anh_en: I realized this was a dream through careful observation. It's often that same keen observation that reveals the deepest truths.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Have you ever considered how someone with lost memories might confuse a dream with reality?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Perhaps paying closer attention to your surroundings could bring you closer to understanding the true nature of "reality."
What are you hinting at? Solaris is a figment of my imagination?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's just a theory. I could be mistaken...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Are you going to leave me? Again?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Well, what a shame.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But waking up isn't so terrible. After all, you never fail to keep things interesting in reality.
Time to wake up.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But I'm actually quite content here.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: This is our arena! Look at all this, so much room for the chase...
It's just a dream.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Then why not stay a bit longer?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's not all that different from reality, if you really think about it.
There's still a lot to do in reality.
A gateway will restore of all this back to reality.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hmm? What's that over there next to the train?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Delivered by Fulei... This is the lost package. How did I not notice it before...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I should give it to Lumi.
You pick up the abandoned package.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: It's already been three days and my package is still—

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: I don't want your compensation! I want my package! In one piece!

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Do you have any idea how important this—

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Ah, the Rover {Male=himself;Female=herself}.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: B-boss? Why are you here in person? I'm just...

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Silence.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: No need for compensation. The contents are still intact. We'll pay you the delivery fee.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Did you retrieve this package yourself from the Waving Battlefield?
Yes. Do I know you?
...I don't think we've met before.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: I'm Tianhu, leader of the Cruising Drake.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I'm terribly sorry, but could you please...

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: The package is secure, and we won't give you any more hassle. In fact, I wouldn't mind getting to know you better.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Not in that way, of course. I heard you took down that beast at Norfall Barrens. The wilds have been quieter since then, which means more opportunities for folks like us.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: We're in need of skilled individuals like yourself more than ever. You'd fit right in.

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Think about joining us one day. The Cruising Drake always welcomes the best of the best.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Hey, wait up, Boss! Why do you always have to walk off like that after talking...

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Shut it! It's about showing our style and drawing in new blood. Pipe down...

You return to Lollo Logistics with the package, only to find the Exiles furious about its damage and ready to pick a fight. Just then, Tianhu, the leader of the Cruising Drake, arrives and swiftly calms his subordinates. He then extends a genuine invitation for you to join his gang.
Lumi, over here!
Lumi, I found the package.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh, oh my!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: This is your package, sir!

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Huh? Let me check... Wait! Look at this, it's damaged!

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Don't expect me to accept a damaged package! This is unacceptable!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: This is our fault... Please accept my sincere apologies. We will compensate you for your loss.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow—

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: So... it's done?
A talking white cat.
A giant black cat.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Heh, that's er... interesting! Didn't know you had such an imagination!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Just like what the white cat said. Only I can see these things...)

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: By the way, you won't believe what happened last night!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I had a DREAM!
Was it a good dream?
Was it a bad dream?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Can't quite remember the details... but it felt sweet!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: My coworkers said they had a similar dream... Maybe I managed to tell them how much I care about them in that dream.
It's all been wrapped up.
I'm sure you did. You're a natural leader.
Yeah, and you'll be a boss someday for sure.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Haha, because I'm Lumi, Luminary of Logistics!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Shhh, gotta keep it low-key... Can't let my boss hear this, or I'll be in trouble.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh no, just got a rush order... Let me give you the payment first.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Again, thanks a bunch for your help! If you ever swing by my hometown, Yuezhou, I'll treat you to some local delicacies!

speaker: NPC #1458
anh_en: We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Got it, got it! Sorry, gotta dash! Catch you later!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Bye, {PlayerName}!
After bowing deeply, Lumi grabs a delivery crate and rushes out of the station.
They asked me to join their gang.

After Tianhu and his subordinates depart, Lumi expresses her heartfelt gratitude. You ask if she remembers what happened in the Somnoire, and as expected, she has forgotten everything upon waking...\n\nNow, you are the only person in Solaris who still remembers this adventure.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Huh... Well, thank you so, so, so much for helping me find the lost package!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Ah? Why the sudden silence?
Did Fulei happen to mention...
I saw something strange in the Waving Battlefield.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh no, what is it?
A flying train.
Oh, hello there.
Thought this place was empty.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: It's you... you've returned.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Here, countless dreams rush in...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: These dreams... I no longer wish to have them, to remember anything.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: But I do remember things about you...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: You're the only one who can restore everything to its rightful place. That's what he said to me.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Farewell, Dreamwalker. May your thoughts remain unclouded.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What is this? I've never seen this in the Somnoire before.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I should look around for more information.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This is... a delivery checklist. The name signed here is "Fulei.")

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The rest is smudged. Someone must have lost it here.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Some kind of fragment lodged between those rocks. Something from a delivery crate?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This is probably where Fulei lost the package, but where is it now...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Is that... Lumi? The Tacet Discords are after her!)

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Find the missing package...
Lumi?
Hey? You okay?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Make sure she gets back safely... help with the express order...
Are you alright?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Organize a welcome party for the new recruits...
Lumi? Can you hear me?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Work finished... Best get movin'. Too many tasks, too little time.
In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Why can't she hear me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: No, she's in danger！
Earlier, over on Lumi's side...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Fulei said the package was lost nearby... Hmm, where is it?

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
The Exile grunts and storms toward the delivery station.
You unexpectedly overhear two Exiles discussing a lost package during transit, with one of them intent on confronting Lollo Logistics about it.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Enough. Explain it in five words.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Suspicious! Courier escaped! Package lost!

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: You're the one who's in charge of this.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Y-yes, but Boss...

speaker: Thiên Hồ
anh_en: Whatever you do, do it right and do it clean. That's the Cruising Drake's principle. Finish what you started.

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: Ah, Lollo Logistics! How despicable! Utterly insufferable!

speaker: NPC #1445
anh_en: I shall reclaim the package myself, that much is clear!
Suddenly, a thunderous sound erupts from the other side.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Ah, a defensive move?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Not bad, but the game is already finished.

speaker: NPC #1457
anh_en: Ahem! We promise, we deliver! Lollo Logistics is at your service! Is there anything I can help you... you with?
What happened exactly?
Tell me about it. Maybe I can help.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: It's a bit complicated... The lost package is labeled as "high value." My team member Fulei was supposed to deliver it.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: He mentioned seeing weird things in Whining Aix's Mire, kinda like the stuff happening over in Tacet Fields.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I checked it out later and asked around in the port.
Sounds like a risky move.
You do act like a leader.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Of course! My team's safety is my top priority!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I didn't notice anything unusual lookin' around, but...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But what?
Are you new here?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.

speaker: NPC #1458
anh_en: We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Ah, it's my coworker. Sorry, I need to take this call.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Yes? What? She's back at work already? But she's injured! ...Okay, please take care of her. Thanks.
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: It's one of my team members. She crashed while delivering an express package.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: The doctor told her to rest, but she's already back to work...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Hmph... I need to bring her back. She can't be pushin' herself like this.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I was planning to search Whining Aix's Mire again, but now...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: If you happen to be going in that direction, could you keep an eye out for that lost package?
I haven't seen you before.
Sure. Leave it to me.
As long as I get paid.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Amazing! Thank you so much!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: No problem. I'll make sure you're well rewarded!

You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.

speaker: NPC #1457
anh_en: Oh, I know you! You're the Rover! A household name in Jinzhou!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Hiya! I'm Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain. I head up the delivery team.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Do you have a package to send, or do you need something else?
That man just now...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh, he's a regular customer. He might seem unfriendly, but he follows the rules.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: His package got lost in Whining Aix's Mire. Speaking of that place, something strange is going on there lately, so be careful when you're there, hmm?
What do you want to do?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But still, they should not be erased.
They won't be.
They live on in people's memories.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: People may eventually forget them, but Somnoire won't!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You saw that girl and how deeply she felt about her dream. It holds significance.
That doesn't justify what you're doing.
You are destroying Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Tell me, have you ever erased another's dreams? Their memories?

speaker: Tiếng Báo Động
anh_en: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: For millennia, I've been doing this tirelessly.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Somnoire has tens of millions of gateways that lead to numerous realms... but it's still too small compared to Solaris.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Those dreams and I are no different in nature, yet I've done nothing but extinguish them.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I don't expect you to understand me. We're not in the same position.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Just know that even the great Rover cannot stop me now!

To preserve every dream within the Somnoire, the Ebony Gatekeeper resolves to use the real world—the entire Solaris—as a new vessel for dreams. He opens numerous gateways throughout Solaris, allowing dreams to invade and consume reality itself.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I need more space to store these precious dreams and memories.
That's why you're expanding the Somnoire to break into reality itself.
Are you planning to expand Somnoire to encompass all of Solaris?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Those gateways that appeared by the Whining Aix's Mire... It's all because of you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Yes, those places will become part of Somnoire, to merge with the other dreams.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Just think of it! They will be forever saved and remembered!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Not every dream holds the key to saving the world... Most are personal, trivial, even selfish.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh! It's his delivery checklist!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: The paper's all smudged, can't read a thing...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: This fragment is from the delivery container... Ugh, where's the package? What if it's been damaged...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Where could it be? Hopefully, I'll find a clue ahead.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Nothing here...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Ah! Where did those Tacet Discords come from?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Can't waste my time with them...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Phew... made it out at last. But why did those monsters stop chasing me?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Ugh, I keep getting sidetracked. Focus, Lumi! Think about what you're gonna do next.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: First, find the missing package...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Second, make sure Tangtang gets back safely and help with the express order...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Third, organize a welcome party for the new recruits... get my own work finished...

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Best get movin'. Too many tasks, too little time.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I'm their leader. Got to act the part. They're counting on me...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Lumi! Thank goodness you're safe!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: {PlayerName}!!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's deal with it first and go find Tangtang.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Let's do it!!!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Phew, finally... {PlayerName}, let's go find Tangtang!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: This must be where Tangtang crashed... I need to find her first, Fulei's package can wait.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Why are there Tacet Discords here? Where is Tangtang? Is she...

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: You're here, Lumi! I've been looking for you!

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: I know, and you've been doing great. I just want to lighten the load.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Aww, Tangtang...

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: Don't worry! I'll catch up with you after I finish this order!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Okay!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Thank you, Tangtang. I mean it.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: And you, Rover...

Against all odds, you and Lumi finally find Tangtang, her injured teammate, who had been searching for Lumi as well. Lumi is deeply moved, realizing for the first time that her value isn’t just in what she gives to others—her team members genuinely want to support her in return.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Looking for me? I should be the one saying that. I heard you had an accident...

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: A small scratch, no biggie.

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: I was worried you might run into a Tacet Discord, so I came looking for you.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Thanks, I'm fine. Let me help you with the delivery.

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: It's okay. The address is around here somewhere. It won't take long.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: But you're hurt. You relax and let me handle it, alright?

speaker: NPC #1454
anh_en: I can manage, really. You have your own tasks to do. I can even help you later when I'm done!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: It's my job to look out for you... That's what a team leader should do.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh, hi! You're here!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I help my team, and they help me right back.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I think that's where I found the strength to escape that nightmare.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I wouldn't have realized this without your help. Thank you so much, {PlayerName}.
Lumi! Thank goodness you're safe!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: D'ya know what, I had a dream just now! And guess what? You were in it!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: My team members were asking for help, but I couldn't get to them.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I kept getting blocked or showing up too late.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I was so worried, thinking they might be disappointed or not need me anymore.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: But later, I managed to find a girl who'd got into an accident.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I don't know how, but I felt like you were guiding me.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Talking with her made me see how important it is to support each other.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Thanks a lot...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: No energy left. Can't talk. Stop disaster. I trust you...
This is what I do.
You're going to sleep?
(Stroke the white cat)

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow—

After aiding Lumi in resolving her issues, you discover that the white cat can now speak. It explains that gateways have emerged across various regions, and it has lost its control over the Somnoire. It requests you to help reclaim its clearance.
You can talk!

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Only a bit...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Many places... gateway open. Enter and fight!
I see now. I can help.
I saw Lumi. Is she okay?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: A sharp mind. You are smart.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: You saw Illusia, not real Lumi. She is safe, don't worry...
You feel your body grow heavy, as if you're sinking beneath the water, and finally find yourself in an unfamiliar dream.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (And the Illusia I just saw of her... This abnormal Somnoire seems to be trapping parts of people's consciousness in their dreams.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (If this has been going on for a while, Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (She dreams about her team, but what about the others? I need to find more clues.)

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: We need you to infiltrate the Blue Camel and get their latest transaction records.

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: Remember, don't get caught, or they'll destroy the evidence.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Infiltration... Hmm, I'll need to suit up right.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Gotta sever communications at their camp first. Can't have them calling for backup.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (He better not be stirring up any trouble.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (No time to call the Patrollers. Let's see what he's up to.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Somnoire gateway must be just ahead...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But why is it closed?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow—

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Feels like I'm floating... Is the cat helping me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This should be the last one.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This outfit should do the trick.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's their hideout. Time to find a discreet spot to change.
You change to blend in with the other Blue Camel Exiles.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This is it... Need to send it back ASAP.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Better hang onto this outfit in case I run into the guards.
You are struck with a wave of dizziness as the Patroller's voice grows distant...

speaker: NPC #1551
anh_en: Hey! What's that you're holding?

speaker: NPC #1551
anh_en: Well... It's good that you want to bring them to justice.

speaker: NPC #1551
anh_en: Alright, I'll escort her to the Bureau. The rest of you, resume your duties.

Yinlin successfully acquires the transaction records by infiltrating the enemy camp. On her way back, she is apprehended by a Patroller for appearing to be an Exile. Yinlin decides to feign surrender so she can be sent to the Public Security Bureau, where she will deliver the records to "Red Eagle."
Delivery for my boss.
Replacement parts, nothing else.

speaker: NPC #1551
anh_en: Open it. We need to check what's inside. We've had reports about Exiles conducting illegal business recently.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: ("Red Eagle" needs this. I can't let them search the box.)
(Pretend to turn yourself in)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I confess, sir. This is proof of their crimes...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I can't stand their dirty deeds anymore, so I'm taking this to the Public Security Bureau myself.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: If you don't trust me, you can come along.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No injuries. Looks like they just passed out.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They'll wake at any moment. I need to get the evidence back to him.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This place... something feels wrong. I need to be on my guard.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What happened... Huh? Why are they all lying on the ground?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Back at the Blue Camel’s camp again? This isn't right...

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: I've told you before not to come barging in here.

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: You've been fooled! I never gave you such an order!

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: Can't you spot a fake transmission?

speaker: NPC #1449
anh_en: You've disappointed me, Yinlin.
Fake? How?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: (Was the intel false, or did someone impersonate him when they contacted me?)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Blaming me won't make any difference. I need to get to the bottom of this.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Give me some time. I'll figure it out.
Yinlin presents the records to the "Red Eagle," only to be informed that no such request was ever made. Sensing something amiss, she decides to investigate further.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Something unexpected happened during the mission... This will be safer with you.
(Hand over the file)

speaker: NPC #1449

The Blue Camel's transaction records. You asked for them.

anh_en: ...If you say so. Come to think of it, Lollo Logistics has never missed a delivery... In that case, I'll come back later.

speaker: NPC #750088

I put my trust in the wrong person.

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Yinlin!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you came because you were worried about me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's take them down together.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe, no rush. They'll be leaving soon.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: You're nothing, Yinlin!

anh_en: Baa!

anh_en: One day, she met her good friend, Cloudy.

anh_en: The Big Bad Demon sent its minions to attack the Magical Kingdom.

anh_en: Everyone hid at home, and the stage was empty and quiet.

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Baa...

anh_en: But then, Warrior Encore stood up and said she would fight the Big Bad Demon!

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Baa!

anh_en: There you go, Cosmos!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: One day, Warrior Encore met Cosmos.

anh_en: Sad little adventurer Cosmos was so moved by these words.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: This special friendship made him join Encore's team.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore!

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Baa!

anh_en: Warrior Encore and her friends marched to find the Big Bad Demon.

anh_en: The sly Demon sent its monster squad to try to stop them!

anh_en: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventurer Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: In the end, Encore's super team took care of the monsters! But the Woolies got hurt...

speaker: An'ke

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Then, the super team marched on their way to fight the Big Bad Demon.

anh_en: At last, it was time to fight the Big Bad Demon!

anh_en: Don't worry. You can do it too!

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: As much as she loved that town, she never stopped wanting to explore the world outside it.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Um, I heard the Sonoro Sphere can keep memories of people or even a place's history. Is that true?

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: What I saw just now, is it real? Is that girl my Grandma?

speaker: NPC #1452
anh_en: My apologies, but I cannot answer that.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Can I come here again?

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: What happens when I wake up? Will this place and my memory of it disappear?

speaker: NPC #1452
anh_en: A part of your consciousness entered Somnoire when you fell asleep.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Somnoire? What's that? Some kind of Sonoro?

speaker: NPC #1452
anh_en: No, but you can think of it that way.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Well... just now, I met a girl around my age. She had the same name as Grandma.

speaker: NPC #1452
anh_en: Everything you saw here will be erased, except your memory. That I have no control over.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: That's a relief... Thank you, kind sir. That's given me some hope.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: In my memories, Grandma always took care of everyone in the family.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: She raised her children and they left home, then her grandchildren, repeating this cycle her entire life in that old house.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: I always wanted to travel, but I couldn't bear to leave Grandma alone.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: This dream showed me a different side of her. She was once a young girl with dreams... just like me.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: She dreamed of traveling, meeting new people, and starting a family.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Now I feel grateful to be part of such a family. And even more grateful to have this side of Grandma live on in my memories.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: I used to think she was old and lonely, but she really glowed with her hopes and dreams.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Thank you, sir. Thank you for showing me this.
In the dream, the girl encounters her grandmother in her youth, gaining a deeper understanding of her. This heartfelt experience brings her solace, easing the sorrow of her grandmother's passing.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: Excuse me, sir. Is this all real? Are you the god of this realm?

speaker: NPC #1452
anh_en: ...How did you get in?

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: I don't know... I was supposed to be at my Grandma's funeral.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: I was watching over her and lost track of time.

speaker: Ảo Ảnh Của Thiếu Nữ
anh_en: The next moment, I was here... Maybe I fell asleep?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That happened in the past... I was looking at their Illusias.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Gatekeeper showed this to me... What is he trying to tell me?

speaker: Tiếng Báo Động
anh_en: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.

anh_en: Waving Battlefield? I was there a week ago... on break... Ahem, can't let my boss know this.

speaker: NPC #1447
anh_en: Anyway, I haven't had any dreams ever since then! It's so weird!

speaker: NPC #1447
anh_en: I heard that some researchers screwed up an experiment there. Some even died in an accident... Wait, don't tell me I'm being haunted by their ghosts!

speaker: NPC #1447
anh_en: Oh no, kind ghosts, have mercy on me!

speaker: NPC #150024
anh_en: Just know that even the great Rover cannot stop me now!

In an instant, it feels as if every memory has slipped away, like a fleeting nightmare.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nobody's here, just this cat. What's going on...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's about to collapse... Better leave now.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It has been some time, hasn't it {PlayerName}?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It appears so, but the answer is something more fundamental.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Exactly, Dreamwalker...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Such a large and complex creation is necessary to save a world torn apart by the Lament.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The dreams it stores contain countless possibilities...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Millions upon millions of dreams converge in Somnoire... Perhaps within one lies the key to vanquishing the Lament.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It may not be the most efficient or practical strategy, but even as a mere spark of hope... I believe it's worth pursuing with all the power I have.
Who created Somnoire?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: They're closely connected to you... But that's not important right now.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: One day, you'll find out who they are.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Compared to you, who is of immense significance to them, I am just a tool they created to get rid of useless data.
So, it was you who did this.
What useless data?
Why are you getting rid of it?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Every day, people dream, but Somnoire's capacity is finite.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Dreams that don't aid in defeating the Lament are deemed worthless.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: My duty is to erase them, like a heartless executioner.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: By this reasoning, the two dreams you just witnessed should also be erased—they offer no solution to save our world.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: What do you think? Are they useless?
They mean a lot to the ones who dreamed them.
Regardless, every dream has its own meaning.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Indeed... those dreams are truly precious.
Why are you showing me this?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: They deserved to be remembered.

The Ebony Gatekeeper stands before you, revealing that the Somnoire acts as a vessel for storing dreams, and he is on a quest to find a way to confront the Lament. He explains that his role involves clearing the Somnoire by erasing what is deemed "useless dreams." Yet, despite this duty, he struggles with the idea. His conversation with a young girl leads him to the realization that he, too, is just a string of data, and that these so-called "useless dreams" hold the power to inspire and motivate people. Determined to change his course, he resolves to preserve every dream within the Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen

To fight against the Lament.

anh_en: Meow...

Lazy kitty.
Night, night.
