anh_en: (The cat's weaker than last time. What's worse, the Gatekeeper said the expansion is accelerating...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I have to stop it before it's too late...)

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Master Zhezhi, have you made any plans for your next painting?

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Trust me. This will be another best-seller!
I-I need to consider it.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Of course. Take your time, Master Zhezhi. Let me know when you've decided.
A manager asks Zhezhi to focus solely on producing more copies of her renowned painting Winter's Serenade in Bloom, but Zhezhi seems determined to follow her own path.
Ah, n-not yet.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: If you don't paint, you can't earn! You don't wanna end up broke, do ya?

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: What about painting... what was it called? Ah, Winter's Serenade in Bloom?
I've already painted that one...
I-I want to try something different.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: So what? Your clients' preferences are what matter most.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Don't worry, Master Zhezhi! I handpicked your clients and know them like the back of my hand.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: That painting was outstandingly popular, I would know.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ha... I need a walk now. Maybe I'll find some new inspiration.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This place...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's all so beautiful... I have to capture it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Let me find the perfect spot to stop and paint.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Didn't expect to see Tacet Discords like that here.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... They do complete the scene I had in mind.

speaker: NPC #1448
anh_en: Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't had any dreams this week.

speaker: NPC #1448
anh_en: I used to have nightmares about the day my father left. He was devoured by a Tacet Field and never returned.

speaker: NPC #1448
anh_en: But since the dreams stopped, I've been sleeping better than ever.

speaker: NPC #1448
anh_en: Maybe it's my father who's been driving them away... Heh, maybe it's a blessing in disguise?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The landscape looks great from this side. It's perfect for planning my painting.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The composition looks fine, but something's still missing...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Maybe I should get closer to see the tiny details of the trees and rocks.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That place should be close enough.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Waterlamp, Dewvetch, Pearl Leaf, and Bittberry...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: These vibrant plants harmonize exquisitely with the cold stones.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The details of the stones and trees... I got it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I can show this draft to my manager.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Master Zhezhi!
I had new inspiration.
It's still a draft, but...

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Zhezhi, you're a true master! Would a master present a client with a half-finished piece?

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Your last painting sold for the highest price at auction! Give the people what they want, that's what I always say.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: You just need to paint it again, and I'll make sure it sells well.
Paint it... again?

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: With all due respect, Master Zhezhi, not everyone will buy whatever you paint.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: I've worked so hard to find a few clients who love your style. How can I sell your paintings if you can't cater to their needs?

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Please focus on recre—I mean, creating tonight! I won't disturb you. I'll come and pick it up tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: No more indulging your every creative whim. All I'm asking for is another Winter's Serenade in Bloom. I'm counting on you, Master Zhezhi!
I-I'm no master...
Zhezhi presents her latest work to the manager, but he insists that she should only replicate her earlier piece, which has already garnered widespread acclaim.
Please, just call me Zhezhi.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Okay, Master Zhezhi! About the painting I mentioned last time...
Here's the draft.

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Very well! Let's see!
(Give the draft)

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: What? What's this?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What do you really want to paint?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Do you remember when you painted the first Winter's Serenade in Bloom?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You worked really hard on it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: And... that hard work should be noticed.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Believe in your judgment, your brush, and yourself.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Believe in... myself.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Zhezhi musters her courage and continues to work on the unfinished draft.)

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away, the painted world fades, forgotten today...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Zhezhi.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This giant bird... It's... it's the one from Winter's Serenade in Bloom!

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: I keep telling you, your clients only want that one painting!

speaker: NPC #1453
anh_en: Don't be so stubborn, Zhezhi! A painting that doesn't sell well is meaningless!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I'm the artist, not just the brush.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's the soul I put into my paintings that makes people appreciate them!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I was just dreaming. In that dream, I tried my best to paint something new, but no one seemed to like it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I-I'll keep practicing!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Instead, they just wanted more copies of my old stuff, treating me like some money machine.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But you told me to trust myself...
They are using you.
People aren't tools.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you for supporting me, {PlayerName}.
No problem, Master Zhezhi.
You'll be better. I believe in you.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Y-you don't have to call me "Master"...
You feel your body grow heavy, as if you're sinking beneath the water, and finally find yourself in an unfamiliar dream.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Hey! I can talk again!
(Stroke the white cat)

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I'm no cat, you know...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow—
How did you manage to do that?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Power grows. Strong enough to fight him.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Next time, I will talk even better!
String a full sentence together?
I prefer your current style.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Help me... Too much sleep. This is the last time...
You want some cat food?
Cats really do sleep through anything.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...Interesting.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It reminds me of the Hongzhen in my memories.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What happened here?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: In that year, a peculiar incident occurred.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: A parent lost their only child, and despite extensive searches around Mt. Firmament, no trace of the missing boy was discovered.

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: Please, help us find our son...
What was he doing before he disappeared?

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: We were having lunch together, just two days ago.

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: Later, I went up the mountain to fetch spring water. When I got back, he was gone...
Did your wife see him after you left home?

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: She said Jing was out playing with his friends... but he never came home.

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: I've been worried sick ever since, unable to eat or sleep...  Jing, where are you now...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Beyond the wolves' howls, there's another sound lurking in this storm.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hehe, if you truly are the untamable beasts you claim to be, then why have you let yourself to be so easily at someone's disposal?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: There's more to this case than meets the eye...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How about we start by investigating the missing person's home?
You cautiously inspect the wooden cabinet and discover something strange.

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: Jing, my poor boy... Please come back home...
Did Jing have any close friends?

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: Yes...
Did any of them happen to see him?

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: Jing had been increasingly withdrawn, preferring to stay home. He stopped playing with his friends.

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: But that day, he said he wanted to play with them. It seemed odd, so I asked those kids later, but none of them had seen Jing...

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: ... Oh, how can I go on without my Jing...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Now that we know who the real culprit is, it's time to act.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Madam, let's not be hasty. The time hasn't yet come.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Finding the culprit is simple. The real challenge is capturing them all at once.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Fully prepare and wait for the right moment—that's a wise strategy, Changli.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: All of the boy's clothes since his infancy are neatly folded...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Except for... his pajamas.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hmm... the board is set, but the final move is yet to be made.

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: Did you find Jing?

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: How did you find out!?
I'm afraid you'll never know the answer.

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: Where is he? Please tell me...
You'll never see him again.
He's gone.

speaker: NPC #1455
anh_en: What?

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: No... my child... Who did this? Why would someone do this?
Stop pretending, Fractsidus.
You're the one who killed him.

speaker: NPC #1456
anh_en: W-what are you talking about? I don't understand...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hehe, he's not the same as the one we faced before.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If they lost back then, they'll lose again today.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Don't worry. While my flames can't destroy this Somnoire, they're more than enough to handle these pests.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You don't seem surprised to see me.
Certainly.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Then why didn't you try to escape?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: To win a game, you must first play it.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Besides... someone who knows they're dreaming is more dangerous, don't you think?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Making yourself part of the game... that's something you'd do.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I need you right now, Changli.

Changli isn't surprised to see you. She has already pieced together the entire story of this case and knows she's trapped in a dream. She reveals that she isn't attempting to escape because she believes she holds the advantage over her enemies, who remain oblivious to their situation.
It's as I expected.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How did you know they killed Jing?
Mt. Firmament is always covered in snow.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: No child would go out in thin pajamas in such freezing conditions.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So you realized it was orchestrated by the Fractsidus...
Yes, it was Xinyi who solved this case.
The Fractsidus were lurking in Hongzhen, concealing their true identities.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You know this is a dream, right?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: So, are you interested in the details of that case?
A genius move.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I'd say your strategy is no less impressive than hers.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Though our enemy's identity remains unclear... I'll support you, come what may.
Yes. I'm all ears.
Give me the details.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Back then, the Fractsidus killed Jing and his parents under the cover of night.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: They then posed as Jing's parents and lay in wait until Xinyi figured it out.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But instead of exposing them right away, she played along, biding her time.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After two weeks, the Fractsidus couldn't restrain themselves any longer.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: They used the pretense of searching for their lost boy to scout out Mt. Firmament.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Of course, Xinyi was prepared for this. She used the opportunity to expose them in the act and capture them.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow! Haha!
Alright, alright. Good kitty.
(Stroke the white cat)

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: We will finish this! Together!

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow! Hey! Don't treat me like a cat!

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I can finally talk in full sentences!
It doesn't sound like you.
I prefer how you used to talk.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Yeah, yeah, try to meow or speak three words yourself. You don't want to know how it feels...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Anyway, we're down to our last gateway.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Once you rescue the last person from their dream, I can finally balance my control over Somnoire with the Gatekeeper's.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: That's when we can launch our final attack.
I'll finish him with one strike.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Is this real or just another dream?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe... If it's a dream, it better be juicy!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Huh... {Male=He;Female=She}'s here too?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Wait for me to catch you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That white cat... Why are the Tacet Discords after it?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll handle them first.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, you wanna play hide and seek?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The tastiest meal is always the one you've worked hardest to catch.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: There you are.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Quit the running and come play with me. Let's not waste our precious time.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ugh, what a bother...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Why does the Black Shores keep dumping these dull missions on me?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...This doesn't satisfy me at all!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...Hello? {Male=He;Female=She} disappeared again.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Boring, boring, boring...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...I hate boring!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I live for a good thrill.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But it's so hard to find one that meets my standards.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Some have potential, but they're still too dull.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Only you can really get my heart racing, {PlayerName}.
You swing your final strike at the struggling enemy, but your blade cuts through nothing but air.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...You?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: No... Impossible.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I remember the way you fought—your blade's strong enough to sever the air itself.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Powerful, beautiful, intoxicating...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ah... My head... It hurts. No, that's not you!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is that... Camellya? She needs help.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I need to go to her, quick.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Gotta be faster...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Too slow...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's... you...
We can do this after we get out.
I'll make time for you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, is that an invitation? You do know how to please me.
Yes.
I'm here for you, Camellya.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...Hehe, I knew I was right.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: That thing couldn't be you. You always... exceed my expectations.
I'm right here.
I won't die that easily.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...I know. After all, you're the one I've chosen, my beloved seed.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: While I crave your sweet words, a part of me craves the thrill of hunting you down.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow—
Why were you running away?
What happened inside the gateway?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow... meow...
You want me to go inside?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Meow!
In the Whining Aix's Mire, you encounter a white cat that escaped the Somnoire by train. It asks you to enter a mysterious gateway...

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: Hi {PlayerName}! Want to feel the thrill of the ride in total safety? You should try our motorbike simulator!

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: It's an AI-powered training system that we, the Biomatic Club, built with the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society. Right now, we're looking for test riders!

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: The thing is—the simulator's grown an attitude and is being super selective about its riders, which is exactly why we need a skilled rider like you!

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: I've sent you the coordinates. This is a new version still under wraps, so it's a totally new experience guaranteed!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Strange. I only fed the system with standard student data...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where did it pick up this preference for riders?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Shouldn't I at least be on its approved list...?

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: Oh, hey {PlayerName}! It's so cool to finally meet the Voidworm Rider in person. I'm Kinova, the Biomatic Club member who contacted you!
What should I do exactly?
Could you share the rules first?

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: It's simple. Just race with our simulator. I built it to train riders for real-life situations in a totally safe environment.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: For H.E.R.M.E.S., racing with a rider is part of its core code. It's been waiting for someone at the top of the game!

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: Fair warning—if you run into some odd interferences on the track. That's just junk training data taking shape in the simulation.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: But no worries, H.E.R.M.E.S. offers tailored skills to each rider and an arsenal of weapons. Feel free to raze them out of the algorithm!
So there are some other riders?

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: Yeah! Back in the stress test—before H.E.R.M.E.S. got so fussy—I invited some top riders from the Academy. You might even know a few of them.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: The better you race, the more H.E.R.M.E.S. warms up to you. That unlocks other riders' skill data, so you can try out totally new styles.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: And don't let its attitude scare you. H.E.R.M.E.S. has every function you'd need. It's the joint effort between the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society and us, after all. You'll have a solid racing experience, guaranteed!

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: And here it is: Heuristic Expedition Robotic Motorbike - Embedded Sentience, Mark II—our latest AI-driven VR motorbike simulator.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: I loaded it with all the Lahai-Roi terrain data I could find. The tracks simulated feel amazingly lifelike.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: And best of all? Since it's just a simulator, you'll never get a speeding ticket from Mr. S.I.G.M.A.!
Sounds like a fun.
I'll try it, then.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: Excellent! You have our club's most sincere gratitude! Now hop on H.E.R.M.E.S. to start your exclusive journey!

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: We like to call it by its acronym, H.E.R.M.E.S.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: It is the heart and soul of this club. But, as much as I hate to admit it, we’ve hit a snag. It's become finicky in the skill level of its rider, perhaps due to the student data we've been feeding it.
Why me?
But I'm just another regular student.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: C'mon, everyone's heard what you and Lynae pulled off! If the legendary Voidworm Rider can't handle this thing, then nobody can.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: You're just being modest. Everyone's heard what you and Lynae pulled off! If the legendary Voidworm Rider can't handle this thing, then nobody can.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: We're just one step away from finalizing the testing. Could you give us a hand, pretty please?

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: Thank you so, so much! You really helped train the model and cleared out a ton of redundant training data. It's running way smoother now.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: It's been a real lesson for me. Next time I train an AI, I'm definitely screening the data first. Can't afford to have a random student with their whimsical thoughts run the tests again.
Easy peasy. Nothing I can't handle.
You can always rely on me.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: You know, after spending all this time in the lab, I've been thinking… if I ever quit research, I'd love to travel the world riding H.E.R.M.E.S.

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: But to make that happen, I'll have to keep upgrading it, and really work to earn its approval!

speaker: NPC #750401
anh_en: It's been great working with you! Safe travels ahead. See you around!
See you!
Best of luck with H.E.R.M.E.S.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Oh, I'm finally patched through. Hello? {PlayerName}... Can you hear me?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Aha, good to hear your voice. I'm Yhoran. We met back at the Black Shores.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Loud and clear.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Do you still remember the Tactical Trial you took part in before? We're currently running a similar project, and we could use your assistance again.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I suppose you're still in Rinascita?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: You can find me in Ragunna City and I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Long time no see, {PlayerName}. Stories of your adventures in Ragunna are all over the streets!

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Sounds like something straight out of an action movie, doesn't it?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: KU-Cass even came up with a cool name for it—Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier. Said the name was inspired by some of its retro video games.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Anyway, we're counting on you to give the holograms a run. And as always, we'll make it worth your while.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: And if possible, feel free to call over some friends to take a spin on the simulation. The more data we can get our hands on, the better.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Well, {PlayerName}, I'll be looking forward to your performance!
Like the Virtual Crisis project？

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Jokes aside. The Tethys System has always kept a close watch on Rinascita, and our emergency response team just received new data linked to Dark Tide activity.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: To help prevent another Waveworn Phenomenon on the scale of a Dark Tide, we've been working with local authorities to conduct simulations using a hologram device in regions vulnerable to the Threnodian's power.
I can feel the crisis already.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Exactly. It utilizes a similar technology, but the scenarios you'll experience are only extreme predictions simulated by Tethys, so nothing to worry about, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: After all, Tethys is in charge of preparing us for every possible scenario. As they like to say… hmm, what was it again?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Ah, right: "The grim reaper won't come when you're ready for him."

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: It's worth mentioning that unlike our usual training, which revolves around skirmishes, this time Tethys wants to focus on scenarios concerning the deployment of individual Resonators.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: To put it simply, in the event of a TD outbreak triggered by the Lament, elite Resonators will be deployed across weak points behind enemy lines to create diversions or take out high-value targets.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Three minutes, and your idea may start a total cafeteria transformation!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Join the beta test now and get exclusive rewards!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Welcome! Since the beginning of the Celebration, 24,601 students have walked right past my booth. But you? You made the wise choice to stop!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Long story short, it all goes back to our Academy's great and controversial Food, Utilities & Energy Lounge, A.K.A. the cafeteria.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Honestly, I've never understood the hate. The cafeteria food's nutritionally on point, efficient, even kinda reminds me of home cooking... so why does everyone keep complaining?

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: So, after thorough analysis, I've come to a conclusion: it's not the food. It's the whole dining experience. It's flat. It's boring!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: You order, you wait, you eat... rinse and repeat. Every single day. No surprises, no payoff. That's why satisfaction's been sinking.
So... what's your solution?

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: The solution is—gamification! I've extracted the core dining process, mixed in some classic game mechanics, a little physical training, and created this F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: I'm using this club showcase event to finalize my research. If the feedback's solid, I'm taking a formal proposal straight to the Student Council to save the cafeteria's reputation!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: And if an Academy legend like you joins the cause, my data's credibility spikes by a guaranteed eight percent! Please, I could really use your help testing this game!
I'm a professional player. I come with harsh criticisms.
What if the test results don't meet your expectations…

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: No wonder you're the star of the Academy, {PlayerName}! You're exactly the beta tester I've been waiting for. Someone with a keen sense for "efficiency" and an eye for the "future"!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Oh, no big deal! This is game development. Failure is part of the game!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Look, whatever the results are, I can roll with it. Worst case? I'll just tweak it and try again! How about it? Wanna give it a go?
Let's hit it!
The Academy doesn't have that many people…
There aren't that many people taking part in the Celebration…

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Ahem, it's hard to filter out duplicates in the foot traffic statistics. Just a minor issue. No worries.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: I'm Van Tassie, a member of the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society. This ultra-efficient F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator right before you is my very own creation!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: So, what do you think? Ready to claim your spot in this free, non-wipe beta test? Plus, there are generous rewards up for grabs!
Tell me more.
That depends on what the test involves.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You have fully experienced the various features of the F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator... Now, it's time to submit your test feedback.
I figured as much…
This scoring system looks familiar somehow.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: The conclusion is clear: Games should be about fun, and dining should be simple and straightforward. Trying to force them together? Not the move.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Looks like my cafeteria optimization plan won't work out. But that's okay! I'll just keep this simulator as a casual game and keep tweaking the gameplay.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: As for the cafeteria's problems… well, I'll figure out another way to improve the "efficiency." But seriously, thank you for all your help. Once I've run another round of updates, you've gotta have another go at it!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: You're here, {PlayerName}! So, what do you think of this game?
It's pretty interesting.
A bit lacking in the fun department, to be honest.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Thank you! It matches the survey data trend. Overall, reviews for the game itself are holding steady at "mostly positive."

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: It seems this gameplay is pretty close to how students already see the cafeteria. I knew running those extra research rounds upfront was the right call!

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: You're right. I've noticed the problem as well. I was so obsessed with optimizing the dining process that I forgot what actually makes games fun: letting players do stuff they can't do in real life.

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: After all, compared to just eating plain standard energy gels, everyone seems much more interested in those "Cracked! Bolt!" Fish Jars that actually explode…

speaker: NPC #800355
anh_en: Anyway, looking at all the feedback now... the reviews are unfortunately stuck at "mixed." Still got plenty of room to improve...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Maybe I should spice things up a bit…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How about... "junk food" for the next batch?

speaker: NPC #750171
anh_en: Analysing data... Progress at 93.75%. The Rinascita data bundle has been fully recovered.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: No need to feel sad, {PlayerName}. Their sacrifices are a testament to their dreams and oaths to protect others.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Every Black Shores member knew what they signed up for. That includes both of us, isn't that right?

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: To provide additional safety measures for our agents out on the field, the R&D department has developed a few autonomous Combat Machines by combining technologies of simulated Echoes and Tacetite weapons.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: The design purpose is to have them replace field personnel in delaying TD Outbreak attacks, buying time for evacuation. However, there are still some rough edges to be ironed out before they can be fully deployed.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: So to set us on the correct course for improvements, we're collecting TD Outbreak data to create a simulated environment for testing these devices. This is where the Tidal Defense Simulator project comes into play.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: On top of that, we hope to find more efficient deployment strategies through repeated simulations.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: To get the results we're looking for, I'd like to invite you to participate in the simulator project. With what you've achieved in multiple previous crisis trials, you'll certainly help us develop a flawless strategy.
No problem.
I'll do what I can.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750171
anh_en: Initiating regional TD ecosystem data import into the artificial Sonoro Sphere. Requesting computing assistance from the Tethys System. Estimated completion time: 366 seconds.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: I'd like to point out that to verify the machines' combat efficiency, please refrain from using direct attack methods while in the Tidal Defense Simulator.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Let's be honest, normal TDs are a cake walk for you, and if you get too involved, there won't be much left for the machines to do their thing.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: So, as an alternative, I'll have KU-Uigon and its offensive loadouts serve as your tactical support, which should simulate the combat capabilities of the average Bloom Bearer.
Glad to have you with me, KU-Uigon.
Sure, I'll try my best to be gentle.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Right, then KU-Uigon and I'll go get the Sonoro Sphere up and running. Good luck to you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Well done, KU-Uigon.
What are you doing here, Valentina?

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Nice to see you, {PlayerName}. As you can see, we're collecting data associated with the TD Outbreak for the Tidal Defense Simulator project.
Tidal Defense Simulator?

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: Yep. One of the many assignments as a Black Shores field agent is to assist local authorities in evacuating citizens in the event of Waveworn catastrophes or large-scale TD Outbreaks.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: But due to the high risks that often come with the tasks, many Bloom Bearers gave their lives while performing their duties, just like... Niya and Hoda did in the previous Port City of Guixu incident.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: How's everything going so far, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: We appreciate the assistance, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: We'll be staying here until we've finished analyzing the additional TD Outbreak data.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: If you wish to conduct further testing in the Tidal Defense Simulator under even more challenging environments, you are welcome to come here anytime.
Going very smoothly.
Okay... I guess?

speaker: NPC #750171
anh_en: {PlayerName}'s test results have been archived. Based on the data, Bloom Bearer {PlayerName} has demonstrated extraordinary tactical capabilities.

speaker: NPC #750171
anh_en: Machines set up by {PlayerName} produced a combat efficiency 52.63% higher than the Black Shores average.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: 52.63%... That's a number you don't see very often. Then again, it means that none of the previous tests truly captured the Combat Machines' full potential.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: I'll file an application to develop the tactical guidelines on the Combat Machines based on your test results.
Glad to be of help.

speaker: NPC #750018
anh_en: And, of course, your efforts were of considerable help to us. With these test data, the devices are one step closer to field deployment.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Progress report, KU-Uigon.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Awaiting further data input. Please stand by, Valentina.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Your timing is impeccable, my friend. We've just finished tidying up this area. You see, my employer, Mr. Geisel, loves traveling and collecting curiosities. And he has a particular fondness for Echoes.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: They say he once set out on a journey to become an Echo Master. Along the way, he fought many villains, gathering a whole menagerie of Echoes with his signature red-and-white Echo ball. All displayed here.
(The story sounds familiar.)
(Echo ball? Isn't it usually a Terminal...?)

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: This was his personal gallery. These adorable beings always bring color and life to the fest.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Feel free to arrange them as you like. I'm sure they are eager for your attention.

speaker: NPC #750341
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you must be a wee bit tired lately! How about a breather?
You mean a luxurious party? Don't tell me it's at the Distribution Center?
A mysterious legend? How mysterious are we talking?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: You read my mind.

speaker: NPC #750341
anh_en: Aye! I was hoping you'd say that. Official announcement: Lollo Logistics is throwing a proper luxurious bash, and you're on the guest list!

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: You mean a luxurious party? Don't tell me it's at the Distribution Center?

speaker: NPC #750341
anh_en: No, no! It's somewhere you'd never expect!

speaker: NPC #750341
anh_en: Plus, you'll get to hear a mysterious legend while you're there.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: A mysterious legend? How mysterious are we talking?

speaker: NPC #750341
anh_en: Hmm… think three, maybe four mysteries all rolled into one! Now quit your dilly-dallying! We'll be waiting for you at the end of the Forever Fest!
You read my mind.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you made it! So, what d'ye think? Not too shabby, eh?
So that's why you co-hosted this party.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Exactly! When I got lost here, they helped me. Now I want to help them wrap up the Forever Fest with a proper smile.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: So I had a chat with both sides. Decided we'd liven up the party and hopefully, we'll suss out how it all started that way!
That's just like you, Lumi.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Hehe. Truth is, the only events we've ever handled were company year-enders. At first, I was stumped! But thankfully, a Mr. Cobb Copo showed up to save the day!
Who might that be?
A new hire at Lollo Logistics?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: He's the Forever Fest's dedicated butler. Managing all this is second nature to the man! He's been a huge help.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh no, no. He is the Forever Fest's dedicated butler. Managing all this is almost second nature to him. He's been a huge help.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: By the way, he's settin' up the games right now. You'll find him by the card table! What's a proper party without a wee game to start, eh?
Not exactly the image I had of Lollo Logistics.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Heehee! For our clients, we can be anythin' we need to be! But I'll admit, throwin' a party here was a right surprise, even for me.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I stumbled into this Sonoro a while back and found this extravagant place inside! And it's full of all these... "special folk."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Special? They look pretty ordinary to me.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: We checked with HQ. Turns out this place was created by a Resonator's rare ability. The folks here sense it, kind of, but most just stop askin' questions and lose themselves in the Forever Fest.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: But nothing really lasts forever, does it? Even this Sonoro. See? It's already startin' to fade.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: They all know it. Even a "Forever Fest" won't last forever. But they've grown so used to the happiness here, they'd rather the endin' be a happy one, too.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Before this place vanishes, they want to know what's weighing on the host's heart. They asked me to look into it.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Ah, it seems you have mastered the rules in full, Miss Jinhsi. The table now awaits only the hand of your opponent.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Ah, allow me to introduce Mr. Copo. I was just sharing some of your exploits with him.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Cobb Copo, at your service. What an extraordinary demeanor. One might easily mistake you for the very host of this fest.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Speaking of which, where is the host?

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Mr. Geisel rarely resides here. He used to come and go, but it has been a very long time since his last departure. I'm afraid…

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Ah, forgive me. I've spoken out of turn. Tonight, you are the stars of this fest—no, this party. Please, no need for reserve. Enjoy it to the fullest.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: With that, I'll take my leave. Should you need anything, you have but to call.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Mr. Copo always manages to slip Mr. Geisel into the conversation. He even told me a few stories earlier.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Maybe they share a deep connection. When someone means that much, their name naturally slips into your speech… Ahem. In any case, {PlayerName}—

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Mr. Copo just taught me a card game. It's different from Weiqi, but charming in its own way. Would you be my opponent?
But I don't know the rules yet.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Thank you, Mr. Copo. I believe {Male=he;Female=she} has just arrived.
I'd be honored.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Don't worry, I'll teach you everything I just learned.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Mm, I look forward to it.
Jinhsi turns to look at you, her gaze following you until you reach her side.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: {PlayerName}, it has been too long. Word of your arrival reached me, so I've been waiting here.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Jinhsi, it really has been too long… I thought you'd never leave Jinzhou.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Well… I still am in Jinzhou.
Another projection?
Huanglong's holographic tech has come a long way.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Yes. We've invested more resources in Huaxu Academy. Their hard work has borne exceptional fruit.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: The engineers inform me that this goes beyond mere holograms. Next time, the tech might have advanced enough to meet in a more tangible way outside Huanglong.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: When Mr. Copo explained it, I thought it a light amusement. But now, playing against you, I've truly felt its thrill.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Very well, I'll be waiting.
Playing against you is a treat.
You are hard to read, Jinhsi.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Mm. When time allows, we should play more often.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: A Magistrate must learn to wear many faces for different situations.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But in one of the rounds, I confess I may have gotten a little reckless...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't worry, Jinhsi. A game at a party is meant to be fun.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: You're right. I do have a habit of overthinking.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't forget to breathe, Magistrate. Oh and, I'm looking forward to seeing you back in Jinzhou someday.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Doing guest satisfaction surveys, Lumi?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh, no need for that! I have full faith in Mr. Copo and Lollo Logistics! Bet he's already told you about the host? What's he called now...? Ah, Geisel!
Yes, that's the name.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I knew it. He can't help himself! Always talkin' about Geisel, why he left, where he went. And it's not just Mr. Copo. Everyone here is wonderin' the same.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: That's why I'm askin' around. Gotta get to the bottom of it fast.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: How can a truly good party leave anyone with regrets, right?
Couldn't have said it better.
That's very sweet, Lumi.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Hehe, I'll carry on with my questions then! But hey, don't you go worryin' about it. Just enjoy yourself and leave with a heart full of happy memories!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Something on your mind, Mr. Copo?

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Please, forgive my preoccupation. It is no grave matter, only that over all these long years, the decor here has scarcely changed.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: New guests deserve a fresh atmosphere, but the long years I've spent here have blinded me to the world's current fashions. Might you offer some suggestions?
I am the No.1 tastemaker in Solaris.
I'll see what I can do.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: I could tell at first glance.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Splendid. Your help will be greatly appreciated.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: So please, let your creativity flow! Be it new furnishings or a change of floor design, just speak your idea, and I shall see it done.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Judging by that look on your face, you've dug up a clue, haven't you, Lumi?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh! And apparently, before she left, she got a wee bit cross and said somethin' like "It's time you grew up, Geisel."
What's that supposed to mean?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Right? It makes no sense! But anyway, not long after that, Geisel himself left.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like he left this all behind for her. But... I doubt it's that simple.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Exactly my thoughts! One clue will always lead to another. The party may end eventually, but we've still got time to figure it out.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Alright, enough snoopin' for now! Back to party business. Mr. Copo says we need new areas ready tomorrow, so I'd best get crackin'!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Mm… not the answer we're lookin' for, but I did hear somethin' intriguing.
Let's hear it.
I'm listening.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I heard that during Geisel's last visit, he brought a lady with him, but they all said she was terribly rude.
How so?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: It was Geisel's first time bringing a lady back, so everyone was glad. They laid out the best food, prepared the finest room. But she didn't seem to care one bit.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: She didn't eat, didn't drink, didn't even bother looking at the room. Just strutted around a bit, then left on her own.
That's strange.
Time seems to elude perception in this place.\nIt's only when a new visitor mentions it that you realize a full day has passed outside.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: You're finally here, Warrior!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Anyway, now it's your time to shine!
My time to shine?
Don't tell me we're gladiating here.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: That's right! I've been looking forward to it.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Hah! We'll save the brawling for a proper arena. Here, the only clashing we do is with cocktail glasses!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: While you were away, we ran a little poll for today's mixologist. And you, {PlayerName}, were everyone's first pick.
Me? A mixologist?

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Allow me to clarify. At the Forever Fest, we observe a long-standing tradition that mixologists are not hired, but chosen by the guests themselves. And for the Lollo Party, we wanted to keep that tradition alive.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Of course, the choice is entirely yours. It's simply that everyone seems to have a lot of faith in your skills.
Can't say I'm surprised.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Come on! You're the one who was a no-show yesterday.
Not sure I have faith in myself, though.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Count me in as customer number one!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Trust me, whatever you make will be great. I'll down it in one go! Guaranteed!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Haha! I wanted to come sooner, but I had a match I couldn't back out of.
How'd it go?
Let me guess, easy victory?
Makes me miss fighting with you.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: A total knockout, of course!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: As long as you're rooting for me, losing isn't even an option.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: The world's full of fights waiting for us! And with a partner like you, we're unstoppable!

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: I had the pleasure of watching you mix earlier. Such finesse, on your very first try. You may yet become Solaris's greatest mixologist.
Guess I've got a knack for it.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: If you have company to treat later, feel free to take over this counter. I'm sure your drinks will have them singing your praises.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you're here! Look what I just found!
Another lead?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Aye! More of a lucky find, really. I was tidying up the counter and found these notes tucked away.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: They are Geisel's notes. And he was writin' about... her.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: From these notes, it's clear that Mr. Geisel couldn't stand the thought of beautiful things fadin'. Probably why he created the Forever Fest.
Maybe not.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: If it's real, I will find it!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: If it doesn't exist, what was she really tryin' to say...?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Ah, anyway, thanks for lettin' me ramble on. I should get ready for tomorrow's event. You go on and enjoy the rest of the party!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: But if he had the power to do that, what's so wrong with it? Why did that lady get so angry...?
There's more to the story.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Mm, yes. Must be somethin' we don't know yet.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: There's one more thing that caught my eye. She asked Geisel to leave all this behind and follow her to a place where "a river of stars falls."

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: She said that's where the answer is. But I've looked high and low, and I can't find any place by that name.
Maybe your answer is waiting there, too.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: But... does such a place even exist?
It could be real.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: You always arrive at the perfect moment, my friend.
(Another story that feels familiar.)
(Still sounds made-up.)

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: But once that foe was vanquished, he returned that artifact to the sea.
(Yeah, he definitely made that up.)

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Now, please enjoy yourself to the fullest, my friend.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You've opened up another area?

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Of course. If happiness were a land locked away by the sea, we would sail across as explorers of a new world.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: My employer, Mr. Geisel, told me he once donned a straw hat and embarked on a great sea voyage. He and his crew crossed vast waters and brought justice to numerous islands. He boasted countless stories of those days.
(This is sounding way too familiar, too.)
(Sounds made-up.)

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: These two new areas are drawn directly from his stories.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: One displays the many weapons Mr. Geisel wielded on his adventures. The other is a crystal blue pool, where he often soaked and reminisced about his seafaring days.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Like that time he plunged into the sea and borrowed the sea stabilizer as his weapon.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Welcome, my friend. We've opened several new areas today. Please, explore at your leisure. I'm certain you'll find them worth your while.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: The moments you hold dear today may become your life's treasures. Have fun, and cherish every encounter.
Let's just wait here for now.
In the blink of an eye, the Lollo Logistics staff rush in, refurbishing the area completely. At the center of it all stands what looks like...
An Academy display booth.
And that's... my motorcycle?
Of course it is.
Feels like something's missing.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: You never fail to see right to the heart of a matter.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: This was where Mr. Geisel once kept his mount. Since his departure, it's been vacant. A trivial matter, perhaps, but the emptiness weighs on me.
There are no vacant display stands left at the Lollo Party.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Ah, your beloved ride. Such a unique, majestic design. It lends the whole place a new brilliance. I cannot thank you enough.
Just borrowing a parking spot.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Haha, rest assured, I'll keep it safe. I hear more of your friends have arrived. Please, do not let me keep you from them.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: And do not forget to savor the joy of collecting. At the Forever Fest, there's more to collect than just the tangible.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What are you looking at, Lumi?
So, everything here is just an illusion?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Aye, this place, these people, everything here is an illusion Mr. Copo created for Geisel. Later, when that lady came to the Forever Fest, she noticed that pigeon too.
She could tell it was an illusion.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Exactly. She wanted Geisel to cherish life's real, fleeting moments, rather than a false eternity. That's why she asked him to go with her to "where a river of stars falls."
Have you found that place?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: I've only heard a legend. They say that every year, on a certain night, people look up at the sky and witness the spectacle of stars falling.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: That lady must have wanted Geisel to witness the moment where a river of stars falls from the sky.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But why would Mr. Copo create this whole illusion for Geisel in the first place?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Hehe, about that... I think you'd better ask Mr. Copo himself.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh hi, {PlayerName}. I was just watchin' this pigeon.
A two-dimensional pigeon hovers quietly in an unnoticeable corner. It looks like...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like Mr. Copo's lapel pin.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Yes! I had the Pioneer Association do some diggin' for me. They told me there used to be a magician named Cobb Copo in Rinascita, and his most famous trick was creatin' illusions.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Apparently, at one of his fests, a boy saw right through his act. That boy's name was Geisel.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: They say that Geisel cracked the illusion when he noticed a two-dimensional pigeon that was obviously out of place.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Geisel, did you see that pigeon? This is all an illusion.

speaker: NPC #150106
anh_en: I know, but... I can always pretend it's real.

speaker: NPC #150106
anh_en: As long as I'm here, it feels like this fest could last forever.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Can a Forever Fest truly make you happy forever?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I don't believe moments of joy, or beauty, or excitement can even exist inside eternity.

speaker: Gleamtender

speaker: Gleamtender

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: How may I be of service, my friend?

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: So, I… No, the real Cobb Copo created the Forever Fest for him in this Sonoro. And I, too, am one of the illusions he conjured.

speaker: NPC #150105

(Ask about Geisel's Forte.)

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

A piece of cake.
This illusion itself.

speaker: NPC #150105
anh_en: Hahaha, I can see you are teasing me.

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

speaker: NPC #150105

A wondrous change seems to have taken place on the second floor of the Fest.

speaker: NPC #100204

speaker: NPC #750407

speaker: NPC #750407

speaker: NPC #750407

speaker: NPC #750408

speaker: NPC #750406
anh_en: We'd rather destroy everything than betray our vision!

speaker: NPC #750408

speaker: NPC #750406
anh_en: Of course, to us, money doesn't matter; we just want our stories to be heard.

anh_en: By the Sentinel, do you SEE that twisted model over there?

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Perfect.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: What do you think we should do, {PlayerName}?
Let's restore it to normal.
Let's go even weirder.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Got it. I'll handle it right away.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Oh, I see where this is going... Alright, lemme give it a little tweak...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: There are more shopkeepers now. You were hoping it would spark some healthy competition, but instead, they all started saying the exact same thing.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you study the odd tree, a strange thought crosses your mind, "If I had an axe, I could get a lot of wood…"

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The customers near the fruit stand have become even stranger... You decide it's best not to keep staring at them.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As the guardian of a vast land, surely, Jué won't mind a little joke like this, right?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Clang Bangs have reclaimed their shells. Though softened by the hot spring before, their icy exteriors, and even their hearts, froze over once more.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You stare at the towering snowman, only to find it staring back with Ku-Roro's eyes.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The "cleaner" swings a massive broom, sending dust swirling into the air. It's best not to stand too close...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The "gardener" keeps diligently watering the paper on the ground. His expression seems livelier now… maybe.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Ku-Roros who were listening have all turned into blank white cubes. Well… at least they don’t have to worry about losing their legs anymore.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Huh. Why is this tree... square? Looks like the texture mapping glitched out.
Hmm… Let's try another version.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Perfect.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Going full pixel forest? On it.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Switching back to normal trees? No problem.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: What do you think we should do, {PlayerName}?
The normal trees look more natural.
What if we made all the trees...

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Got it. I'll handle it right away.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Oh, I see where this is going... Alright, lemme give it a little tweak...
Bertolt makes some modifications based on your suggestion.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: All done, {PlayerName}. How's it looking now?
Looks great.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The oven Echo has shrunk even more. You figure that even if it baked pizzas nonstop for a whole month, it still wouldn't come close to satisfying your hunger.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It seems like everything's flipped on its head... but isn't this exactly what you wanted?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Tubpup dances gleefully in the air—or so it seems from your angle. Maybe it wouldn't hurt to hop in and join it?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Gondola has reached its maximum speed. Please proceed with caution. The Second Coming of Solaris is not liable for any damage incurred while operating this boat.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The elevator has been flipped. It still moves... but whether it'll take you to your desired destination is another matter.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You watch the giant fish rise into the sky and drift higher and higher... until it's just a distant speck. Then it's gone, swallowed by the edge of the world you know.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Plushie Squad, it's time to rock out!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The chair floats up into the sky, and the person sitting on it doesn't even flinch. For now, the laws of physics seem to have taken a break.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Wingray drop tower is all set! Go give it a shot!

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Looks like we've cleaned up all the bugs in this area… probably.
Any leads?

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Not yet. But this doesn't feel like just some harmless prank.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: I'll ask the other designers to look for signs of the intruder in other areas of the Second Coming of Solaris.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: We might still need your help, though. Thanks again, {PlayerName}. Until next time.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cats, one and all... Bear witness!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The colossal Echo watches your every move… It's preparing to vanish the moment you draw near.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Red! Horn! Three times faster! It's the most powerful Echo!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Huh? Don't all of you talk at once. I can't make sense of it...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why haven't the bird eggs gone on sale yet...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Who am I supposed to buy from?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What's wrong with this tree? Did something infest it or make it sick?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: One leaf... Two leaves...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Something ain't right! I'd better get someone who knows their stuff to take a look...

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: So, what do you think, {PlayerName}? Nice view, right?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: An in-game resort... But can that really help with burnout?

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Honestly? I'm not sure. As the guy who designed it, it's hard to find any magic here. Nothing beats the feeling of actually traveling.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Now every time I come here, it just feels like I'm back at work. Haha…
That's kinda depressing.
That's life for you.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Ahem. Anyway, emotional overshare over. Moving on.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: There are probably some more bugs around here. Please help me find them.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Just like before, snap any weird stuff with the Zoom Camera, and I'll take care of the rest.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Yeah, but… it feels kinda familiar?

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: Familiar? Bingo.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: A few months back, I worked myself into the ground. Overtime every day for a whole month...

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: When it was finally over, a colleague told me I should take a break at Mt. Firmament. You know, mountains, snow, hot springs... the whole package.
Sounds refreshing.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: It really was. Watching the mountains stretch on forever... Felt like the wind blew all the stress right out of me.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: When I got back, we recreated the whole thing for the game. Figured players might want a chill spot too.

speaker: NPC #750175
anh_en: The breeze here feels just like the real place. Hot springs too... We spent a good week designing new environment simulation add-ons for them.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: Rongqing has told me some about this book.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: It has a short flowering season, making it unsuitable for <ano=Bonsai>Penjing</ano>. So we usually don't sell them here. But Verina happened to drop by a few days ago and gave me a few.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: I'll give one to you if you need it.
Thank you, Grandma Lin!

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: You're welcome. Just drop by anytime.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: I can't say I have much experience with stuff like this... I'm just too old for a packed page...
I can read the pages to you if you like.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: You're so sweet. Just tell me if you want to buy some <ano=Bonsai>Penjing</ano>. I'm giving you discounts!
Anything similar to what's described in the novel?

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: Well, you certainly can't expect a potted plant to look nearly as impressive as an actual sea of flowers.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: But I guess a luxuriant pot of irises may capture the feel.

speaker: Speaker_786_Title
anh_en: It originates from Whining Aix's Mire and its flower language is fragile, untold affections. Romantic, isn't it?
Do you sell it here?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It's beautiful. Thank you for the work. I'll hand it over to the dev team.

anh_en: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

anh_en: See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

anh_en: Sorry, my bad... This is one of my favorite bits so I got carried away.

anh_en: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.

anh_en: In this chapter, our protagonist paid a visit to a mystic island.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It goes: "The autumn seemed to be permanent here. Leaves and foliage were bathed in burning gold..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: As the sea breeze gently met the shore, a golden shower fell upon our shoulders...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: For once, I caught a whiff of fragrance in the fallen leaves... It was only many years later that I realized it had been a kind of <color=highlight>golden insect</color> hidden in camouflage in those leaves.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The insect served as a metaphor by the author for the following plots.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: What's more. At the end of this chapter, the elders of the island would use this insect to—
No spoilers!
I want to see it myself when the game comes online.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: An entomologist... I have no clues.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Maybe you should go to the pond. Some kids are frequently seen catching flies there.

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: Do {Male=you;Female=you} like these bugs too?

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: Take a look, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. We had it in the shrubs.

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: It feeds on honey and smells sweet just like the kind of candy Daddy would treat us to.
It's so beautiful!
May I have it?
Hehe, I kid you not!

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: Of course! But promise me to come over to play hide-and-seek with us!
Sure thing.
I'm quite the expert at this.
Daddy taught us tricks. You can't mess around!

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: Please accept the butterfly. And don't forget your promise!

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: No, Mingming. {Male=He;Female=She} needs you to answer a question.

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: Until then!

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: Hide-and-seek! Hide-and-seek!

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: Daddy has told us stories about it. The legend of a hero! Do you still remember?

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: Oh, I know! And a hero and a big bad guy, the Hatless, right?!
I don't think so...
The Hatless, the big villain!

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: So, {Male=you;Female=you} are looking for the insect in the book, right?

speaker: Doudou
anh_en: A golden fly that smells sweet... Sounds like the yellow butterfly we caught today.

speaker: Minh Minh
anh_en: A giant yellow butterfly! Just show {Male=him;Female=her} what we get!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The bug does have elegant patterns. Thank you for your efforts. I'll deliver it to the dev team.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It will contribute a lot to the building of the island.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Ever heard of Second Coming of Solaris before, {PlayerName}?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It rivets nearly all the attention of our editors from the headquarters.
They all enjoy reading fiction?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Of course not... Some swooped in only to try to find the trick to write a top seller.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: But I can't deny that it's the best piece of work among all the candidates in recent years.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I was taken on an epic adventure through the protagonist while I was reading Second Coming of Solaris...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Oh, I got carried away. Let's turn back to our topic. {PlayerName}, we hope you could lend us some help.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The Pioneer Association has reached an agreement on developing a game franchise based on Second Coming of Solaris and the production of the game is already underway.
A spin-off game!
When is it expected to be released?

anh_en: The development is still at a very early stage. The basic framework is complete, but we're still working on the production of a huge body of art assets.
Nope.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The dev team is still struggling to find a creative direction that enables them to recapture the grandeur of the world in the novel.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: In our meeting yesterday, a few colleagues mentioned that a well-traveled guest had just arrived in Jinzhou... that is what brought me to you.
Do I get an early access to the game as a perk?
But I've never read it before...
Of course, we'll let you know whenever there's progress in the game.
It's okay. I'll describe to you in detail the related scenes in the novel when you need me to.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Simply put, all you need to do is find us some real-world references that fit the descriptions in the novel.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: With these references, the developers can have a general picture of what the in-game world should look like.
Any rewards for this job?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: You don't need to worry about that. We have a deep budget for the game and you'll be well compensated for your efforts.
A new periodical by the Pioneer Association?
I'm in.
Don't forget to include me in the credits.
Of course. If this goes smoothly, the name of {PlayerName} may appear on our "Special Thanks" list.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let's begin with today's job if you're ready.
A new merch by the Pioneer Association?
So you don't know about it?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Oh, that's not my job. Periodicals and merchandise are only sold at Ganxue's shop.
But how come you don't know about this book?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Second Coming of Solaris... It's the fiction that everyone's talking about across Huanglong. It has been a bestseller for three weeks in a row!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Its author, Karl, is from the New Federation. It's his debut work and he's already been named one of the top-earning writers in recent years with this single book.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let me explain our job today.
I see.
Maybe I have read this book after all.
Really? We must have made a wise decision to pick you as our exclusive consultant.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: So you know the story.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: We want something to help the dev team to picture the image of the Crownless.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: In this chapter, the true identity of the protagonist's nemesis is finally revealed.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: According to the book, it's "...a towering figure with rough edges like a statue..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: An aura of brilliant stars surrounded this <color=highlight>Crownless King</color> like loyal courtiers...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It nearly compelled me to bow down... I gathered all my strength from falling on my knees...
The Crownless?!
The Hatless, the big villain!
Where did you learn that name?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Second Coming of Solaris has received overwhelming favor for this part. Fans of this book call this mighty figure The Crownless.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: A ferocious opponent... The Crownless... Maybe you should ask someone who frequents the danger zone?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Xianchen over there is an experienced Pioneer explorer. If you need help, how about asking her?

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: I've read Second Coming of Solaris. A good piece of work, I'd admit... But I've never finished it.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: This is something I brought from the Tacet Field back in those days. Just take a look at this ominous structure. It's too weird to be a natural formation.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: If you're after something related to monsters, just take this.
Are you really okay with that?
I can feel it's important to you.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: Don't take it to your heart. Life is much better when you don't have to handle those Tacet Discords.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: But it does remind me of those young Pioneer reporters. They can risk everything for a field trip about Tacet Discords. I can't help but worry about them.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: Wait, no. Let's continue this topic next time. I'm off to talk to Zhuyi about his dangerous field trip...
May I ask why?

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: Because it makes me sweat bullets when reading the portrayal of the monsters.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: Those monsters in the book... They must be the Tacet Discords.
Do they really look that scary?
I fight Tacet Discords a lot.
Yes, they do.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: *sigh* I ventured into Tacet Fields a lot when I was young, wishing to get some first-hand reports about Tacet Discords.

speaker: Tiêm Thần
anh_en: But my adventure was cut short by an accident, where I was heavily injured by Tacet Discords. After that, I decided to leave the field and work for the support staff.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: How peculiar... I'll hand it over to the dev team right now. Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I believe the team would have a much more vivid picture of the protagonist's first encounter with the Crownless.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

anh_en: So you know the name? Many take "Big Brother" as a nickname for the Crownless.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Anyway, let's call it a day. See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

anh_en: Anyway, please pick a suitable dish as a reference for our dev team.

anh_en: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.

anh_en: This chapter recounts how the protagonist met their destined companions for the first time.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It goes: "The most reliable way to find you a reliable teammate is not through good vibes but a good fight."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: And when you're concerned about mutual faith, ask for a bowl of <color=highlight>hot soup</color> when you suffer hunger and cold in the wilderness.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: During such a hard time, someone offered a bowl of hot soup to our protagonist.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I would remember it for the rest of my life if I were the protagonist.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: What kind of food do you think would work best in such a scenario, {PlayerName}?
A bowl of hot congee.
A bowl of meat soup.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Well, Panhua's Restaurant is definitely one of the must-haves in Jinzhou.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you need to learn about foods, I suggest you ask for Panhua's advice.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Though I've never read the book, the story certainly feels close to home!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Hehe, right? A stew of meat and vegetables always serves the best when you're hungry!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Oh, don't forget your urgent errands. Let's continue our food conversation next time. I still have a few dishes to serve.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: You can drop by for a slow enjoyable meal when available. I'll cook for you!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: I remember back when I was young and my family was struggling to make ends meet, I could nibble on a plain flatbread that the kind old man of the village gave me to get me through the day.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Perhaps it was these days that nurtured my love for cooking.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: What could be happier than to please your guests with all your cooking skills?

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Speaking of which, here is a specialty I made just now.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: It's called Jinzhou Stew, General Jiyan's favorite food of all time.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: It's also a taste from their childhood for many in Jinzhou
It certainly uses many ingredients.
It looks delicious.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It smells good... I'll hand it over to the dev team right now. Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It should be the ideal food to signify their first encounter.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let me explain our job today.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Well, that local drink will suffice.

anh_en: According to the book, "the cries of peddlers fill the market... a bewildering array of goods lines the shelves of every shop..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: We had a taste of a <color=highlight>local drink</color> served by the hotel. I was caught by total relief though my tongue stung a bit from that bitterness...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Even on such foreign land, we feel safe and sound... We stayed there for three days to restore our strengths before we reluctantly said goodbye to this city.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: This Tiancheng here is so much alike to Jinzhou.

anh_en: Anyway, let's call it a day. See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

anh_en: Indeed. The black clouds had an overwhelming presence as they had swallowed the glow of the moon and minerals.

anh_en: Samples of Mithrill will help improve the mental image of this chapter, I believe.
