speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: In this chapter, they ventured all the way to the North and reached Mt. Moore, preparing to meet the final enemy.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Before their enemy showed up, the air of Mt. Moore had already chilled the protagonist to the bone.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It goes: "...Obscuring the moonlight, <color=highlight>black clouds</color> even made the <color=highlight>Mithril</color> on the hills lose its sheen..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Everything seemed to be flowing, filling my lungs like condensed ink. As I took my breaths, I was dragged into darkness further.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: This part can never cease to impress me with the howling sense of despair, even after all of my repeated readings.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I can't help but wonder, what would induce such a sensational scene? And this Mithrill... what does it look like?
We need a reference for this.
It says it shines bright like the moon.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Well, maybe you should ask the owner of Huaipu Mining Firm. He is a knowledgeable mineral expert.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Since it's about the Mithril, I suggest you go ask for his advice.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: Second Coming of Solaris? I could spare little interest for these casual reads of you youngsters...

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: What a coincidence. I happen to keep a Lampylumen remnant left by the previous guest.
Brilliant!
May I have it?

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: The Lampylumen is a specialty mineral only found in the caves of the Panyan mountains.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: But if it's useful to you, I'll not reserve it.
Thank you, Mr. Owner!

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: You're welcome, hehe! Business is all about honesty and I'd like to maintain a good relationship with my customers.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: Do remember to come over next time! Huaipu Mining Firm has the best mineral salt and petrolatum.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: Take it. I know you have a busy schedule today.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: ...though I do know a thing about this Mithril.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: A translucent mineral called Lampylumen would produce an azure shine that makes it even brighter in the dark.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: I'm assuming the Mithril probably originates from the Lampylumen.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: You've mentioned its writer, Karl, right? I would like to have a little chat with a mineral expert like him.
I don't know if it's possible.
He is out far in the New Federation now.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: *sigh* What a shame... As you get older, you'd realize how hard it is to meet someone who shares your passion.
Anyway, do you have some Lampylumens available?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Wow. This mineral surely fits the depiction of the Mirthril. I'll hand it over to the dev team right now!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: When the black clouds veil the moon... This is the perfect trigger!
Some time passed while Maqi was away to hand over the item...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let me explain our job today.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It marks the climax of the first chapter. I have the same exciting feeling as you. I wonder what it would be like in our game.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: But with one issue remaining: What exactly is this <color=highlight>Burning Jade</color>?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Though it appears in the previous chapters before, the writer has omitted the description of its shape and appearance.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: To reproduce the showdown, we're gonna need a reference for it.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Coming to the end of this chapter, the protagonist engaged in a showdown with the Crownless.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It goes: "...We compromised to the overwhelming darkness... Sword and spear, wand and gem, all had shattered like broken pieces..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: We stared at the night, almost covered by the rising Crownless... Its gaze pieced like a razor...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: ...We cannot retreat, even wielding the <color=highlight>Burning Jade</color> as our only weapon...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: ...March till the end if you're lost in the wild. Rip the moon apart if it fails to shine.
This makes my adrenaline race.
I can't wait to see this in the game.
You should add grand music here.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you ask me, there is a clue you can get from one book fan.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: We all can tell his passion for Second Coming of Solaris, but that doesn't make our conversations easier.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: However, I have the feeling that you can understand him.
I'll go find him.
Well, I happen to speak the language of these geeks.
Though I'm not sure if Riddler is the right word, you seem pretty confident in this.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Then I'll entrust you to this.
May I ask for a name?
Where is our book fan, then?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: His name is Xieyang, often seen around the Jinzhou Institute during the daytime.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: He has a reservoir of ideas for this book, generous in providing suggestions. But...
But...?
Is he a difficult guy?
His words are usually saddled with riddles.
No, he is easy to get along with. But his words are usually saddled with riddles...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Drinks that will prevail on foreign taste buds... Maybe I should do a street interview with those visitors?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The Pioneer Merchandises have been Ganxue's staple. Many visitors bring one of those back as a gift.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: That would be a good idea that you ask Ganxue about their comments on Jinzhou.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: The Crownless's tyranny rules the failing moon...

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Because it's the key to turn the tide in the incredible final showdown!

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: A precious of such eminence will not tolerate any plain mold in this world.
Then where can I find a reference?
Enlighten me, please.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Such nerve... Fine, I'll tell you. Only in the ever-changing Sonoro Sphere could you find a substantial copy of this Burning Jade.
The Sonoro Sphere...
You really know a thing or two!

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: But it's a piece of cake for a No.1 book fan. I've prepared what you want.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Now, I can give this precious item to you, if you wish.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: But with one condition.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: ...while civilization stems from the silent Burning Jade...
What condition?
Do tell me, please.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: I want you to ask Maqi to... add my name to the Special Thanks list.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: How can I remain anonymous as the No.1 fan of this book?
Leave it to me.
Only the Pioneer Association can decide.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Just... do your best. Success only comes after you give it a go!
I'll help.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Here, have it. And don't forget your promise!
Impressive speech!
I don't understand a word...

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Finally! Someone reaches out to ask me, the most loyal fan of Second Coming of Solaris...

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Only the expansive world in the book can match my incessant stream of creativity and overflowing talents for verses...
What's this Burning Jade in your mind?

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: I know you'll come to me for this, from the moment you joined this project.
How can you know?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I see. It matches the image of the Burning Jade in my head.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I'll deliver it to the dev team. They will need it for the last scene.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: All chapters of Tiancheng have been completed.
Mr. Karl also expressed his appreciation for your help in the game development.
I can't tell. You could ask him when you meet him.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Anyway, our job is done here. But...
But...?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The references you brought in made our developers' lives much easier. They would like to come to you for more of this kind of favors. What would you say?
Sure.
As long as you pay.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: No worries. The Pioneer Association will pay you in full if you agree to help.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Well, until we meet again, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The Pioneer Association would like to thank you for your continued support, {PlayerName}.
I love the design of the scenes.
Hope it will release soon.
Same here.
Same here. I'll let you know if we have any progress.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: By the way, Mr. Karl has heard stories about this. He would like to meet you if possible.
It's my honor.
I guess he's prepared a special gift for me.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Among all the drinks in Jinzhou, I like tea the most.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: ...which is also the perfect match for what's in Second Coming of Solaris. Its taste is bitter but persistent on your tongue.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Tea is also the most popular seller here in my shop.
Could I have one pack of tea?

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: By all means. That's also our greeting to visitors of Jinzhou.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Here. Remember to boil it with spring water. That makes the tea even better!

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: We look forward to meeting you again. Goodbye.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Enjoying a cup of tea over chitchats in an inn... Seeing the steam of hot tea does make it more vivid.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: This would be what our dev team needs. I even can picture the lively Tiancheng right now.
Some time passed while Maqi was away to hand over the item...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let me explain our job today.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Anyway, we need the reference for the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color> to create the valley according to this chapter.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: In this chapter, they passed right by a valley on their way to Mt. Moore.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: It goes: "We ventured through the valley as the night fell..."

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: In the sole darkness of night, the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color> seemed to fall noir... Pressed between petals and leaves, we walked as clothes uttered gentle friction...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Pale and silent as it was, the night permitted our disturbing existence. No, I heard murmurs upon the waves, saying O travelers O winds..."
I could feel the tranquility.
A relaxing scene, as it is.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Yes. I find inner peace in this.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: But to think of what comes after this chapter, I slow down my pace...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Speaking of the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color>, I do visit Bogu's Arbor around the business area when off shift.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you want to inquire about something related to plants, you can ask Grandma Lin, the owner there, for some information.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: {PlayerName}... I-I think I just saw someone else's dream.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Um... t-thank you... It makes me really happy to hear that, b-but... I don't know how to respond...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I've probably taken up too much of your time. Please, take this painting with you.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Even if it was just a dream, it holds a lot of my feelings... a-and I want to share them with you.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It was in a small, dim room. A child, with her parents watching so warmly, blew out the candles on a tiny cake... and smiled.
You seem a bit moved.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes... It was such a simple, ordinary moment, but it felt so full of happiness.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Maybe I had moments like that when I was little too.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But I can't remember anymore... I've gotten so used to being alone. And in my dreams, my parents always seem so... stern, so far away.
You've always been strong.
But you're not alone anymore.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: N-no... I'm not strong... but if that's how you see me, I-I'll try to live up to your expectations.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Ah, you're here. Speaking of which, I've stumbled upon quite a few... intriguing nightmares lately.
You've sacrificed a lot.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe, trying to console me, are you, darling? Playing these sinister roles is simply part of the game. It's only natural that I appear in their nightmares.
But I see the real you—not the masks you wear.
I always see you as who you are.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You certainly know what to say, don't you?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Then come closer. I want to reward you with... a memory that tingles just right.
Seriously? Intriguing for nightmares?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes. I encountered different dreamers, but they all feared the same figure—though her appearance varied from one dream to the next.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Sometimes she appeared as a stern office worker, sometimes a lowlife street thug, and other times... a lone Exile wandering the wilds.
Ah, I see. That person... it was you, wasn't it?
Those were criminals' nightmares about you, right?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Well, I rarely reveal myself during a mission, but it's amusing when the "lucky few" get a glimpse.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: If they're haunted by a little... trauma, it might make them hesitate the next time they think of causing trouble.
But you don't seem happy.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I didn't expect to cross paths with you here, {PlayerName}.
Let go of your responsibilities! You're in a dream!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But aren't you working just as hard to protect what you hold dear?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: This ear of millet... it holds deep meaning for me, but now, I'd like you to have it. May everything go smoothly for you on your journey.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: This place... it's quite amazing. As I walked through, I felt as if I was drifting between past memories and, at times, into the fantasies of others.
We're in the dreamscape.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I see. That would explain a lot.
Is something troubling you?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Dreams always stir mixed emotions in me. For a long time, I was plagued by nightmares.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Sleepless nights filled with images of my people displaced, shivering in the cold, and facing hunger. We were all so small before the might of the Lament.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Yet, those nightmares serve as a constant reminder of the complex challenges our people face, the burdens I bear as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
It's okay to take a rest sometimes.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: So, it really is you. I owe you my gratitude.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Yet, ever since we've crossed paths, I haven't been haunted by them again.
That dream will never become reality.
If you ever falter, I'll stand beside you and support you.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Thank you... If you're heading to somewhere perilous, take this lance.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: May it grant you safe passage through every trial, and may it help you prevail the lasting night.
For...?
What happened?

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I was trapped in yet another endless dream, fighting Tacet Discords alone. No matter how many I vanquished, they continued to rise.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: The voices of the fallen cursed my every step, assailing my spirit. Yet, amidst the chaos, a radiant, golden light broke through the darkness.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: It was fleeting, but soon after, you appeared.
But I didn't do anything.
You're the one who endured to the end.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Before, such dreams felt eternal, persisting until I awoke.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Ah... that is reminiscing

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's behind me now. Look at me, healthy and well, am I not?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: When peace is finally enjoyed across the land, no one will have to starve as I once did.
When we wake, let's go grab a meal together.
I'll treat you to a feast in reality.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hehe, I won't say no to that. Then, it's a promise.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Here, take this journal. It contains some recommendations. I hope you find it useful.
What happened?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I just had a dream from my past.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Simple dishes—plain noodles and soft steamed buns—but even in the dream, they appeared irresistible.
Really?
Steamed buns and noodles?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Surprised? In my childhood, I wandered the streets, often plagued by hunger. Each time I passed a restaurant or a food stall, my steps felt heavier.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Back then, all I longed for was a decent meal—so much so that it echoed even in my dreams.
That must have been tough for you.
Let's explore more of the world together.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Indeed, our connection will only grow stronger.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Let these bright stars guide you on your journey.
Anything to share with me?
What happened?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Listen.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You faintly hear the sounds of waves crashing against the shore—they seem distant, yet stirring emotions within you.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Those sounds always take me back to the moments we shared—bathed in soft moonlight, with fine sand beneath us, and the rhythm of your breath and heartbeat filling the air.
You really cherish those memories, don't you?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: ...It reassured me that I have indeed kept our memories for you.
We'll create even more memories together.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you're finally here.
Are you really Encore's Cosmos?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Of course I... Wait, why that look?
Where did you learn about the Black Shores and Encore?
Why do I have to do it?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: I-I… Please, {PlayerName}, I have no one else to turn to. What can I do to make you accept? I'll do anything within my power.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: How serious are you about that?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: I've got a ton of rewards ready for you, {PlayerName}. My entire collection is all yours if you complete the experiment!

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: You want "Astrites," {PlayerName}, don't you?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmph.
Keep talking.
Cosmos? Why are you alone here?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: There are only two simple rules: One, <color=Highlight>protect the experiment device on the other side of the gate from being destroyed</color>. Two, <color=Highlight>eliminate all the Tacet Discords there</color>.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Oh, and to ensure the success of the experiment, you'll also get my special <color=Highlight>Echoids</color>.
That's all?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: That's all! Please, {PlayerName}, without you, I'll...
I'll think over.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Thank you! Please let me know when you're ready. We can do this any time!

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Use the Echoids against the TDs, for our cause!

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Ms. Encore has been preoccupied with numerous other matters recently. Therefore, I, the Black Wooly, will temporarily serve as your business representative in her stead.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: We invite you to participate in an experiment for our corporation this time.
You talk in a suspicious way.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Ahem, I um...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Did you say experiment? What experiment?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: It's a stability test of the dream links. This is the entrance to the experiment zone. You will conduct the testing on the other side, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I smell something fishy about his offer.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Now all the experiments have concluded! Thank you so much.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: That's why I hate sharp people...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: What were you murmuring about?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Now you have all the rewards I promised and you must be tired after all these battles so maybe you should get some rest oh and I still got something to attend to so bye!
Cosmos dashes through the gate at an astonishing speed.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, stay there!
Knock

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Darn it. This guy only ever thinks of himself, doesn't he?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: He didn't even try to learn more about the one he pretends to be. Why the effort?
To divert our attention.
To cover his true identity.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Geez. Finally done.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I don't get it, but I think you're saying that this guy is doing something bad to pose as a member of the Black Shores, right?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmph. We'll make him talk when we catch him.
This gate looks even more familiar to me now.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I feel you. It looks just like the gate to Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I think we deserve an explanation.

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Somnoire? Sorry, not my thing.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: You're not deceiving me!
You just said "Somnoire," didn't you?
What are your motives behind all this?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Hello, Hello! I'm here! Hello?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Hi? Hello? I'm RIGHT HERE, can you see me?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: Excuse me? See me here?

speaker: NPC #700068
anh_en: (Should've got something bigger from the dream...)

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Still clinging to those obscure words?... Indeed, things remain a riddle.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Only by going through those doors, into the depths of these orderless dreams, can you reach the truth.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: When you're in a dream, dream on until you get the answer.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Look forward to dreaming with you again next time...

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Sails of the departed drift on and on, souls above the clouds, hearts claimed by the sea...

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: When you spend days, weeks, maybe even years adrift, loneliness creeps in and twists despair into something monstrous. And yet, when you see a flicker of light out there—something you dare call "hope"…

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: That's when people stop thinking straight.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is this from someone from the Fool's Troupe?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: No, it was someone who's long gone now.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: He died ten years ago in a shipwreck. I wasn't there to see it happen, and his face has almost faded from my memory. But...
But?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: On my last voyage, I saw him. He was on another ship. A lively one if I might add. I could hear the laughter and clink of glasses.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hold on. Didn't you just say it's rare to see anything living on the sea?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Exactly. That's what makes it unusual. When I saw him, he looked just as he was all those years ago, not a single day older. And in that moment, everything I'd forgotten about him came rushing back.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you saying… he might still be alive?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Oh, hello, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Surviving ten years on the sea, without even a scratch? What do you think, {PlayerName}? How likely is that?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Almost impossible, right? My thoughts exactly.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Yet when the light of "hope" is right in front of you, you can't help but chase after it. No matter how violent the waves or impossible the odds, you have to see it for yourself.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Sadly, when we got closer, Battier and Brant reported back the waters were teeming with Tacet Discords.
If another ship were to stumble across that area…

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: It would end badly. No doubt about it.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: That's why I need your help, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: I'll admit, this seems more of a personal request from my side. But when you're out there dealing with those Tacet Discords or trying to find the man, regardless of the results your safety comes above all else.
What does this man look like?
Is that one of your new songs?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: He had the same blue hair and eyes as me. He used to call it the color of the sea, a blessing from the ocean itself.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: After he died, I stopped believing in nonsense like these. Most sailors still prefer to hold onto their superstitions though, as a way to boost their spirits before heading off to sea.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I wish you safety... and the best of luck.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: It is... this one came from a rather unusual experience.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Tell me, {PlayerName}. What do you think of the sea?
Why do you ask?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Someone once said the sea is a city of the dead. You can hear the endless cries of the wind and waves, but never the voice of anything living.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: {PlayerName}, welcome back. How did it go out there?
So these waters… is a trap. The TDs are luring people in.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: I believe so. And the longer those monsters are left unchecked, the more lives they'll claim.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: I'd like to ask another favor of you, though I understand you've got plenty of other tasks to tend to...
I do have a lot going on.
But it's not like I can't make time.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: I've learnt about your reputation of being quite a busy person. So don't feel pressured in taking on the task. Feel free to come by whenever you have the time to spare. I'll think of other ways to handle it in the meantime.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: That said... I do prefer that you make use of that time on some relaxation.
Are you planning on a reward for me?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Of course, if that's what you hope for. I do not want anyone else to have to experience the loss of hope any longer.
The place was overrun with Tacet Discords.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Don't worry. I've made my peace with the idea that he did die ten years ago. Maybe that's not such a bad thing after all.

anh_en: Maybe that's what the "unknown variable" in your model really represents.

anh_en: ...Very well, this is somewhat inspiring. But fundamentally, even if this theory is sound, this so-called "human factor" cannot even be quantified...

speaker: NPC #750088

anh_en: Oh, to watch my opponents' carefully designed strategies and decks walk right into my calculations, like bugs caught in a spider's web, helplessly awaiting their doom...

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: It's a victory for mathematics! It's exhilarating!

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: I have zero interest in disbanding any club. But Professor Calith promised that if I worked with him, I'd have no shortage of powerful duelists wanting to challenge me...

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: ...Unless... {PlayerName}, you're the one... Could this be what Mornye was talking about?

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: To be honest, he wasn't wrong. But out of all the challengers, only our duel was brilliantly satisfying.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: This feeling of giving it your all, only to come up just short... it hurts, but it's not the worst, huh?

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Perhaps. Well then, my mathematical models need some modifications. Until next time, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: ...A tiny deviation, given enough calculations, can completely overwrite the expected future state.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Just like that variable I couldn't account for in my proposed model.

speaker: NPC #700244

Calculations can't determine the future.

anh_en: Up next, the final duel with Professor Calith.

anh_en: I'd better go discuss our options with Anita first, just to be safe.

anh_en: And this is...

speaker: NPC #700246

anh_en: Don't get cocky, Chessa! {PlayerName} here just beat Professor Dennis and Professor Festa!

anh_en: This is really annoying. So... {PlayerName}, how do you stack up? Guess you're now No. 2, and Anita is No. 1...

anh_en: ...Fine, fine. I'm No. 3. There, I said it. Happy now?

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Alright then, {PlayerName}, the new No. 2... I challenge you to a duel.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Huff... Sorry. That's it, kid. Match over.
I accept.
Let's make this quick.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: Tch... It'll take more than that to beat Anita!

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: ...W-What should we do... Even Olof lost to her...

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: ...Excuse me, but is Anita around? Am I allowed to challenge her now?

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: So tired. Let's just get this over with already... The sooner this is handled, the sooner I can get some rest.
What's happening? And who are these two?

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}! You're finally back!

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: This is Olof. He's the strongest duelist in the fan club, after Anita.
You lost, Chessa.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: He wanted me to play against this fan club. I figured it'd be a good way to pay him back too.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Sigh... If I'd known it'd be this much of a hassle, I would've just looked the other way. But since I lost, guess I wasn't cut out for it. He can't complain.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: ...H-Hassle? Don't you have any interest in Peaks of Prestige at all?

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Of course not. I hate anything that requires effort. And I'm always getting dragged into errands by my boss or some professor.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: If the Academy were under attack by Voidworms or a TD outbreak, I'd gladly put my life on the line to protect everyone.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: But this kind of meaningless scut work? No thanks.
...Thanks for your, uh, hard work.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Don't mention it... Well, I'd better get going. Bye-bye.
Chessa turns and walks away. You can almost see the weight of this meaningless task lifting from her shoulders with every step she takes.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Phew... Finally. My job here is done.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Olof...?

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: Oh, I'm fine. Well done, {PlayerName}. Thanks for helping our fan club.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: Haha, who knew there was a hidden powerhouse like you at the Academy?

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: But that's not to say you can slack off. I may not be strong enough to beat you now, but one day, I'm taking back the title of No.2!
I look forward to it.
Don't expect me to go easy on you.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: By the way, Anita said she'd go find Professor Calith to arrange the final showdown.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Understood. I'll head over right away.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Good luck, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: That's it for me. Bye-bye, everyone.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: ...Wait!

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Huh? We don't have some complicated beef or anything... I was just backup Calith called in.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Owed him a small favor, and now we're square. Come on, just let me go.

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: I have to know... how did you get so strong? What's your secret?

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Huh? Nothing special, really. I was on shift when I ran into Calith, and it looked like something was bugging him. I asked out of curiosity.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Next thing I know, he's insisting I play Peaks of Prestige with him. After one game, he said I was a natural. Haha... do I look like a natural to you?

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: What was that about...? What does being a natural even mean?

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: I practice every single day... wracking my brain thinking of how to be a better duelist...

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: I thought it was my DESTINY to defeat the professors and save the club... But what's the point of all my effort... compared to natural talent?

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: And the worst part... she doesn't even care about Peaks of Prestige! I lost to someone like that...

speaker: NPC #700245
anh_en: ...No. I can't fall apart. I am... No, I was the club's No. 2...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Doesn't seem to be a good time to talk to him right now. Maybe I should give him some space.)

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}. There you are.
...There might be more to it than meets the eye.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Maybe... Well, that's all I know about Professor Calith. So, what do you say, {PlayerName}? Ready to duel?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Better safe than sorry. Let me know when you're ready.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Let's do this, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: The final showdown is about to begin. Are you ready?
I want to know more about Calith.
Not yet.
I'm ready.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: To be honest, I don't know much either. I've never dueled him myself. I've only heard stories... they say he's on another level.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: But he seems to really hate Peaks of Prestige. He's publicly announced that it's just a game for kids, and that it's dangerously addictive.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I admit, he's a good professor... Students think his lectures are fun, and he's surprisingly approachable. He can make even the most complex topics feel simple.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: But when it comes to this fan club, it's like he turns into a totally different person.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Anita. {PlayerName}. You're here.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: But...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Enough wasting time. We can discuss this after the duel.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: ...Fine by me. Then let the duel—BEGIN!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: The application to disband your fan club is nearing final approval. As agreed, defeat me, and I'll withdraw it.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: And if I win... Heh. Well, I doubt you'll be fortunate enough to find another club member who can best me.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: ...Heh, I have complete confidence in {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Very well. I have confidence in myself as well—I will disband your fan club.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Professor Calith, why exactly are you doing this...?

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...I won't deny it. I am biased against Peaks of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: It's because I witnessed an immensely talented, brilliant person go down a self-destructive path because of it.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: I will not allow such a thing to happen to any student at this Academy ever again.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Excuse me, fellow student!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Can I interest you in our fan club?

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...Well done, {PlayerName}. I admit defeat.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Don't let his carefree act fool you. He was once a brilliant student. He was the one who should've ended up at the Academy, not me.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Though I hate to admit it, before he threw it all away, he was considered a genius by many...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Top marks without even trying. The teachers always praised him for it.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: As for me... No matter how hard I tried, I was always regarded as someone standing in his shadow.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: But it wasn't supposed to be like that! He was meant to be my rival! The one I would eventually surpass and defeat!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: I spent all my days studying, pushing myself to beat him in exams and prove to everyone that I was the most outstanding student!
That's good, right?
A little rivalry is good, I guess.
That seems a bit extreme.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...Just when I was on the verge of finally surpassing him, he just... dropped out of school!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: As agreed, I will withdraw the application to disband the fan club. But for your own good, and for the Academy's... I urge you to stop playing that cursed game.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: He said he was going back to Septimont to "pursue his real passion." That bastard... it meant he'd remain undefeated forever!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: If only he'd waited another month... No, another week! I could've shown everyone what defeat looked like on him!
I don't see how Furius was "indulging in pleasure."
I don't see who Furius betrayed.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: You must be joking... Furius dropped out to create that Peaks of Prestige, did he not?!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: I will never accept that! It's a betrayal of his academic potential... How infuriating that his silly game managed to become a success, too!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: That guy... I thought becoming a professor here would finally make him see me as an equal, but he never took me seriously. Not once...

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem... I think I understand now. So you're that "dear friend and rival" Furius has mentioned before...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...What?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Just a sec, let me find that interview Furius gave in Septimont...
What exactly happened in the past?
Anita projects a video showing Furius.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: How did I come up with Peaks of Prestige? Haha... I owe it all to a dear friend and rival of mine.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: I'll keep his name a secret, but back in school, I had this very serious friend, a real perfectionist.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: I actually got the inspiration for Peaks of Prestige during a tactical simulation practice with him.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: He kept launching these fierce Echo attacks against my defenses. I was exhausted just trying to hold the line. But looking back now... that can be quite fun, agreed?

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: Haha... That was just one of many moments between us. He was always so driven. How could I afford to fall behind?

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: In fact, without the pressure he put on me, the constant criticism and praise, I probably would've started slacking off a long time ago. He always did call me out for being so nonchalant, hehe...
The projection ends. Calith's face is a mask of stunned disbelief.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Wait... Was that really Furius? No, that infuriating grin... that was definitely him.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I don't know what exactly happened between you two... But I don't think Furius ever looked down on you.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Right, Professor Calith, you said you knew someone who threw it all away for this game...?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: It's clear that your dedication and hard work put a lot of pressure on him. He must have been working hard in secret too... He just never showed it.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Tsk, I knew it... He may look like a slacker, but he was grinding behind my back all along. So he wasn't just some natural talent who didn't need to try...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Fine! Once I get the chance, I'm going straight to Septimont. I'll use his own Peaks of Prestige to beat him at his own game, and make him admit defeat to my face!

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...Yes. The man who threw away his future, betrayed his studies, and neglected his responsibilities, all to indulge in pleasure...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Is none other than the man calling himself the founder of Peaks of Prestige, Furius!
What...?
You're kidding, right?

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: It's the truth. We went to school together... long before I ever came to this Academy.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Good work, {PlayerName}. I never expected Professor Calith and Furius to be former classmates...

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: This fan club was formed with her direct approval. So even if Calith's application had gone through, she would've vetoed it at the final stage.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: She said she was "eager to see the competitive drive and spirit"...Ahem, that everyone would show in a crisis.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: She believes that's the mark of a true duelist, and that it's good for the "character development" of both students and teachers.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: And she told me that you, {PlayerName}, were the one duelist skilled enough to not only beat Professor Calith, but to earn his respect.
Should've seen that coming.
That's actually pretty meaningful.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Haha, now that's all settled... how about a match with me?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem. I, Anita, am the division manager for the Peaks of Prestige Ranked Tournament, Lahai-Roi division.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: If you can beat me, you'll earn your qualification for the Ranked Tournament.
Ranked Tournament?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: It's nice to see friendship and connection help to clear the resentment in his heart... Well, I'll spare you the lecture.
Lahai-Roi division?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I'll explain all the rules after our duel. Here we go, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: At least everything is settled now, and the fan club is safe from getting shut down...
Not quite.
You're still holding out on me.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You've been way too calm through all this. Almost like you were never worried about the club being disbanded in the first place. You've got another card to play, don't you?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: How perceptive... No wonder President Lucilla picked you. She did say there was no need to keep secrets from you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: President Lucilla?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Oh yeah. President Lucilla is the Academy's No. 1 duelist. Not that she cares much for the matches.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: ...Impressive. Your skills speak for themselves, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Good luck, {PlayerName}! I'm looking forward to the day you become our Division Champion.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Now, as division manager, I grant you the qualification to participate in the Lahai-Roi division Ranked Tournament.
So what exactly is this tournament?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Unlike the single-elimination "Apex Duelist Championship" held in Septimont, our divisions follow a points-based system.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Qualified duelists can challenge anyone on the tournament roster. Win, and you earn points.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: When the season ends, the duelist with the highest score will be crowned the Division Champion.
I think I get the idea.
When does the tournament start?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I've already sent the coordinates of the other competitors to your Terminal. Feel free to challenge them anytime.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: How's the tournament treating you, {PlayerName}?
I'd like to hear the rules again.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Sure, I'll go over it again for you. The Lahai-Roi division runs on a points system.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: You need to challenge other qualified duelists in the region and rack up wins to earn points.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: When the season ends, the duelist with the highest score will be crowned the Division Champion.
Understood.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Great. Show 'em what you got, and bring home the Lahai-Roi division champion's title!
I've finished challenging everyone.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: If you're interested, you can seek out their division managers to compete for some pretty sweet rewards.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Plus, if you win enough division championships, you can qualify for the Peaks of Prestige Grandmaster Championship. It's held every three years.
Every three years...
Sounds like just empty promises.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: ...Oh, don't get hung up on the details. It's what Mr. Furius told me, anyway.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Well, congrats again on becoming Division Champion, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ah, let's see... You sure did! You currently rank No. 1 in points among all duelists in Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Congratulations, {PlayerName}! You are now the Lahai-Roi Division Champion!
That's it...?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Well, there was supposed to be a big award ceremony... Ahem. But my request to use the auditorium got denied by the President.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: B-But, you'll still get your championship prize though! So don't worry!
Cool.
Still feels a bit underwhelming...

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem... Anyway, they run similar points-based tournaments in other regions too.

speaker: NPC #700243
anh_en: We meet again, {PlayerName}.
Hello, Professor Dennis.

speaker: NPC #700243
anh_en: Hmm. Do you not have classes right now?

speaker: NPC #700243
anh_en: Remember, a true scholar maintains diligence even in their leisure hours...

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Hmm? Oh, hello there, {PlayerName}. What brings you by?
How is your research going?

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Fine, I guess. Science isn't like Peaks of Prestige, you know. You can't just win in a few quick moves.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: But that's where the joy lies. Pushing past old failures, mine and everyone else's, is like free climbing... Just you and the next mountain.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: I'll never solve every problem out there. And there will always be more mountains... So I'll just focus on scaling the one right in front of me.
Good luck, Professor.

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Thank you.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Hi there, fellow student!

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Unlike traditional Gladiator matches, the players, we call them "duelists," don't fight in person.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Instead, they use their Terminals to deploy Action Cards and command Echoes from Preset Decks to challenge other duelists.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Just download the game modules onto your Terminal, and you can challenge anyone, anytime, anywhere. Pretty handy, right?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I'll get into the nitty-gritty details once we're in the tutorial match.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: ...Huh? Well, it's the exact promo script from Mr. Furius's "Peaks of Prestige Promotion Manual."

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Does this mean you've met Mr. Furius before? In Septimont...? Wait. Golden eyes. Tacet Mark on the back of the hand...

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: No way... You're not the legendary first "Apex Duelist" from Septimont, are you?!

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem... Forgive me. I never expected to meet the legend {Male=himself;Female=herself} here in Lahai-Roi.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You tell Anita that you're very familiar with Peaks of Prestige, and that you're the "Apex Duelist" from Septimont.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: R-Really...? Golden eyes. Tacet Mark on the back of the hand.... Just like the rumors said!

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ever heard of Peaks of Prestige? Would you like to join our fan club?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem... Forgive me. I never expected to meet the legend {Male=himself;Female=herself} here in Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: In any case, welcome to our fan club!
Wait, I haven't agreed to...
Sure, I'll join your club.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: No worries, I've already sent you the game modules. Even if you don't plan on joining our fan club, it's a fun way to kill time between classes.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Great! Then I'll go ahead and send you the game modules.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: By the way, our club's version of Peaks of Prestige is personally authorized by Mr. Furius himself.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Besides the basic Echo cards, it also includes two work-in-progress expansion packs—"Novelties" and "Domains."

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: The interface is completely redesigned, and there are a bunch of brand-new cards.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Only downside is, for now, it's not compatible with Peaks of Prestige data from other regions.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Peaks of Prestige is currently the hottest game in Rinascita. It's super easy to pick up and crazy fun! Sign up now and you'll even get a limited edition starter pack.
Sounds interesting.
New cards? Tell me more.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Haha, why don't we have a real match and let the game do the show-and-tell?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: I'll find you an opponent—right this way, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: On top of that, it's a great way to simulate Echo tactics and Tacet Discord behavior. Master the game, and writing your thesis and research reports will be a breeze!
What's Peaks of Prestige?
Now where have I heard that before...?
I've played it before.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: So you're new to the game? Well, allow me to give you a quick intro.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Peaks of Prestige was developed by Mr. Furius. It's a simulation game based on Septimont's Echo battles.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: ...Oh? Didn't you already beat me? What else do you want?

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: And as I'm only getting older... Ahem, never mind.
You don't seem to like this job.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: It's not that I hate it... When I first signed up, I thought it would be more exciting.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Fighting monsters in a mysterious Spacetrek facility, saving the day, becoming a hero.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: But after all these years, there hasn't been a single "crisis" to speak of. Haha... Just endless errands for professors and students.
Isn't that a good thing?
No drama is good drama.

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Sigh... It just feels like a waste of my skills, you know? I can't help feeling a little unsatisfied.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Was there something else, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: When I go to Septimont, I'll beat him at his own game. Then we'll see who's really the best!
About you and Mr. Furius...

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...I've been thinking. He does seem to be a... decent guy.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Not sure why all my memories of him are so irritating, though.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: ...And, though I'd rather not admit it, Peaks of Prestige... does have its merits.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: It's a passable teaching tool for Echo synergy tactics. Even covers basic Tacet Discord attack modes.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Mr. Furius would be thrilled to hear you say that.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Him? Hah, I doubt it.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Something the matter, {PlayerName}?
I'd like another practice match with you.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Sure! I have been practicing.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Come on, I'll show you what I've learned!

speaker: NPC #700243
anh_en: Another round of Peaks of Prestige?

speaker: NPC #700243
anh_en: By all means... Show me your elegance once more, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Another duel? Anytime you're ready!

speaker: NPC #700244
anh_en: Let's see how my new algorithm performs... Brace yourself, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: ...A duel? Quit bugging me already. Ah, chill, chill. If you say so...

speaker: NPC #700246
anh_en: Let's just get this over with.

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Another duel, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #700247
anh_en: Gladly. More good practice before I utterly destroy Furius... I won't go easy on you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Anita...! Huh? She's not here?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: More Peaks of Prestige practice?

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: No problem, I'm ready anytime.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Echo-centric builds are so outdated.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Domains and "Novelties" are the future of this game.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I admit those cards do have some powerful effects.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But don't forget, Echoes ultimately decide the outcome of the duel.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you heard... about the division tournament?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, I caught some buzz about it...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But players like us would probably wash out in the qualifiers.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ehh... True.

speaker: NPC #700761
anh_en: Nue, you're from... Ashinohara, right?

speaker: NPC #700761
anh_en: I heard that card dueling games have been popular there for a long time.

speaker: NPC #700762
anh_en: That's right. Before I came to the Academy, it was the go-to activity between classes.

speaker: NPC #700761
anh_en: So that missing girl... Chisa. She's probably really good at this too, huh?

speaker: NPC #700762
anh_en: You know what... it could be? Honami City is a major hub after all...

speaker: NPC #700762
anh_en: I'll ask her about it next time I see her.

speaker: NPC #700242
anh_en: Anita! You're finally back...

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: Ahem... All right, Ashild. We can talk about that later.

speaker: NPC #700241
anh_en: The club won't be going anywhere anytime soon. For now, let's just enjoy dueling instead of worrying about what-ifs.

speaker: NPC #700243

Does this have something to do with the Lament?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh, that one has really become an urban legend lately. They say a cold, mysterious girl with a giant pair of scissors patrols Honami's streets, hunting any powerful Tacet Discord she finds.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: By the look of those TDs, the lingering Lament power in Honami City is stirring again.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I have a feeling we're about to find the truth.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Doubt we're going to find the source of these events in this area.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Mhm. I wonder what Shouta and Firi might have found around the old cafe...
Ask about Namipon's thoughts on the cafe.
We should regroup with them.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Namipon, you seem kind of hung up on that old cafe?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I've just been thinking what the source of these strange events could be.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: A cafe should be a place that holds all Passengers' happiest memories. That's why "Your smile is our specialty" is the Shashou Cafe's motto.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: If these unexplainable events are trying to grant the wishes of that old cafe's customers... what if it's the cafe's owner that's behind everything?

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Hey, come take a look at this.

speaker: NPC #850418
anh_en: As for what's inside this notebook, you should see for yourselves.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It looks like a guestbook left by a customer. It's filled with stories from the old cafe...
(Analyze the pages)
(Analyze the source of the unexplainable events)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Kirine, Aomame, and Shouta all left messages inside. Everyone caught in an unexplainable event, too.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Flying, work, and... Hmm... a tiger. The events are all tied to the wishes they wrote down in this book.)

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: That narrows it down.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: So the records in this old guestbook became the blueprint for granting their wishes... In that case, do you think it could have been...?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But no one can manipulate the Lament's power. Especially not a Left Behind.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: What if they aren't manipulating it? What if they were devoured by it and became a part of it?
Shouta and Firi hand you a notebook.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh…! I know, it's the <te href=851067>Longings</te>! Remember the Longings we collected before?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So, if Longings are strong enough to affect the Lament's residual power in Honami...

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Then it must be located where the Lament first began...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Yup. Where we had that great battle.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Longings are frequencies that persist within the Lament! They don't disappear even if they're devoured by the Lament again.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: …Neon Tower.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's head out then.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Okay! The route to Neon Tower is set. This time, we can go straight to the top!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: A notebook? There's a sticky note on the cover... Miki? Is that who this notebook belongs to?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: There are frequency traces... similar to the Lament power on this notebook.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Miki was the owner of that cafe. The one Aomame mentioned, who adopted capybaras.
Adopted capybaras?
Does this mean Namipon is actually…

speaker: NPC #850418
anh_en: Yes, it was part of the aesthetic of the cafe.

speaker: NPC #850418
anh_en: Not quite. Those were just ordinary, non-talking capybaras. Namipon is more of a... mascot. A symbol of Honami itself.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Is this... a pocket Sonoro Sphere formed by Lament power?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It seems to be recreating the scene from the last time we were here...

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: I'm sorry... Miki... I've failed you as a father...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Look out, Passenger! TDs incoming!

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: I will carry on your dream...

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: This is the last thing I can do for you...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Passenger, more TDs coming our way!

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: Keep everyone in the cafe. Forever...

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: Just like you always told me you wanted...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: His frequency has been completely devoured by the Lament...!

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: You are... from Shashou Cafe... I see...

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Some mysteries aren't meant to be solved until the very end.

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: Your smile is our specialty.

speaker: NPC #850364
anh_en: I entrust Shashou Cafe to you now...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The voice then goes silent forever.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I'm not picking up on the Lament here anymore.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: But, Ms. Miki's father... He mentioned Shashou Cafe, didn't he? How did he know that name?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Both Kirine and Ms. Aomame mentioned seeing someone they know. But Miki's father was always in the tower. Which means…

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Time to go, Namipon.

speaker: NPC #850361
anh_en: Welcome back. You two must be exhausted!
Was your wish fulfilled?

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Haha, sorry about that. It's because during my investigation, I started piecing things together about Shashou Cafe.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: If my hunch was right, then the ones who saved this city from the Lament, long before these events started... was you, wasn't it?

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: It's long overdue... but thank you. Thank you for saving our city.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Actually, the place Miki's father wanted to rebuild the cafe is exactly where Shashou Cafe is standing today. We just never got the chance to start…

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: After you rescued me, I struggled with whether to tell you the whole truth. After all, Namipon had a right to know.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: But I wanted you to see it through yourselves. It was the only way for Miki's father's wish to be truly fulfilled.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Inheriting a cafe isn't just about the building, the coffee beans, or the dessert recipes... It's about inheriting the stories and the life that fills it.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Of course, it has been. Honami Crossing, this cafe, and even Honami City now have wonderful new guardians.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Huh, why the big gathering?

speaker: NPC #850361
anh_en: And that guestbook, full of stories from the past... can finally start collecting new ones.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh, Passengers...

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: I never thought I'd get the chance to talk to you like this. Namipon... or should I say, the spirit of Honami? But I think I'll stick with Namipon.

speaker: NPC #850418
anh_en: Thank you for everything. Our story ends here. The rest of it... is yours to tell.
With their wishes fulfilled, the Left Behind gradually fade from sight.
A little while later, Namipon tidies the tables and prepares a fresh cup of coffee for everyone.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Good work, Passenger. It seems these unexplainable events have finally reached their end.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You were so helpful, Namipon.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Miki used to name all the capybaras in her cafe after railway lines... but the name she chose for the cafe itself was <ano=Train Conductor>Shashou</ano>.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I think... I'm finally starting to understand why.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: We heard everything from Shouta... So, what happened? Did you find out the truth behind the unexplainable events?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The people in this city are all connected, like a vast railway network. Tracks crossing and intertwining.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Lives that were never meant to meet all found a connection in the cafe. And slowly, this place became the central station for it all.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Maybe… that is why you, the symbol of Honami, appeared here in the first place.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Beats me. At the very least, this cafe is proof that the Honami of the past existed.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Then, as the Shashou, you have to take good care of it, Namipon.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Don't you worry. The story of Shashou Cafe is just getting started.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Next time you get the chance, remember to bring more of your friends over to visit, {PlayerName}, Chisa.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You share everything that happened inside the tower with the group.

speaker: NPC #850418
anh_en: A brilliant piece of work. It seems everything is out in the open now... Shouta, don't you think it's time you came clean?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: It must've been you that Kirine and Aomame saw.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Yes, and for that I owe you all an apology. The truth is, I'd been inside Neon Tower once before we ever met.

speaker: NPC #850362
anh_en: Of course, I didn't expect to get caught up in one of those events myself.
Why didn't you tell us?

speaker: NPC #850366
anh_en: Thank you for choosing NamiZoom! How can I help you?
Set out for Honami City.
Which Namipon are you again…?

speaker: NPC #850366
anh_en: I'm the one who handles the transportation! You can also call me the Platform Guardian.

speaker: NPC #850366
anh_en: Here in Honami, no matter how far away, I'll come rolling up the moment you need it!

speaker: NPC #850366
anh_en: But remember, Passenger. Drive slow and enjoy the scenery. Drive fast and you might join the scenery.

speaker: NPC #850366
anh_en: So when you're out exploring, drive safe, and be safe.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Unusual cases always bring the freshest clues. It's the mundane ones that are truly unsolvable.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: I wonder if there is more to this series of events in Honami than meets the eye...
I'd like to check the Namipon Namipon Case Files.
Which Namipon are you again?

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Forgotten me so soon, Passenger? I'm Polmes. To be precise, I'm a certified "consulting detective." I am, one might say, the mentor to all detectives.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: But don't get me wrong, I'm not some brooding protagonist from a popular work of fiction. I don't have time for emotional baggage, psychological hand-holding, or spinning fancy theories from a total lack of data...

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: I simply enjoy the meticulous architecture of logic. Each time I enter my mind palace, I feel a sense of transcendence. It is my instinct.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: In other words, I enjoy cases and crimes.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Perhaps Honami would be more interesting with a Moriartypon...

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Today's Honami special: the critically acclaimed, limited-edition Namipon badge series! Would you like one, Passenger?
Explore the shop.
Which Namipon are you again?

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: I'm Mall Guide Namipon. I'm in charge of Shashou Cafe's specialty store.

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Just between us, the items here might seem random, but if you have enough Rice Dangos, you're basically guaranteed to get the badge you're looking for...

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Don't worry about a few bad pulls! After all, the thrilling uncertainty and the hint of possible disappointment are what make this gameplay so exciting!

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Eep! A-And it's totally not because a direct price would have to be, like, crazy high to cover costs! Nope!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Looks like you've gotten a general idea of the situation in Honami City.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It's time we investigate the first unexplainable event. Hmm, the one closest to us is... "The Haunted Apartment." A fine place to start.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The city is still pretty dangerous, so I've arranged a safe and reliable Namipon Shuttle for you. Beep, beep!
If you need a lift, just give Transport Namipon a shout.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The smell of the Lament is getting stronger, Passenger. We're going in the right direction.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: What's that hovering above the roof…? Is that a girl?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: There may be dangerous enemies up ahead. Be careful, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: This must be "The Haunted Apartment."

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: Careful, this area is pretty dangerous. There's that one unexplainable event, plus some freaky TDs.

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: You're also tracking these unexplainable events? Hmm… after a closer look, you two do stand out from the rest of the city residents.
That's what we're here for.
Let them come, they're no match for us.

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: That's quite the confidence in your abilities. How nice.

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: I'd like to help, but in my current state, I'd be useless in a fight. The best I can do is share what I know.

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: The girl you see floating up there is Kirine. She was originally a citizen of Honami, born with a frail constitution and no Resonance abilities.

speaker: NPC #850358
anh_en: I'm not sure how she got caught up in this unexplainable event, but I don't think she deserves your suspicion.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Now that those unusual TDs are gone, the Lament power around here seems to have stabilized... Oh, Passenger, look! Our ghostly lady is waking up.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This area isn't fully secure yet. Let's head back to the cafe. We'll be able to talk in peace there.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Couldn't agree more! We'll have delicious coffee and desserts waiting, our treat. Your help in investigating these unexplainable events will be really appreciated, Kirine.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Sure, I do love a nice cafe. Please, lead the way.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Ugh, my head... Are you… Namipon the Mascot? What happened?
You briefly explain the situation to her.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: So it wasn't just a dream... I was affected by the Lament's power and turned into some kind of possessed ghost?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: We haven't found any other lingering traces of Lament power here. I believe that is the case.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: How incredible. Thank you for saving me. I'm Kirine, a Honami local.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: I'm curious, what exactly is this Lament power you mentioned?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hmm... to keep it simple, Honami's Lament power manifests as a unique phenomenon we call "Irideglow."

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Irideglow? You mean those rainbow-colored, sparkling things? I think I saw something like that right before all this happened...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Oh, hey. I found this lying near that unusual TD earlier. I'll find a nice spot for it…
The craft you discovered has been placed on a shelf inside the cafe...

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: I'm surprised. This cafe looks so different from the one I remember. That one wasn't this spacious, and the location wasn't nearly as nice…

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Did you notice anything particular that day? Anything that stood out?

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Well... I think I met someone I know... then there was the familiar smell of coffee. Sorry. I can't remember who it was exactly.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Can you recall the street where you met them?
You obtain details of the location from Kirine.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: So you're investigating the unexplainable events happening in Honami? That reminds me of two detectives who used to stay in the old cafe.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Maybe they're looking into it, too. I wonder what the truth behind all this really is...
Some time later, after saying goodbye to Kirine, you and Namipon sort through the information you've gathered so far.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: We still haven't figured out what's causing these unexplainable events. But judging from Ms. Kirine's situation, they might be triggered by the lingering attachments of the Left Behind.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Ms. Kirine was always sick and stuck inside, so it turned her into a flying ghost. It's like her wish to be free was granted... but in a twisted way?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: It's too soon to jump to conclusions. But the Meishin Passageway she mentioned is highly suspect… Has anyone reported strange happenings there, Namipon?

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Oh, what was it you wanted to ask about?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I did hear a few stories… How about we head to the Commercial District next? The trail might be cold, but it's better than just chasing rumors.
(Ask Namipon about the Left Behind)
Let's move out.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Namipon... How come the Left Behind can perceive these Lament phenomena now? Before, they didn't even realize they were all already dead.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh, that... Well, after you and Chisa stopped the looping Lament in the city, the <te href=850080>Waveworn Phenomena</te> affecting the Left Behind was weakened.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: They still linger in Honami because of their attachments, but now they can think more clearly, almost like they did in life, until those attachments finally fade.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I see... So that's why they're becoming self-aware.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Mhm! By the way, we've gathered enough materials from our exploring to fix up a few facilities. Be sure to take a look when you get a moment, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Before we head out again, you should go talk to Polmes. I think it needs your help with some of the other Namipons scattered around the city.
(Ask about her identity and experiences)
(Ask how she first saw the Irideglow)
(I need to figure out what connects the victims of these unexplainable events. Since they're all Left Behind, it must be some kind of strong attachment keeping them in Honami.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You mentioned you're a Honami local, Ms. Kirine... Can you tell us a bit about yourself?

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: I'm just an ordinary high school girl. What's special about me...? Well, I've been sickly since I was a child. I couldn't go out much, and hospital visits were a regular part of my life.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Actually, to think I was flying during this unexplainable event... is actually kind of nice.

speaker: NPC #850359
anh_en: Let's see... My memories are still kind of fuzzy. I was probably on my way to the hospital for a check-up that day. I can't really say how I saw the Irideglow.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Long time no see. I'm impressed you found one of our <ano=Missing Namipons>Little Namipons</ano> so quickly, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: There are still other Little Namipons lost in the city. If you happen to find any, please help bring them back to me.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: I've put together a list with all their details.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Of course, there'll be rewards for completing this Namipon rescue mission. Come find me anytime to check the list or collect rewards.

speaker: NPC #850376
anh_en: What the—?! Can't believe you saw through my Kage Bushin! You must have a pair of sharp eyes.
... It was pretty obvious.
You were just dozing under that tree.

speaker: NPC #850376
anh_en: Ha, guess I need more training to really hide my aura.

speaker: NPC #850376
anh_en: Alright, fine. Time to head back to the cafe. Ninjutsu… Teleportation!

speaker: NPC #850377
anh_en: You know, Honami Central Park used to top the "This Park is Amazing!" contest.

speaker: NPC #850377
anh_en: But this place is huge. You could get lost just like I did. Which way should I take again?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Maybe you should head back to Shashou Cafe first.

speaker: NPC #850377
anh_en: Right. After such a long trip, it's time I finally head "home."

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: I didn't pass the interview… again. The interviewer said there's only one opening left, and they already have it filled.

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: Every morning, I leave my apartment head high, only to end up sitting here at sunset, jobless, all alone in the park.
Just chin up and keep going.

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: It's alright, really. Just a hurdle any other person would face.

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: Don't worry, I'm not giving up yet. Just a hurdle any other person would face.

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: Being able to sit here without worrying about survival… that alone makes me luckier than many others.
(You tell the Namipon about the cafe.)

speaker: NPC #850378
anh_en: …Ah, that's right. Turns out I do have somewhere I belong besides this park. I should head back.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come to think of it, this is probably the largest cafe in Honami.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ♪Eh-yo, destiny's callin'! Here in this building!♪

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: One capybara, two capybaras, three capybaras... *Yawn*...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: There are so many of "us" here... This has to be enough to count as a kaidan, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've got a big plan. Startin' from this cafe, I'm gonna bring the hustle and bustle back to Honami Crossing.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I just hope this peace can last forever...

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: As reliable as ever, Passenger! You've managed to bring back all the Namipons!
That's how a cafe should be.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Gathering all the lost capybaras in such a short time… You're truly the greatest detective in all of Honami!

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Haha, with so many <ano=Little Namipons><te href=851073>Missing Namipons</te>s</ano> here, this place feels more bustling than ever.
Maybe they could keep their voices down a little.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Indeed. I love a lively crowd myself as well.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: There's no need to worry. Every Namipon's a good Namipon. We'd never cause any trouble.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Thanks to your help, "we" are reunited once again, ready to make Honami City a better place.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: I look forward to us working together again! Be it chasing urban legends or solving cold cases, you'll always have my full support.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Wherever there's a case, there's a detective! The Super Detective Team will always be on the frontline in pursuit of truth.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (That banner's color and the direction it's flying don't match the others…)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Why are all those Namipon statues facing in different directions? Was that done on purpose, or just a mistake...?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm, how come that light over there is not on?

speaker: NPC #850367
anh_en: We bank clerks don't work for the banks. We work to make everyone happy.

speaker: NPC #850367
anh_en: But now with Honami City in ruins, who even needs banks anymore…

speaker: NPC #850367
anh_en: Hmm? I smell a familiar scent from you… Aha, so the original <ano=Namipon>me</ano> is in that cafe?

speaker: NPC #850367
anh_en: Thank you. It's almost time for me to head back.

speaker: NPC #850368
anh_en: ♪Eh-yo, fella! Call me Rap-bara! Congrats, you caught me standin' tall among hata!♪

speaker: NPC #850368
anh_en: ♪This block once buzzin', loud as an arena. Now it's hush, no more noise, no fiesta.♪
Time to head back to the cafe.
Now there are talent shows?

speaker: NPC #850368
anh_en: ♪Gotcha, gotcha! I'll see ya when I see ya!♪

speaker: NPC #850368
anh_en: ♪Just a capybara, doin' what I wanna. If the rhyme doesn't land, don't sweat it, no drama!♪

speaker: NPC #850369
anh_en: Hmm… it took me forever to find this Rice Dango in a convenience store. I'll have to try to make it last for as long as I can...
There are more Rice Dangos at the cafe.

speaker: NPC #850369
anh_en: R-really?! Umm… I think I can get a feel of the cafe's location from you. Guess I'll go check it out.

speaker: NPC #850369
anh_en: Hehe, I wonder what other treats they might have there.

speaker: NPC #850369
anh_en: Oh, by the way, I picked up this fancy gadget on my way here. Please accept it as a gift.

speaker: NPC #850370
anh_en: Did you know that if you make it to the deepest part of the Meishin Passageway, you might get a chance to have a wish granted?

speaker: NPC #850370
anh_en: Well, I just came out of the Passageway, and, uh, nothing happened.

speaker: NPC #850370
anh_en: …Shashou Cafe, you say? Sounds like a nice spot to take a break.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You tell the little capybara about the cafe.

speaker: NPC #850371
anh_en: Zzz… Zzz… Ah! Whoa, the view and this breeze here are too comfortable, I almost dozed off just now.

speaker: NPC #850371
anh_en: W-wait… you're not here to drag me back to the office, are you?
I'm here to take you to the cafe.
Your office's already gone. No more office days for you.

speaker: NPC #850371
anh_en: I see… I can sense the original <ano=Namipon>me</ano>.

speaker: NPC #850371
anh_en: Ah, now I remember… I'm on vacation forever.

speaker: NPC #850371
anh_en: I know how to get back to the cafe now. Thank you. Please, take this power with you. It'll come in handy.
