anh_en: Hi, {PlayerName}! We're coming up with some lucky greetings.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It's the Moon-Chasing Festival, so we're coming up with some new lucky greetings for the festivity. You know, two heads are better than one.

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Yeah, I heard those researchers call it brain… brain…?
Brainstorming?

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Yeah! That's it!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Alright, I'll start with an easy one. Listen up, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Now, it's your turn to start, {PlayerName}.
May your diligence pay off!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: And your future shine aloft!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: I'd say the rhymes are great, and the content is amazing, too.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Let's save this couplet for students preparing for exams. They'll be glad to hear it.

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Lingyang, your turn.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Oh yeah, how about this one!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: May your business grow and soar!
Bringing happiness more and more!
Achieving heights never seen before!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I wish you great fortune and success!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: I'd prefer a better expression than "more and more."

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Hey, don't be so picky! It makes perfect sense!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: …Yeah, you have a point...

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: That's a good line, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I bet shop owners and businessmen will be happy to hear it!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Looks like {PlayerName} has the upper hand. Now, you go first, Lingyang.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Me again? Alright, listen up!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: May the fierce lion chase evil away!
May peace and light forever stay!
Wishing you joy and peace everyday!
May all your dreams progress!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Impressive! My master said there's a trick to everything. Once you find it, things get done better.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I say you've mastered the trick of giving lucky greetings!
What's the trick anyway?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Put yourself in their shoes and think what they crave.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Then whip up some rhymes—it'll hit the mark!
I see, that's the magic of "empathy."

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The best greetings are the ones we all want to receive. They're what truly connect us.
So, do you want those lucky greetings too...
...since you love giving them out?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Well… maybe, but it's okay if I don't get any!
May you be happy everyday!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: After all, seeing everyone happy because of my lucky greetings makes me happy too!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It means my efforts are being appreciated, right?
Perhaps I can come up with one for you?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Wait a minute, you want to do it for me? That's fantastic!
Fare thee well, blessings swell!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Aww, that's so sweet… Wait, wasn't that what I came up with before?!
Bingo!
I have a good memory.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Haha, it really is a good one.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Thank you so much, {PlayerName}! I'm really, really happy to hear that!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: …You're quite an opponent, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: In return, I wish that all things go your way, and your dreams come true every day!
Thank you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Enjoy your time!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: That's a wonderful couplet.

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: It doesn't seem to rhyme with Lingyang's line...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It's no big deal! After all, happiness is what matters the most!

speaker: Mingzhi
anh_en: Well, since Lingyang is okay with it…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: {PlayerName}... What do you need from me?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Like that traditional fairy tale? Good idea. Cute animal puppets should be popular with the kids.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Like those Hero Plays? That could work. The battle between good and evil might be a big hit…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Starting from scratch is probably too late. Fortunately, I know a place that sells ready-made puppets.
Really?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes. In Jinzhou, you can buy ANYTHING with the right connections...
Is it a black market or something?
Ugh, that sounds dangerous…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Just kidding. Come, let's get going.
No big deal.
I have a favor to ask.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I see. So the puppet show performer couldn't make it to the Moonlit Fair, and now you need me to save the show.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Sure, I don't have much on my plate right now, so I can fill in for a few days—If you can afford my fees, that is.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And if we want to perform at the Moonlit Fair, we'll need some puppets that match the vibe.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Any ideas, {PlayerName}?
A fox chasing after a rabbit?
Rover and the Threnodian, recreating the legendary battle?

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Welcome to the Pioneer Association Store! Hey there, {PlayerName} and Ms. Yinlin! What can get for you today?
In no time, Ganxue locates the puppets Yinlin needs and brings them to you.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Thanks a bunch! Hope to see you both again soon!
Done! Let's go back to Taoyuan Vale.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hold on. I think I just saw someone I know.
Someone you know?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Interesting… He shouldn't be here. Let's follow him and see what he's up to, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We'd like some puppets.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Absolutely! We just received a fresh batch of new arrivals.
You sell puppets here?

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Our Pioneer Association has highly skilled puppet makers who trust us to sell their creations.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: But not many customers come to us looking to buy their own puppets, so we only display them when requested.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: But thankfully, there's still interest from collectors and professionals like Ms. Yinlin here who purchase these puppets.
I see.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: I'll go check our stock real quick. One moment please, I'll be right back…

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The person you're after... Is he an Exile?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Exactly. Exiles aren't allowed in Jinzhou. To sneak in, he disguised himself and didn't wear the Exiles' uniform.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: His name is Lei. He used to involve in petty crimes and just got out of prison a few days ago.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Used to be my informant before I became an undercover agent myself, but he fled at a critical moment.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Something feels off about him being here... It seems he's talking to someone. Let's find out what he's up to.

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: Big Lei, are you saying… You got a new hustle for us?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Then come with me and see for yourself. And keep your mouth shut! This deal's ours alone.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Big boss wants us there, 2-4 AM, east side of Taoyuan Vale. Don't mess it up! Get ready!

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: Got it! You can count on me!

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Hell yeah. You know who I used to , right? The Savage Beasts. Lots of cash for you.

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: Sweet! I'm listening. Money's been s**t lately.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: You know the Moonlit Fair? Lots of snobs, easy cash for the taking.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Just got outta the slammer, remember that big boss I was talkin' about? He's got the connections, loyalty, and street smarts.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Stick with him, we'll clean up at the Moonlit Fair. Soon we'll be swimming in cash!

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: C-can I meet him?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: What, so you can ditch me for him?

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: No joke! I'm a loyal guy. Just curious, that's all.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Looks like they're planning something. {PlayerName}, what do you think we should do?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hold on. We don't want to tip off our target. Let's scope it out first, just the two of us.
We need to think carefully.
Let's arrest them directly.
You're the expert. I'll follow your lead.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I agree. Lei mentioned a 'Big Boss'. That man must be the mastermind behind their scheme.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lei isn't the true culprit. The so-called Big Boss must the mastermind behind their scheme.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We should track down that Big Boss. He must be the mastermind behind their scheme.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We know when and where they're meeting. Maybe we can pay them a surprise visit... What do you say?
I'll call the Patrollers.

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: Big Lei, when is he gonna showing up?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Ha, no way. We just got here. Hurry up, greet our boss, Uncle Li!

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: We're ready, boss!

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Hehe, youth. If I were a few decades younger, I wouldn't have needed to bother you lot.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: No problem, boss. We're just hustling for cash!

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Well, I'm not in this for the money… anyway, you wouldn't believe me if I told you. Where's my stuff, Lei?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Over there in the box. I once ran with the Savage Beasts for a spell, so I know a thing or two... But feel free to take a look yourself, if you want.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Yeah. Given how important this is, I'd better—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Uncle Li is about to speak when the roars of Tacet Discords interrupt him.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: That sound... Damn, it's a Spearback! Must've smelled our goods!

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: M-mr. Li, since you're the boss, you need to protect us, right…?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Just wait! Big shots always show up late!

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: If I could be twenty years younger, I wouldn't break a sweat dealing with it! But now… Cough cough!
They're being attacked by Tacet Discords.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Interesting… From what I know, Uncle Li isn't a bad person. If he was actually hiding his true nature this whole time, I have to give him some credit for fooling me.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Let's take care of the monsters first. Then we can have a proper chat with him.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Oh, he's here! Straighten up and say hello!
A familiar figure emerges from behind the tree and approaches Lei. It's someone you know all too well.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Wait. Is that…
No way…
How could it be…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Uncle Li…? Stay put. Let's listen in first.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Sorry I kept you waiting, Lei.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: {PlayerName}, and… Yinlin? What brings you here?

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Hold on, {PlayerName}… Is buying meat illegal now?
Buying meat…?

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Yeah, I've been working on a new dish—Special Jinzhou Skewers. I'm trying to sell it at the Moonlit Fair, but the taste wasn't quite right.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: So, I thought about using top-quality meat and grilling it over charcoal for that perfect flavor.
But what does it have to do with the Exiles?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: What? Exiles? I left that life behind when I got out of jail.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Uncle Li knows life ain't easy for a man with a past like mine. Used to run with the Savage Beasts, know how to hunt, so he hired me and my crew to fetch meat for him.
Then why are you dressed up like this?
What do you mean by "we'll clean up at the Moonlit Fair"?
Why are you meeting up here at midnight in a remote place?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Thank you, thank you for saving our lives... Wait, you are...
I'm done.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: We were goin' huntin'. Can't wear clothes that tear easy, right? These are better for the job.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Well, because the Moonlit Fair's got easy targets everywhere... I mean, rich folks. Mr. Li's skewers are gonna sell like crazy! And he gives us a generous cut!

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Since I have a stall to attend to, I have to wait till the wee hours when all the customers are gone to get my supplies. Besides, look at them? They won't be allowed into the venue dressed like that.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I see… There are no holes in your answers. Thank you for cooperating with the investigation. I apologize for the confusion.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Uh, no need to apologize to us, ma'am. I know what's up now. Gotta work on my language, drop those old habits.

speaker: NPC #700057
anh_en: I totally thought we were gonna break some laws too... No wonder they'd grow suspicious...
Good to know you're doing legit work.
I'm rooting for you.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: I will. Jail taught me, gotta make honest cash to stay outta trouble and find some damn peace in my life.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Keep an eye on them, {PlayerName}. I'll go see what they have here… Might be dangerous substance.

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: Uncle Li, heading back to the stall already? Let us handle the boxes. We'll get 'em close to the venue, but the rest...
We'll help him.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Oh, great! Thank you, all of you!
Shortly after, Yinlin returns.
Bombs or guns?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: ...Just some meat, fresh and nice. No hidden compartments, and it's not poisoned.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Alright, tell me your story. What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #700058
anh_en: I'll spill everything! It was all Uncle Li's idea!

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Wait! Zhezhi, don't tell me you plan on finishing all that by yourself?
Zhezhi leaves in a hurry.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Wait, Zhezhi...!

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Oh, hello, {PlayerName}. Are you here to buy a fan?
I saw Zhezhi leaving in a rush…
Is there anything wrong?

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Well, here's the thing. I set up a fan-drawing stall at the Moonlit Fair and was planning to ask a few of my artist friends to draw some fans.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: But none of our other artists had open slots... I didn't know what to do. Then Zhezhi stepped up to take on all the commissions herself.
So many requests to work on…
That sounds like a lot of work.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Zhezhi never misses deadlines, but I don't want her to overwork herself.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes.
Anything I can help you with?

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: You're gonna help us? Really? Let me think…

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: How about taking photos of the landscapes she chose? That way, she can just use those photos as references.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: She can stay home and focus on her art instead of traveling. It'll save her time and energy!

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Can you help us with that? I'll pay you, of course!
Sure, why not?

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Great! Thank you so much! Zhezhi should be painting peach trees on a slope near Taoyuan Vale right now, so I think you can skip that place.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Now... We still need pics of the waterfall at Bell-Borne Ravine and the Jinzhou city.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: When you're finished, please bring them back to me and I'll pass them on to Zhezhi.
You can count on me!

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: But there are so many requests... Darling, I can't let you do all of this alone.
A piece of cake.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: That's a relief. Thank you, Zhezhi will be so happy to have those photos!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Dianxiao, it's okay. I'll finish them on time.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: I never doubted that. I know you just pulled all-nighters for another project. It's only been a couple days, you need rest...

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: And if you take this job, you'll have to travel around for inspiration… It's not going to be light work.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Are you sure you'll be alright?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Y-yes. Please let me take this job…

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I... I'll start working right now. Thank you, Dianxiao.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The puppets are ready. I'm all set for tonight's performance, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Heh… Of course you'd see through my lies, {PlayerName}. Alright, I didn't think this level of performance would fool you either.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But I'm curious. How did you figure it out?
From Lei's identity.
From what Uncle Li purchased.
With my instinct.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Indeed. Lei was my informant. I had to keep an eye on him to make sure he didn't rat me out.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So, it didn't make sense for me to not know he had gone straight… That was a glaring flaw in my words, yes.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Your theory makes sense—Uncle Li is known for his exquisite taste, and the items he bought just happened to attract attention from greedy Tacet Discords like Spearback.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Plus, Lei's past with the Savage Beasts suggests he has strong hunting skills. It would be easy to put two and two together from here.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Heh, your instinct is sharp indeed. Noticed that since the first time we met.
You look happy.
But that's not the main reason behind my conclusion.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Oh? What is it then?
You are a great undercover agent. Very experienced.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: …So, you believe I wouldn't mess up such a simple case?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe, I see. So {PlayerName} really does trust me a lot, huh?
I had a lot of fun today.
Thank you, Yinlin.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Same here. I haven't felt this happy in a long time.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I should be the one thanking you, {PlayerName}. I haven't felt this happy in a long time.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You make me feel like I can be myself, no masks or pretending. I can do whatever I want, without any masks. You are... the only one.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Of course. I've been spending most of my time dealing with criminals.
So Yinlin really does trust me a lot, huh?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Sure I do. But earning my trust is no easy task.
It's my honor.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Can you do something for me, {PlayerName}?
What is it?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry. I won't ask for anything outrageous. It's simple.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No matter how busy you are, remember to come watch my performance. I'll be waiting until you show up.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Many of them have lost all scraps of humanity. As long as they're alive, they'll keep doing harm. I've stopped some, but there's always more out there.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lei used to steal, but he's not a lost cause. He lacks bravery and brags, but he knows there are other ways to survive.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Now he's turned his life around, and as someone who fights crime, it brings me joy to see that change.
This isn't the only reason, right?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What do you mean…?
You discovered the truth long ago.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: {PlayerName}, it's been a while.
No need. You can count on me.
I'll go check on them for you.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: You... *smile* Then I'll gladly accept your help, {PlayerName}.
Jiyan? Did something happen on the front lines?

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: Don't worry. I'm not calling you for work this time.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: We have contained the hatching Threnodian. Any new threat from the Tacet Discords will likely take time to materialize.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: It wouldn't have been possible without you, {PlayerName}. Thank you.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: With the Moon-Chasing Festival near and our borders secured, I've granted leave for soldiers who haven't taken any in too long. They deserve time with loved ones.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: I will remain on post with the rest to ensure continued safety.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: That reminds me... Some of the soldiers on leave have lost their families to Tacet Discords.

speaker: Kỵ Viêm (Đang gọi)
anh_en: I'm not sure how they'll spend this time or if they need help. Maybe I will...

speaker: NPC #700042
anh_en: Yanwu! You're back!

speaker: NPC #700043
anh_en: Count me in! Come on, Lele! Let's go find Auntie!
The children run off with Loong Buns, playfully chasing each other.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Take it easy, kids! Watch your step!
Hello, Yanwu.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Oh hey, {PlayerName}! I remember seeing you during the last battle!

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: What brings you here? Thought you'd be at the Moonlit Fair.
Well, in fact…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You explain why you're here to Yanwu.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: I see. General Jiyan was thoughtful to send you, but there's no need for that. I'm doing great. He worries too much.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: I grew up in the orphanage nearby. Autie Director takes care of us like her own. The orphanage is my home now.

speaker: NPC #700043
anh_en: Yanwu! Where are the yummies you promised last time?

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: I'm not lonely at all. Look, my family's right here.
Those kids…

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: They're all orphans like me. Whenever I get leave, I stop by to catch up with them and chat with Auntie.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: It gives me a sense of purpose, knowing I'm out there on the front lines fighting those monsters to protect them.
Need any help?

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Help? Nah, nothing comes to mind. Maybe repainting the orphanage walls...

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: But nevermind, I can knock that out in an hour, tops!

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Thanks for coming over to check on me, {PlayerName}! It means a ton.

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Alright, time for me to get cracking. See you around!

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Oh no! I totally forgot…

speaker: NPC #700043
anh_en: Hmph! You liar!

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: ...Hahaha, just kidding! I got you some Loong Buns from the Moonlit Fair. Eat them while they're hot, they're the best that way!

speaker: NPC #700043
anh_en: Wow! Loong Buns! Thank you, Yanwu!

speaker: NPC #700042
anh_en: C-can I go to the Moonlit Fair too...?

speaker: NPC #700044
anh_en: Of course! Just let Auntie know and you can go!

speaker: NPC #700042
anh_en: Hooray!

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: It's my brother's grave. He served in the Rearguard. During a transport mission, his team... ran into an ambush.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: They fulfilled their duty, forming a human barricade to protect the carts from those monsters.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: By the time reinforcements came... it was too late. None of them survived.
They were heroes.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Thank you. I'm sure he'd be happy to hear that from Jinzhou's savior.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: By the way... What brought you here today?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You explain why you're here to Ke Ni.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Ah, I see. That does sound like something General Jiyan would say. Thanks for offering to help. Hmm, let me think...

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: If you don't mind, could you fetch some Lemongrass for me? My brother loved its scent, despite not being a fan of flowers.
No problem.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: ...Hello, {PlayerName}. Are you visiting someone you know?
I am here for something else.
...No, I don't know any of them.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: I see... These graves hold fallen soldiers from before your arrival in Jinzhou. You probably don't know them.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: They're all soldiers who gave their lives in battles, protecting Jinzhou.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The name on the grave marker in front of Ke Ni catches your eye—that surname is the same as hers.
This is…

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Thank you... It smells refreshing as always.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: It'll probably taste worse since I'm eating alone though. Oh well...

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: It reminds me of when mom was alive... She always used Lemongrass in her fish soup. It wasn't the best, to be honest.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: The lemon grass and fish created a weird taste that I couldn't quite put my finger on.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: But she insisted it would make us taller. I couldn't handle it, so I'd pour mine into my brother's bowl. Well, he did grow really tall…

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: I guess he loved Lemongrass because it reminded him of simpler, happier times...

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Sorry, {PlayerName}. I got carried away talking about my family... Haha, now I'm starting to miss my mom's fish soup.

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Alright!

speaker: NPC #700045
anh_en: Since you brought me so much Lemongrass, I'll make that fish soup during my leave!

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: You here for some sight-seeing too, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Haha, EVERYONE…

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: I can, you say... Huh.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: My village got swallowed up by the Waveworn, sunk right into the ground.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Like a stone skippin' on water, a few ripples and poof, gone for good.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Friends, family, everything I ever loved... vanished in a blink.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Had no idea what to do, but I wanted to live.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Then along came Jiyan.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Well, I know you're not. Ain't nobody got as much free time as me during days like this.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Haha, you know what that fool... ahem, I mean General Jiyan did? He tried to recruit me! Asked if I wanted to help combat the Tacet Discords. Funny, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: As if that'll make a difference... Tacet Discords and the Waveworn stuff, those are natural disasters. They just happen. What can I even do about it?

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: But I said yes anyway. He made it sound real good. Figured dying on the battlefield beats starving in the wild.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Alright, you've heard it all. You should know my answer now.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: How do I know what you're gonna ask? Well, Jiyan's been asking us the same darn question every leave!

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: And my answer stays the same—thanks but no thanks! I'm good being alone. As long as there's still Tacet Discords to fight. Keeps my fists busy.
I will tell him that.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Sure, now go. Oh, and take this with you.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Jiyan never seems to stop working. He keeps skipping meals once he gets busy.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Me and the boys made this stew with what we've gathered. He can have some.
Your face... Are you injured?
It smells good…

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Hey, no sneakin' bites! Well, maybe a nibble, but leave some for Jiyan, okay?

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Oh, no worries. Just a scratch from a few days back. It's all patched up now.
You don't seem to be enjoying your leave.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: The leave... If I was a rookie, I'd be over the moon.

speaker: NPC #700046
anh_en: Think about it. Leave's all about food and friends and family reunions for most people, I bet.
Yeah, that's what everyone does.
You can go do all of that too.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Tacet Discord remains contained to Norfall Barren. We should consider pushing our outpost positions further north.
I can understand why now.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Ah... They must have told you a lot, {PlayerName}.
They have a gift for you too.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: A gift? Could it be...
You set the bowl of stew in front of Jiyan.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Ha, knew it. Ningwei made it, right?

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: He probably mentioned how I recruited him, but I bet he didn't tell you the whole story.
Go on.
I love stories. Tell me more.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I wasn't the general back then. Just another medic on duty, returning to base after dark.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Deploy new observation posts on the outskirts. This will give us early warnings and time to ready for future outbreaks.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Made a stew for myself with whatever I had. That's when I saw Ningwei wandering alone in the wilderness.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: He lost everything in a Waveworn disaster. He was all alone, didn't know what to do.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I shared my stew and listened as he talked about his struggles. About what happened after his hometown was gone.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: His eyes were filled with hopelessness. He wanted to live, but couldn't find a reason to go on.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: You already know what happened next. I asked if he'd want to enlist in the army. He said yes.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: After that, Ningwei often makes stews to share with me during his leaves. Maybe to repay me for the stew from that night.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: ...Nevermind, he's probably just showing off his cooking skills. Mine are lacking, to say the least.
Nice story. Your stew is getting cold, though.

speaker: NPC #700047
anh_en: Roger that!

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: ...Ah, thanks for the reminder.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Shall we eat together, {PlayerName}? You must be hungry, having walked all the way here.
A little bit…
Don't mind if I do!
The messenger salutes and hurries away.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: {PlayerName}, what brings you here? Aren't you supposed to be in Taoyuan Vale?
Came back from one of the soldiers you mentioned. Wanted to check on you too.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I see. It's got to be Ningwei and his crew.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I told them to make the most of their leave... But they won't stray far from camp, even after years on the front lines.
Because they already consider it home.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Tacet Discords…

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: To collect the Twin Lotus Seeds, we'll need to get rid of them first.

speaker: NPC #700061
anh_en: Wow, it looks amazing! Where did you get it?

speaker: NPC #700062
anh_en: Yumyum Haven. Uncle Li made it fresh! Madam Magistrate said it's good too!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Magistrate? Is Jinhsi here, too? I should give Yumyum Haven a visit...)

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: How'd you like it, ma'am?

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Here, have a taste, {PlayerName}.
Thank you.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: How is it?
I agree with Jinhsi.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Alright, thanks for your advice. I'll adjust it based on your suggestions.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: This is merely our personal preference. It may be helpful to get others' input as well, Uncle Li.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Haha, don't worry. I take every single customer feedback seriously. That's how I get the inspirations for new flavors.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Here, take these snacks and enjoy them while you explore the fair. It'll be lovely to walk under the moonlight and snack on something delicious, don't you think?

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Come grab a bite if you get tired and hungry anytime. You'll enjoy the fair more on a full stomach!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Thank you, Uncle Li. If you need any assistance, please let me know. I'll be sure to help.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Dewvetch's nectar is sweet and delicious, truly the highlight of this sweet porridge.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Great, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks, Madam Magistrate! Now go and have fun!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: {PlayerName}, how has the Moonlit Fair been for you? I just found some time to come over and take a look, and I ran into you right away.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Since it's such a delightful coincidence, how about we take a stroll together from here on?
Sure, let's go.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I recall there is a method to enhance the sweetness even more. Something like… soaking it in sugar water first…

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Oh? {PlayerName}, what a pleasant surprise. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?
Yeah. Jinhsi, I didn't know you had a sweet tooth.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Hehe, Uncle Li is having people taste-test some pastries. I happened to be passing by and decided to stop in.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Actually, I came to see if I could help with something, but Uncle Li told me that…

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: My bakery is all set for this Moonlit Fair sales. Everything's been going smoothly.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: But I'm not sure if people will dig our new pastries, so I'm having them taste and give feedback.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The waterfall near Bell-Borne Ravine… This should be the place.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I'll find a good spot for my photo.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: What else… Lemme think… I can't let the riddle updates fall behind…

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Sure! Now, the first riddle is... Oh, why don't we let Madam Magistrate tell you herself?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Alright. Here's a riddle… "What finds joy in making others smile with glittering lights, even at its own cost?"
The answer is fireworks.
The answer is Jinhsi.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Hehe… I knew it would be easy for you to solve. Guess my special gift has finally found its owner.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Jinhsi blinks in astonishment, then quickly breaks into a smile.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Hehe, you always surprise me, but unfortunately, that's not the right answer.
Looks like I can't get your special gift.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: If you want it, I can always make another one for you.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: There are still plenty other riddles to solve. Those give various gifts too! Give them a try!

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Oh, Madam Magistrate! Are you here to solve riddles or perhaps share some new ones?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: {PlayerName}'s going to take home all the rewards at this rate, I'm afraid.
I'm not that good at solving riddles.
Then I have to quit for other people's sake.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: You're too modest. Indeed, this event is for everyone. Others deserve a chance to win, too.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Hehe, indeed, this event is for everyone. Others deserve a chance to win, too.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: {PlayerName}, how about we check out other stalls?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Mr. Xieyang, excuse us. We'll leave you to your riddle-making. May your creativity flow and your inspiration never end.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Thank you! Happy Moon-Chasing Festival to you both!
You came up with the riddles?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Yes. When I was reviewing the stall applications earlier, I noticed a lantern riddles stall. I remembered a couple riddles I had solved before, so I wrote them down.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But I'm not sure if they were selected.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Those riddles you provided are just perfect! They're so simple and clever. I've put them all up.

speaker: Tà Dương
anh_en: Unfortunately, no one has solved them to claim the special gift you prepared yet.
What riddles? I wanna try.
A special gift from Jinhsi? I wanna try.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Fireworks! Fireworks! Fireworks of all kinds! You can even make your own!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I'm glad I could help.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Here, take these fireworks as a gift! Thanks to you, these beautiful colors remain intact.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Me?

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: But storage's tough for this one. Any temp or humidity change can mess up the colors.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I see. We will make sure to handle them carefully. Thank you!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: You're welcome! Feel free to come back for more!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Madam Magistrate, wait up! See any fireworks you like? My treat, take your pick!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Without your help, this stall wouldn't be set up so smoothly.
Her help...?

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Yeah, Madam Magistrate did me a big favor.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: I used to keep all my goods in a warehouse across the river.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: You know, fireworks need special care to prevent accidents, so I tried to take fireproof and waterproof measures, did whatever I could.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: When Madam Magistrate heard about it, she helped me find a better storage place.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Otherwise, the quality could've suffered, and there might've been safety risks.
I feel the same.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But... have you had enough fun yet?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: You've made my wish come true. Now let's go do what you'd like to do.
We are already doing just that, walking under the moon together.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: "May we meet under the full moon's light, our bond unbroken, ever bright."
You look so happy.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I'm so glad our hard work paid off. Seeing the Moonlit Fair's success is truly heartwarming.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I always knew we could do it, but witnessing it firsthand is truly touching.
Then let's spend some more time here.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I've already had the most out of it.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: As I walked around, I saw genuine smiles on the visitors' faces, and the vendors were passionately running their stalls.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Everyone here is enjoying the fair… and this is exactly what I wished to see.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: {PlayerName}, thank you for showing me around. It's been a truly joyful experience because you are here with me.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I'm sorry. Though I do practice Taoism, geomancy and fortune-telling aren't my strong suit.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: His moon-reading skill was said to be exceptional. Uh, I guess you're not familiar with it, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: You half fill a specially crafted porcelain bowl with pure water, recite an incantation, and observe the reflection of the full moon in the water to discern fortune and misfortune. That's the moon-reading divination.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: When that diviner performed it, the water would emit a golden glow, adding a touch of mystery to the moon's reflection.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Unfortunately, no one knew where he went. It's said that when he left Jinzhou, he left a letter and a divination lot.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: In the letter, he mentioned meeting a mysterious person in Jinzhou. After a deep conversation on divination, he felt his understanding was too shallow and lost interest in reading divination books.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Frustrated, he decided to give up his career, but he couldn't bear to part with the porcelain bowl that had accompanied him for years. So, he hid it somewhere in Jinzhou.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Then, he left a divination lot as a clue, hoping someone would find it one day.
Is that the divination lot you wanted Jianxin to decipher?

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: That's right. Since the bowl belongs to that famous master, it must be great for divinations. So I want to have it on my stall and enhance my credibility.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Though I haven't heard of this divination master, Uncle Dong does have a point. In this line of work, possessing powerful artifacts does lend credibility to one's abilities.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Moreover, this matter concerns chance, and you can't force it.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I bet that master would be happy to see his treasure recognized by people again.
What did the divination lot say?

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Oh, haha, I almost forgot our main business. It says, "To seek your true self, observe the lake at a deck. Place your trust in innocent young souls."

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: This lot doesn't seem related to fortune-telling, so I'm a bit confused. Any thoughts, {PlayerName}?
It mentions a location.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: A deck where people can appreciate the lake… Do we have a place like that in Jinzhou?

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: I've been to several places that match the description. Found nothing so far. Perhaps the time wasn't right.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Anyway, as long as we have a clue, there's a way to find it! Uncle Dong, we'll help you find that porcelain bowl!
Yeah, you can count on us.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Great! I'll be sure to pay you a hefty sum! Best of luck, Jianxin, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: I see. Sigh, then I'll come up with something else.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: That might be the best solution.
What happened?

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Oh, hi, {PlayerName}. It's nothing big. Uncle Dong asked me to help him decipher a divination lot, but… I'm not skilled in that art.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: It's a long story. Although I know a bit of divination, I'm self-taught. So, I decided to find something to lend some credibility to my efforts.
Something to lend your credibility?

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Yeah. Long ago, a famous diviner visited Jinzhou, rumored to possess the gift of communicating with spirits and predicting destinies. People flocked to him for guidance.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Observe the lake at a deck… Seems like this is the place the divination lot implies.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: And the next line… " The pure heart of a child shouldn't be doubted." We may need to look for children nearby.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: You're right. There might be clues around here.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Lalala…

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Cats… What's your take, {PlayerName}?
It's indeed worth our attention.
Let's go check it out.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: A-are you Patrollers?
Sorry, we're not.
We're here for treasure hunting.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: A-are you bad people, then...?

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Haha, of course not. We're here for a long-lost treasure.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: A treasure?! That sounds cool!

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: A treasure?! That sounds cool!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Hello there, little girl.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: But Mommy probably won't let me join you. Never mind, I'll cheer you on from the sidelines!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Thank you, young miss. We'll definitely find the treasure!

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Yeah!

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Hi? How can I help you?
Seen anything strange about lately?

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Something strange…? I come here a lot, but something strange...

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Oh, yeah! The cats!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Cats…?

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Yeah, that's right! There's a spot around here where cats love to stay.

speaker: NPC #700060
anh_en: Often saw them just sitting there, not moving at all. Mom said they're fishing in the lake but...

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Look! I found it! It's a wooden casket. Hmm? What is that smell?
You and Jianxin open the porcelain bowl. However, except for some herbs wrapped in silk pouches, there is only a yellowed piece of paper.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I seek my true self, but the paths are unclear. Blurring my vision, fueling my fear. I hesitate, I question, and I wander. My cart dust-covered, yet no path feels right, I ponder. Seems quite similar to that divination lot.
Another clue.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I can't seem to figure out what is says. Any idea, {PlayerName}?
I may have an idea.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Great! Knew I can count on you!
It smells like medicine.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: There must be some kind of medicine in here that lasts a long time and attracts cats.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: It's interesting, but I just don't get it... Could someone actually predict a kid would solve this puzzle years later?
Maybe he trusted a child's curiosity.
Maybe there indeed was a way.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: True. Kids have pure hearts, free from adult worries. They often have a keen eye for details that we miss.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: My master was right; divination isn't just about lies and trickery… Sadly, I'm not gifted with the talent to fully master it.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Shall we open this casket? We may find the porcelain bowl inside.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: My cart dust-covered… Oh, look, there's an old cart. Looks like it hasn't been maintained for years.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I'll go search around!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: From here I can see the entirety of the Jinzhou City.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I should take a photo here.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I found it, {PlayerName}!
Let's go check it out.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Sure! We'll find out soon enough!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Another wooden casket. But it feels way too light... Don't tell me there's another piece of paper inside…
Probably.
That master really thought he was being funny, I guess.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Seeking my true self, I travel wide. In the stall where fortunes amass, emptiness resides. This must be the next clue.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: In the stall where fortunes amass… That probably means the Main Street?
You're so clever, Jianxin!
You're getting good at reading divination lots!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Haha, just a guess. We still don't know if I got it right.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: There are so many stores on the Main Street… I guess we have to search them one by one.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall" we can probably cross out large stores from our list.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Good point. We should focus on the small vendor stalls, right?

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you're right. The clue does point to a vendor stall.
You may be right.
Is that so…?

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Anyway, let's bring it back to Uncle Dong.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: This wooden casket is heavy. I think the porcelain bowl is inside. Shall we open it, {PlayerName}?
Sure.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: The treasure left by that divination master is inside… The thought makes me a bit nervous.
You and Jianxin open the wooden casket. Inside there is an ordinary looking black porcelain bowl.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Is this the treasure we've been searching for? But it looks…
It looks like an ordinary porcelain bowl.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: I see. Just as the saying goes, "Great music has the faintest notes; the Great Form is without shape." Maybe the more precious the treasure, the less eye-catching it is.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Perhaps it only shines when used in divination.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Oh, you're back! How's it going? Did you find the bowl?
You stole my word.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: …Well, I'm certain the bowl you found is the one left by that master of divination.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: But now, it seems to be an ordinary bowl used for divination, and that's all.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: How can that be…

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: I'm actually not surprised the bowl didn't work. These kind of stories are usually just hearsay, and it looks like this one is no different.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: That master might have been good at divination, but people exaggerated his skills.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: I love operas and shows, but come on—heroes performing impossible feats and warriors moving mountains? It's all embellished for entertainment.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: So you mean the bowl is useless?

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: No, far from it! While it may not have "magic," it's still a treasure worth cherishing. Remember, what defines a treasure is not its practicality, young one!

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: It's the story behind it that matters. A good story. A story rich in twists and turns.
Yes, we did, but…

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Ah, I see now.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Anyway, thank you, {PlayerName}, Jianxin. Thank you for helping me find this bowl.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: With the presence of this porcelain bowl, my reputation as a professional fortune-teller will surely flourish!
It doesn't look like a treasure.

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: Thank you. It's okay. According to the record, we need to fill it with fresh water and recite the moon-reading incantation…

speaker: Chú Đổng
anh_en: When the moon casts its reflection on the water, you'll witness its magic.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Wow, that sounds amazing! Hurry, let's try it out, Uncle Dong!
Uncle Dong fills the porcelain bowl halfway with water and recites the incantation, but nothing happens.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Wait, where's the golden glow…?
I just see moonlight.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: So this is it. Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: But how… well, let me think…

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Oh! I know! I just got a new paycheck. I should treat you to a meal!
Great!
I can't wait!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Order whatever you like!

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Sigh... I wanted to see the legendary golden glow and its extraordinary power, but it turns out to be just an ordinary bowl.
You look frustrated.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Yes, a little bit. But Uncle Dong seemed happy. Maybe that ordinary bowl is indeed a treasure to him.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: Honestly, I'm more embarrassed than frustrated.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: You've been with me the whole time, searching and solving riddles, but we've just come up empty...
It's okay.
Never mind.

speaker: Giám Tâm
anh_en: No! I can't just let it go. I must repay you somehow for all the work you've done for me.

speaker: NPC #700069
anh_en: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}.
Are you here for "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"?

speaker: NPC #700069
anh_en: What? Oh, not really… So this is the stall for that Gulpuff game? My apologies. My eyes aren't as sharp as they used to be.

speaker: NPC #700069
anh_en: My son is a Resonator. He might like this, I guess...
Your son?

speaker: NPC #700069
anh_en: Yes. He's a Midnight Ranger. They gave him a few day off. When he comes back, I plan to visit the Moonlit Fair with him.

speaker: NPC #700069
anh_en: Haha, I'm sure he'll have a lot of fun.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... I should leave more space to make the contrast pop. And perhaps I'll do some wet in wet, add a touch of vermilion here, to bring out the peach trees?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: No, that might make it too blurry. The customers at the Moonlit Fair prefer more realistic details...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Zhezhi seems deeply focused. She should have no problem working on the paintings. I'll get going and do Dianxiao's request…)
As you leave, Zhezhi glances back, puzzled.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Uh... Did I just see someone out of the corner of my eye?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: {Male=He;Female=She} felt... familiar?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Nevermind… I'm probably just seeing things after staying up too late.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: How did it go, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Good news…?

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: I suppose you can skip the fieldwork for once. Take a look at this!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: These are… reference photos? The Bell-Borne Ravine's waterfall, and panorama view of Jinzhou City...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Th-these are exactly what I need… Thank you, Dianxiao!

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: No, I'm not the one you should be thanking. A certain kind person volunteered to help.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: A kind person...

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Yeah, {Male=he;Female=she} took these photos for you. I'd never dare go to places like Bell-Borne Ravine.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: (Could it be... the person I saw near those peach trees...)

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: What's the matter, Zhezhi?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: N-nothing! Excuse me, I-I need to work on the painting…!
Here, the reference photos.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: (...I'll be sure to thank {Male=him;Female=her} the next time we meet.)
Easy peasy.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Fantastic! Great angles, great details. Yes, they would make excellent reference images.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Thank you so much. I'll pass them on to Zhezhi once she's back!
See you next time.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: See you, {PlayerName}!
A few minutes later...

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Hey, Zhezhi! Good news!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Oh, here you are, {PlayerName}.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Indeed, I have many affairs to attend to, but I think Madam Magistrate was exaggerating.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Sanhua has eight hundred matters to handle simultaneously, she wrote… That's impossible. Not even the Academy's computers could do that.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: W-why are you making that suggestion all of a sudden?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: … I know. Madam Jinhsi must have said something in this letter.
Is there anything you want to do?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I suggest we first patrol the nearby area. The Moonlit Fair has attracted many visitors, and any incursion by Tacet Discords or criminals could have dire consequences.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Or, we could survey the visitors to evaluate their interests, providing reliable data for future events.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Or, we could…
STOP!!!
Enough of work! PLEASE!
Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Yes, {PlayerName}? Is there something wrong with my plans?
I want to know what YOU want to do.
We're here to relax, remember?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I apologize. I forgot I'm not in City Hall handling affairs right now.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Something I want to do… Please give me a moment.
I remember you were eyeing the desserts at Yumyum Haven?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Yes, I've never actually seen anyone make that dessert before. It's called... Plumpcake, right?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Similar to Wuthercake but with different fillings and shapes. I bet it has a unique taste.
Would you like some of that?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: No, I simply want to learn how to make it, then I can…

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: No, I'm here for work today. Madam Jinhsi entrusted me with this letter for you.
Great. Then let's learn how to make Plumpcake!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Sure. I've watched them make it enough to have a general idea of how to do it myself.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Besides, I have some new ideas… Can we go gather the ingredients together?
New ideas?
Ingredients?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: There's a special lotus seed called Twin Lotus Seed, found near lakes in the Whining Aix's Mire.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I once read about it in The Grand Library. It has a unique fragrance.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I believe using it in the Plumpcake would elevate the flavor.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But it's rare and only grows where Tacet Discords roam, making it hard to come by.
I'm ready to go get some of that.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: As you're involved with the Moonlit Fair, she may have something important to discuss with you.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Then let's get going, {PlayerName}.
As you open the letter, you realize it contains no pressing matters. It simply mentions that Sanhua has been shouldering a heavy workload at City Hall.
Jinhsi expresses concern and suggests taking her to the Moonlit Fair for some much-needed relaxation.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Have you finished reading it, {PlayerName}? Do you have any messages you would like me to convey?
(Tell her the content of the letter.)
How about taking a walk with me?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: These are the Twin Lotus Seeds I wanted. I think we have picked enough of them.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: But I don't have much time for that. After all, Madam Jinhsi's safety is always my top priority.
Are you really that busy?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I'm afraid so. Jinzhou is located on the borders, and safety has been a constant concern. But my workload may lessen in a few years.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: The Threnodian is no longer a threat, and everything is getting back on track. I am positive life will be tranquil for our people soon.
I'm looking forward to that day.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: So am I, {PlayerName}.
I'm a bit curious…
What do you usually do?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: My main duty is to protect Madam Jinhsi.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I also assist her with paperwork, meet visitors, and convey her orders to other departments.
...What do you do except work?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Let me think… I sometimes drink flower wine… but not too much, as overdrinking leads to mistakes, which would affect my performance as a guard.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Other times, I listen to the storytellers. I learn about how other people live their lives, how they respond to life's ups and downs, and everything in this world that I cannot witness myself.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: In fact, I learned from a story that Twin Lotus Seeds taste better than ordinary ones.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Welcome, {PlayerName} and Lady Sanhua! What can I get for you?
Sanhua can definitely nail it.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: You can count on me. I just observed the baking process a bit more, and I have memorized it all.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Alright, I'll let you use my stove.
Count me in!

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Please peel the lotus seeds for me.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Lotus seeds…? No, these are…

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Twin Lotus Seeds, freshly picked. Baking them at high temperatures brings out their fresh fragrance. I'll be using them to enhance the taste.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: But these are said to only grow in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire, where many monsters live...

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: ...On second thought, with {PlayerName} and Lady Sanhua, getting those seeds would be a breeze. Can't wait for your Plumpcake!
Soon, Sanhua effortlessly recreates the Plumpcake with her incredible talents.
We want to learn how to make Plumpcake.
Onlookers pause to applaud her mastery in action.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Done. {PlayerName}, please give it a try.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: How do you like it?
It's amazing!
Not bad, I guess?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Thank you. I'm glad you like it.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: …{PlayerName}, you are not fooling me with your expression and change in frequencies. You find it delightful, don't you?
Sanhua boxes up the fresh Plumpcakes, then hands a box to you.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: This is for you, {PlayerName}.
And the other box is...

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Haha, you've come to the right person. Plumpcake is a traditional dessert that's been around for at least a few hundred years.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: That is for Madam Jinhsi. Since you enjoyed the Plumpcakes I made... I think she'll like it too.
What about you? You haven't tasted any yet.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Me? I don't need it. Eating cake isn't part of my duty.
But Jinhsi wants you to enjoy the festival.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I see… So that's what Madam Jinhsi really wanted to convey?
...Don't tell me you're only getting it now...
Life isn't just about work, you know.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As Sanhua gazes at the bustling scene unfolding before her, her mind seems elsewhere, captivated by the brilliance of fireworks and streetlights reflecting in her eyes.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Now I get it. Festivities like this help people let go of the past's sorrows and the future's unknowns…

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: It's a chance to live in the moment with their loved ones. Finding joy in the little things in life.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Not many people can make it nowadays. I bet most of the youngsters have never seen one.
Yes, I think so.
She just wanted you to be happy.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: Thank you for your company, {PlayerName}. I had a great time today.
What would you like to do next?

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: I don't have a plan yet. I will probably continue enjoying the Moonlit Fair, just as Madam Jinhsi hoped. Perhaps the tasks on my to-do list aren't as urgent as they seem.

speaker: San'hua
anh_en: If you need me for anything, you need only call. I'll be by your side right away, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Though it might seem easy, making Plumpcake takes a lot of effort.

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Kneading the dough and preparing the fillings are just the beginning—every step has its secrets. It takes at least a year or two of practice to get that perfect crispy texture with a lingering aftertaste.
That's a lot of practice…

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: You know, when I learned how to make it, I spent three whole days just memorizing the recipe!
Anyway, let's give it a try first.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: A-are you here to help "Dorothy"?

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Please help, {Male=Mr. ;Female=Miss }{PlayerName}... I have no one else to turn to.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Help me beat them and get me home. My entire collection is all yours...
Why do you know my name?
That sounds oddly familiar...

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Ah, well... Because I've met you on the other side of the Gate before... Hehe.
Really?

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Yeah, it's true. Time works in a way that is a little more complicated than what you may think. Sometimes our memory stems not from the past, but from the future.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: It's like an never-ending loop...

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Oh, I guess it's what they call a feeling of déjà vu? You look so kind, you must've been helping other people often.
Really?
What happened here?

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Yeah, it's not unusual for a kind person like you to hear such a request. Whether in the past, or in the future.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Anyway... Those monsters are really scary. Make sure you're prepared. My friends and I on the other side will do our best to help.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: <color=Highlight>As long as you and your companions aren't knocked out at the same time, I will save you no matter how many times you fall. Dorothy always stays true to her word!</color>
You can even do that?
That sounds like a lot of work.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Yes, but I'll be okay. I must get rid of those pesky things to help my friends return home...
I'll give it a try.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Great! I know you can do it!

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: I... I'm not sure.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Dorothy can't find the way home... I saw Mr. White Cat and wanted to pet it. I chased after it, and before I realized, I had walked through that gate and ended up here.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: And Mr. White Cat was no where to be found... I wanted to go back, but scary monsters started showing up...
That sounds like the gate to the Somnoire...
You shouldn't go through unfamiliar gates.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: I wanna go home...

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: But not even Dorothy's friend can beat those monsters.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Thank you! Now my friends can all go home!

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Aww... I should've saw this coming. A child's dream persona is still too naive. Can't expect her to learn how to hide her true self...

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Not like I ever wanted to hide it from you forever, though...
So you lied to me.
You're that "Cosmos" from before, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Lying? Not quite. At least I can promise you... Everything I've told you this time is true.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Dorothy is a good girl. She won't ever intentionally lie to anyone, not even in a dream.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Not bad, {PlayerName}, you've figured it out already... Yes. You can say that was me.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: I found the dream of a troublemaker and copied it into a Wooly plushie in the dream world.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: And then... I was able to manifest in Solaris-3 and talk to you.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Figured it'd be simpler for us to talk like this, with our real positions and identities making things tricky.
Your friends?

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Come on, don't give me that suspicious side eye... I offered to pay you accordingly. It's been a fair deal, right?
What are you trying to do?

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: ...Sorry, I can't say. Not yet.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: But it may not take long before the right time comes.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: And when it happens... I hope you'll understand my choice, {PlayerName}.
Dorothy falls silent, looking down at her toes.
I thought you said YOU wanted to go home?

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: Yeah, the current "me" you're talking to belongs to the other side of the Gate.

speaker: NPC #750089
anh_en: ...But when it comes to us in another point in time... Our home is right here, on this side.
You live in the Somnoire?
Who are you?
Dorothy falls silent, looking down at her toes.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Ah, you figured it out so fast. I guess a child's dream persona is still too naive.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Hmm... Let's try it here, {PlayerName}.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: So we just set it on the ground, light it here... and ta-da! It's a fireworks show!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Something's not right... Encore, throw that thing away!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: *cough*... Are you... Are you okay, {PlayerName}?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Hmm, I see... I guess his daughter is gonna feel let down this year.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: ...Do you hear something, {PlayerName}?
TDs. They must've been drawn by the explosion.
TDs. And quite a few of them too.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Hey, Encore has an idea. How about we use the rest of these firecrackers on them, {PlayerName}?
You mean...?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Yep, trying new things is a big part of adventuring!
That was... way too big of an explosion.
I'm okay. You?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Encore's alright. Not a scratch. Wasn't scared at all.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: But... Are fireworks supposed to be like that?
Not really... These are some very powerful firecrackers.
Pretty sure something went wrong.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: ...Phew. That's most of the firecrackers. Those TDs didn't even stand a chance!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Let's head back, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Encore! How did it go? Did the fireworks go out with a bang?
On second thought. Maybe... It can be put to use elsewhere.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Wait... you're saying we can use this against the TDs? That might actually work out...

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: I'll talk to the guys at Lollo Logistics and see if they'll give it a shot... Thanks for all your help today, you two!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Don't mention it, Mr. Xisha! Encore got a super cool story out of it!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: {PlayerName} and the Woolies vanquished all the monsters in the forest. Despite not finding her flowers, the princess brought peace back to the woods!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: ...Do you understand what she's talking about, {PlayerName}?
More or less.
Haven't the slightest clue.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Whew, I wish I could... Then I may figure out where my daughter's getting all those wackadoo ideas from.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Ha... My daughter's like that too. Kids these days, you never know what's going on in their heads.
It was a really loud bang...

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Speaking of my daughter. Thought I finally got it right this time... But it seems I'll have to keep tweaking my formulas. Can't give up just yet.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: You can do it, Mr. Xisha! I believe in you!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: You betcha. Thanks, Encore!
Those were NOT fireworks...

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Huh? What do you mean...?
You tell Xisha what happened.

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: Good heavens...

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: I'm so sorry, {PlayerName}. Are you alright? Did you guys get hurt?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: No, not at all. {PlayerName} had me covered!

speaker: Tây Sa
anh_en: *Sigh* I'm glad to hear that. I should get rid of that formula.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, Rover! Ya wanna give this a shot?

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: These aren't like the ones you tried at my stall—trust me, they'll be the craziest challenge of your life!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Jeepers! I gotta try that out!

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Go ahead, knock yourself out. You can even help me get a feel for the difficulty while you're at it.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: What are we waiting for, {PlayerName}? Let's go!
Which is...?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well, you're lookin' at it. Moon Shooter. Been helping Qingxi test out the new targets.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Just beat my personal best, but.. I'm still nowhere near the all-time record.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: I mean, that record holder hit multiple targets with one shot, can't top that. It's crazy how they pulled it off.
You're very good at it already.
These targets move really fast...

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Ready for the real deal, Chixia? I've made some intense Moon Shooter challenges just for the pros.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: But I ran out of space here at the Fair... So I moved them to a safe area nearby.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Over here, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hehe... I hope Qingxi's not gonna disappoint.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You're probably just not warmed up yet. C'mon, another one!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: ...That's it? Welp, Qingxi was right about these being harder than the ones back at the stall. Just a teeny bit though.
I know, right?
It's already pretty difficult for the average folk.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Guess we'll have to look forward to Qinxi's ultimate challenge. She's definitely saving the best for last.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: She must have tougher challenges for us. Instructor Yhan wouldn't have asked her to train the rookies otherwise.
Really?
And that's exactly what you want, right?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Alright. She's got me all fired up now!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Bring it on, Qinxi. I'm game for whatever you're gonna throw at me!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: ...There it is, Rover!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Time to give this ultimate challenge a spin!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well, that was something... Humph. But it'll take more than that for me to call it quits! Oh, no, you don't!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I'm not done yet! Again!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: What's that, Mr. Li? Looks really yummy!

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: It's called the Plumpcake. A traditional dessert passed down in Jinzhou for thousands of years. Try it, you'll love it.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Thousands of years... Then there's gotta be cool stories about it. Right, Mr. Li? Do you know any?

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: Hmm... Actually, I do. Let's see...

speaker: Chú Lê
anh_en: This is a story that dates back to the two Sentinels of Huanglong...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Nice. Haven't broken so much sweat while target shooting in a long time. Ha. Not bad, Qingxi. Not bad at all...
That's way over the top for an amusement game.
That was so intense my hands were shaking.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That last challenge was really something, huh? But we made it through either way! Gimme five, Rover. Yeah!
Chixia raises her hand in excitement as she gives Rover a high five.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Haha. When we team up, we're unstoppable!
Yeah! We're unstoppable!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: C'mon! Back to Qingxi's!

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: You're back. Looks like you managed to beat all the challenges.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey, Qingxi. You forgetting someone?

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Pfft. Ya think? Oh, I know what you're thinkin', all right—

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Easy as shooting fish in a barrel.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: H-How'd you guess that?!
...Read you like a book.
Perseverance is a good trait.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Care to give me some pointers on pistol training, Chixia?

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Who knows? Maybe we can promote your skills among the Rangers!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Tips? It's just hard work, hard work, and more hard work!
