anh_en: They are trying to escape from this space and return to the real world they once strove to save.

speaker: NPC #800088
anh_en: We are not here to prove that resistance is futile, but to mark that… we don't go down without a fight…

speaker: NPC #800088
anh_en: When those who follow see our gravestones, they will understand… humanity never surrenders…

speaker: NPC #800088
anh_en: We won't retreat… ██. This is our final task… Not everyone is lucky enough to bear this responsibility…

speaker: NPC #800088
anh_en: We're so close to getting the accurate modeling of ██… Just give me a bit more time, as long as it's before the Lament strikes…

speaker: NPC #800088
anh_en: Gravity... is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still holds true today…

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you've helped them break free from their hopeless quest to return home.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: With the help of those two Gatekeepers, you will surely surely help to restore this place back to normal.
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: It's just… who knows when we'll meet again in our dreams.
Let's meet one day when we wake up.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Yes, when we wake up... tomorrow.
So, that's it? It's over?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Those scattered dreams will still wander this realm, but they won't be burdened by those overwhelming desires anymore.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Do you regret putting an end to those longings and obsessions?
Their spirits still remain.
They will live on in our memories, won't they?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: You are right. The time has come.
What time?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: The Black Shores in a dream is not where I truly belong… I must go.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You sorted out those dream masses. Well done.
Why are you here?
Where's the Ivory Gatekeeper?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: He's trying to contain those scattered dream fragments.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But it's not an easy job to retrieve them all in such a vast realm as the Somnoire.
You're not to blame for that.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Don't worry, I'll come up with a plan...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Never stop exploring, Dreamwalker. Only in dreams will we find the answers we need.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Welcome back, Dreamwalker.
Like creating a big "zip file" of dreams?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Exactly! It's a workaround for the space issue, but now those compressed dreams have turned into abnormal masses.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: They're wreaking havoc around here. They keep absorbing other dreams to grow stronger, causing even more chaos.
Can't you stop them from merging?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I tried, but I don't have the right clearance. The Somnoire's self-cleaning function is also currently disabled.
Where's the Ebony Gatekeeper?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I'm still searching for him. He may still be in deep slumber, recovering his strength…

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Dreamwalker, keep exploring and restoring the Somnoire. Stay alert, there's no telling what you'll encounter.
Of course, you can count on me.
(Pet the white cat)
I didn't expect to see you again so soon.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Thank you, Dreamwalker.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Meow… Hey! I'm not a cat anymore!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: This will help you on your journey. Use it wisely.
Is this the Ebony Gatekeeper's work again?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: No, quite the opposite, actually. This is happening because he lost most of his power and influence.
I liked you better as that white cat.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Well, like I said before, there are still many things to handle within the gateway.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Ahem… I'm back in action now, so let's not dilly-dally with all of that

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Since your last visit, the Somnoire has stopped expanding into reality and is gradually returning to its normal state.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: However, those extra dreams haven't all been released yet…
What happened to those dreams?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: The overloaded Somnoire started "packing" those dreams to save space.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Watch out! Those dream fragments were drawn here and are now forming into a mass!

speaker: NPC #800090
anh_en: We have nowhere to go… and you have nowhere to run…

speaker: NPC #800090
anh_en: One after another, I see them leave… How many more goodbyes must I endure? Oh, how I wish I could go home…

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: The crisis has finally come to an end. I can't thank you enough for your help.
Looks like he's capable of doing the right thing after all.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Both he and I are Observers of the Somnoire tasked with maintaining its stability. If either of us goes unchecked, it's bad news for the entire realm.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: If there ever comes a day when I lose control, please, stop me.
What?
Are you saying you might go rogue someday?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Just a jest. But now, it's time to say farewell—

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: To thoroughly investigate the faults in the Somnoire, we'll need to temporarily sever its connection to the real world.
We'll see each other again, right?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Absolutely. No matter how long the night lasts, we shall always reunite in the light of day.
Are you sure it's really over?
I am certain this isn't the end of it.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I... can't make any guarantees. The world inside this gateway always finds a way to create new problems.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: By the way, have you noticed our surroundings?
This is where we had our showdown with the black cat.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Exactly. The Ebony Gatekeeper created this Memory Zone to draw in all those abnormal dreams, forcing you to confront them all at once.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: As a trade-off... he probably needs to sleep for a while.
So, this is the "plan" he talked about.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Huh... it seems like we find ourselves together in this dream again.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: A-anyway. You have something urgent to attend to, right?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: While you were away, I went on a field trip to gather inspiration and do some sketching.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I didn't have time to perfect all the details, but... I-I hope you can take this with you. Maybe it'll be helpful!
Hello, Zhezhi.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: We just said our goodbyes, and here we are again so soon. Is it because I can't stop thinking about showing {PlayerName} my paintings...?
You said that out loud.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Oh! Um… W-well, actually, I'm really happy to see you again.
Louder, please.
Me too.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: P-please don't tease me! Um… By the way, I remember you have something urgent to attend to, right?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Wh-what…? You feel the same?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Adventure calls!
Hooray!
Adventure never ends.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: This time, the big bad guy is the White Cat Demon King! It's taken over the palace in the Kingdom of Grapes and is turning everyone's dreams into a mess!
You do know the Demon King is standing right beside you, right?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Humph! I can't believe the mighty Demon King actually came to the Warrior's Village to stop the hero before {Male=he;Female=she} even sets out!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: But don't worry! Mayor Encore was ready for this!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: O brave Warrior, take our strongest Echo—it will help you on your quest!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I hear trouble is brewing in the dreams, huh?
That's just how things go in the dream world.
I'm here to handle it.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Looks like dangers are lurking in this dream world, just like in reality…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: If you let your mind wander for a second, you never know what might jump out at you.
So, are you here to help?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Of course, darling. We share the same goal, after all.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: By the way, I found this nearby. Here, take it.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Let's finish up here quickly, and in return for my little gift... Promise me you'll save some time for me in the real world, okay?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Well, well, I didn't think we could have this kind of fun here.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, take this little cutie with you and hurry back, my seed of fate.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Do whatever you want—let's make it more intense, more fiery, more electrifying than the real world…
I'll handle you later.
You're next once I've handled things here.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Are you going to keep me waiting again? Why can't we fight right now?
Because I have something urgent to take care of.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Fine… I'll behave. There's still plenty of time for us, hehe.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I can feel it... Those chaotic energies are gathering somewhere. Looks like there's a big surprise in store for you.
I'll be right back.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I was musing about their relationship.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Just my humble opinion. No need to dwell on it. Here, take this pouch. It may prove useful on your journey.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: By the way, I'd love to hear about your adventures when you're back, if you have time.
Do you mean the dynamics between the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeepers?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes, the Somnoire's guardians. Are they rivals or allies?
I think it's a bit of both.
Sometimes they work together, and other times they clash.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hmm… They're like two sides of the same coin—interdependent yet counterbalancing. The Somnoire reflects that balance.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The recent disturbances were the result of a series of actions that tipped the scales, rather than the fault of one side going off track.
So, we need to restore the balance.
Are you suggesting I shouldn't favor the Ivory Gatekeeper?

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: I knew you'd come back…

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: There are many terrifying things ahead. They are devouring every dream they find.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: I can see them... all the dreams, both sweet and nightmarish, trapped inside those giant masses...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Free those dreams, just like you did before…

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Dreamwalker, may your mind stay lucid, and may your steps be light.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: {PlayerName}, good to see you again!
Maybe so.
He helped a lot, didn't he?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Anyway, now that we're back, let's shake things up! No regrets when we wake up!

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Oh, by the way, I ran into this quiet lady on my way here. She asked me to deliver this package to you.
A package?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Yep! Just sign here, and—another satisfied customer!
Lumi?
Why are you still here?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Why can't I be here? Are you worried that I might be someone else?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: There are still lots of messes to clean up, and besides, the dream's not over yet.
You remember what happened before, right?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Of course! We teamed up and took down that big cat, right?

speaker: NPC #1437
anh_en: Don't ya know dreams can pick up where they left off? Must be thanks to that Ivory Gatekeeper, huh?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Sigh, you must have noticed the Ebony Gatekeeper by now, right? I finally found him.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: We were supposed to keep the balance in the Somnoire together… but now, things have spiraled out of control.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: There are dream masses just up ahead.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Dreamwalker, please stay vigilant. I wish you the best of luck.
Meow three times, and I'll think about it.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I understand. Thank you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ugh… Fine.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Meow! Meow! Meow!
Don't you have anything to say?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: These masses are devouring other dreams, threatening the stability of the entire Somnoire…

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: With what power I have left in me, I'm afraid I can no longer rein them in. I need your help.
You don't sound like you're asking for help.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I know I made a few missteps in trying to save more dreams. I don't expect you to forgive me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But I am as devastated as anyone to see the Somnoire collapse. You have to believe me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I'm… sincerely begging for your help.
Alright, but I'm not doing this for you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Impressive work. These dream masses are disintegrating.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
What happens now?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Well, they're breaking down into dream fragments now. In time, they might form something new. I'll track them down, but...
But what?
You really need to finish your sentences.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Our actions had unexpected repercussions. More dream masses are escaping the Somnoire. The boundary between reality and dreams is rapidly deteriorating.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I cannot predict what will happen next.
I've gotten used to surprises.
Don't worry. I can handle whatever comes.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abandoned buildings and platforms… I didn't see anything like this before.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like things are shifting again inside the Somnoire…

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: As expected, our paths shall always cross, even in dreams.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: I sense those wishes, memories, and obsessions are turning into something familiar yet dangerous.
What will happen then?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: The existing data isn't enough to provide a clear answer...

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: In the worst case, this dreamscape could collapse under their impact.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: But don't worry. I will use my power to stabilize this realm, and I will stay by your side until the end of your journey.
Alright, let's face this together.
Our goal is to resolve this crisis, right?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Yes. {PlayerName}, if you ever lose your way, call my name.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Remember, I am always here, right by your side.
You come here too?
I'm surprised that you also dream.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Yes. Your arrival provided an opening for me to enter this realm.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Yes, and in the few dreams I have, your presence is always there.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: You have probably noticed that this place looks similar to the Black Shores.
Will the Black Shores be affected in reality?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Not at this moment, but this dreamscape is on the brink of collapsing.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Dreams of the Black Shores are gathering, mingling with those from other realms.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: An entity like this shouldn't exist in a dream… But now that I'm here, let me be of use to you.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: You're back, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hmm... Looks like we need to investigate this further.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: From here on out, Passenger, we'll be delving deeper into the Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The Ebony Gatekeeper and I will go with you as well. Let's work together and get this sorted out once and for all.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I have some good news for you. We have some leads about the Somnoire anomaly.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Based on a theory the Ebony Gatekeeper and I have been working on, this anomaly may be related to the dreams of the Left Behind.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Their dreamscape blurred the line between what is real and what is not. That is why Honami City and Lahai-Roi have become intertwined.
So the Left Behind can dream as well?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Yes. Whether it's the Left Behind or us, everyone has wishes that can only be fulfilled in the dreamland.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It is a Sonoro Sphere woven from the dreams of the Left Behind, similar to the Somnoire, yet not the same...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Yes, let's call it the "Lost Dreams" for now.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: But strangely enough... if it was just the Left Behind dreaming, it shouldn't have caused spatial distortion like this.

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Ugh, I really don't want to wake up... How am I supposed to face my mom after flunking the exam this badly...

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: All right, I know this is all my fault. Once I wake up tomorrow, I'll go tell my mom everything...

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Umm, cards, you'll have to wait for me, okay!? After I'm done with my makeup exam, I'll take you all out to take on new challengers!

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: If only I had one more week, no, even an extra day... or even a few more hours!

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: If I'd just flipped through a few more pages of my notes or done a couple more exercises... Sigh... Who am I kidding? It's all too late.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If you didn't study for your exam, where did you spend all your time?

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Playing card games and opening packs.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What?

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Well...You know, a bunch of card games came out recently, right? After my classmates dragged me into it, I couldn't stop.

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Every day, I woke up to the same routine. Play cards, open packs, play cards, open packs... Rinse and repeat.

speaker: NPC #850483
anh_en: Look, check out this SSR I pulled yesterday! Awesome, right?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh my, so this dreamer failed his exam so badly that he doesn't want to wake up...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Card games... Are they really that addictive?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: There was a card game featuring me on the cover that was quite popular in Honami.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It was a big deal for a while, but then... uh... what was it called again, a new card pack? Once that new card pack was released, nobody played my card game anymore.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I got super bummed out about it for quite a while, too.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Anyway, that's one dreamscape off the list. On to the next one, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: I don't want to go to woooooork...

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: Every day is just torture. My manager gives me a literal stomachache from the stress. Even a basic report gets kicked back seven or eight times for rewrites...

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: What does "move the title three pixels to the left" even mean? And how am I supposed to make something a "colorful shade of black"?

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: I haven't had a single good night's sleep in who knows how long... Even in my dreams, everything's about work.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You're having it really rough, huh?

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: Yeah... I really miss my school days. Back when I didn't have a care in the world. But I know I can never go back.

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: Sorry, my dream's caused you so much trouble. I'll make sure to wake up soon and end this.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Did you get a good rest?

speaker: NPC #850484
anh_en: Not even close! But my family is still waiting for me. I can't just give up here!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You've done well. This dreamscape has been taken care of thanks to your efforts.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Who could've thought... the office workers of Honami City were under such tremendous pressure.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Do you find your job difficult?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I've never really thought about it.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Guarding the Somnoire is the duty that the Ivory Gatekeeper and I share. It is the very reason for our existence.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: So, nothing is difficult.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Well, for your own health... you should take a break once in a while.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I'll consider it. Come, let's focus on resolving the matters at hand.

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: Am I... home?

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: No, I've got it wrong. Sorry. Forget what I said.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Where is your home? I can help you look for it once this dream is over.

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: Home? I lost it.

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: Ever since my mom passed away, I've never found it again.

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: They say the dead speak to the living through dreams, Mom. But I've never seen you in my dreams... not even once.

speaker: NPC #850485
anh_en: I miss you so much.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Is everything taken care of? Look at you. Not a pleasant experience, is it?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A frequency not of this world? What does that mean?

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: I don't know all the details. This is the best I can find with my available access.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: I'm counting on you to solve this case, Great Detective.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Mom... The one who created me... Well, it's been quite a while since I've seen her, too.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Let's move on from those old memories. Anyway, you've been exploring for so long. Did you find the cause of the anomaly?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Namipon and the Ebony Gatekeeper theorized that all of this should be related to the dreams of the Left Behind...

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Hmm, you've got half of the part right!

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Ahem! Let me tell you a secret. The Left Behind's dreams are just the tip of the iceberg. The real cause? A frequency not of this world found its way into the Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: The Somnoire triggered its defense mechanism to eliminate it without the two Gatekeepers knowing.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: As a result, the dreamscapes began to layer on top of each other, "accidentally" bridging the Left Behind's dreams with Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #750090
anh_en: Hmm... I guess this breach probably won't be patched anytime soon.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Oh, thank you, Passenger! You've handled all the anomalies!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: There are still lingering echoes from the dreams of the Left Behind. But do not worry. They are not enough to threaten the waking world.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The Ebony Gatekeeper will continue the investigation and contact you as soon as anything comes up.
What about the Ivory Gatekeeper?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: It is occupied in the investigation with the Ebony Gatekeeper, so it asked me to convey its thanks to you.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The Left Behind have all awakened from their dreams, and the Somnoire has stabilized...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hehe. Even though it was a short one, it looks like my time as the acting Gatekeeper is coming to an end.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I hope I can be in another one of your dreams again, Passenger!

speaker: NPC #850486
anh_en: Huh? Where the hell am I? What is this?

speaker: NPC #850486
anh_en: Ugh, my head is killing me... like someone's crushing my brain with pliers!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Easy there. It's just a dream.

speaker: NPC #850486

anh_en: Ah... Such precious Echo emotional data. Who says data has no warmth!!!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: There's the anxious Echo, the brave Echo, the angry Echo, the thoughtful Echo, the tender Echo, the loving Echo, and the heartwarming Echo...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I will definitely use these precious data, or rather emotions, to create a one-of-a-kind "Lollo Genie."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: (Wait, if the "Lollo Genie" becomes too powerful, am I going to be replaced? Whatever, there's no time to think about that. Without new businesses, I'll be replaced either way.)

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: (Besides, the Echoes are just too adorable!)

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ahem, just wait for the good news, partner. This project is a success in the making!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You have my word!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: There's nothing in the hole.

speaker: NPC #700155
anh_en: Nothing's here? Oh no, could it be that my memory's gone fuzzy after such a long time?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't worry, I have an idea.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Got it. Over here.

speaker: NPC #700155
anh_en: Coming.

speaker: NPC #700155
anh_en: We've found it!

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Tweet, tweet. Coo, coo...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: With the current economic climate, fewer and fewer people come to watch our shows. Life isn't easy... If-If only I had a more attractive publicity photo...
This sounds really deep somehow.
Where would you like to take the photo?

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: I-I-I'm sorry... If only I were more beautiful and professional...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: As f-f-for locations, I haven't decided yet...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Err... Sorry, I have trouble making choices...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: There are usually a lot of people over at the square, b-b-but maybe too many?

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: The platform below the square is where my friends and I used to perform... But they weren't fond memories...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: One of us would be screaming the other's name while crawling over the floor, for instance...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Oh, dear, shoo, bad memories, shoo!
Tweet, tweet. Coo, coo?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Bliss must've remembered something terrible and began juggling anxiously.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: The Bank Street... People there tend to be kinder, but their serious faces scare me...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Where do you recommend is a good place to take this picture?
The square.
The platform below the square.
The Bank Street.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Hmm... It's time I overcome my social anxiety....

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Err... It's time I work up the courage and face my past...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Yes... I must be brave if I want to be part of the grown-ups' world.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe that's a little bit too emotional...)
Gonna need some help, Abby.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Abby Translate, your reliable expert Echo translator! I can read an Echo's emotions without them needing to say a word. Ku, ku, ku.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Your personal Echo interpreter Abby is now online. Loading internal Echo interpreter module...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Just great, now you're talking like Maji!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Beep—Echo interpreter module ready. Entering charging mode and standing by...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Whatever makes you happy.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: With the help of Echo interpreter Abby, you're able to make out a clear sentence from the Echo's chirpy noises.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: H-H-Hello, I'd like an elegant new publicity photo.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: In this photo, caught between the crowds, Bliss musters courage, demonstrating the skill of beauty towards life.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Umm... I'd never thought I had this much courage in me.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: It's a wonderful photo. Thank you!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You submit the task, and Lollo Stamps are deposited smoothly into your account like butter.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Hmm, so Echoes can also experience emotions like "social anxiety" and "shyness."

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Bliss managed to overcome social anxiety. How remarkable!

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Keep up the good work, partner!

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Umm... In this photo, I'm standing right in the middle. I really stand out.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: I don't want to be just a bystander anymore. Next time if one of us decides to make a scene, I'll be the first to stop them.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Maybe that way, we won't end up breaking up again...

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: I really like this photo. I'll be braver in the future. Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You submit the task, and Lollo Stamps are deposited smoothly into your account like butter.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Hmm, so Echoes can also experience emotions like "social anxiety" and "regret."

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Bliss has become braver than ever. How remarkable!

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Keep up the good work, partner!

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: Umm... The background is full of commuters coming and going, and they're all wearing long faces.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: That's it, I'll stay here to bring joy and smiles to all the hard-working people.

speaker: NPC #700153
anh_en: This photo's really well taken. Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You submit the task, and Lollo Stamps are deposited smoothly into your account like butter.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Hmm, so Echoes can also experience emotions like "social anxiety" and "dreams of maturity."

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Bliss has become more grown-up than ever. How remarkable!

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Keep up the good work, partner!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}, just the person I was looking for.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: An Echo band is going through a slump and awaits your rescue...
One that's got members doing random screaming and yelling...?
The band's not wearing masks, are they?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Well... some of them wear masks... like your old friend, Hocus Pocus from the Plushie Squad!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Okay...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here are the coordinates. Time is of the essence. Bring me good news once you're done!

speaker: NPC #700154
anh_en: Hey! Long time no see!

speaker: NPC #700156
anh_en: Never been there before...

speaker: NPC #700157
anh_en: No big deal, my master's been to Septimont and told me many interesting stories about it each time he returned. I'll share them with you!

speaker: NPC #700157
anh_en: Stories like the matches {PlayerName} won, and how they prevented a huge crisis!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Ahem, back to the task at hand. Let's make some music.

speaker: NPC #700154
anh_en: Oh, right. How about we write a song about courage? Septimont style!
The Plushie Squad immediately gets to work. An inspiring and powerful melody begins to sound.

speaker: NPC #700158
anh_en: Hehe, now that's what you call true music!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You submit the task, and Lollo Stamps are deposited smoothly into your account like butter.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Well, well. Sounds like you have a party going on over there. It's really getting my heart pumping.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: I feel like I could write a whole report right now. All 88 pages!

speaker: NPC #700155
anh_en: Remember us? We're the Plushie Squad from Penitent's End, the ones you and Roccia brought back to the Troupe of Fools.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Whoa, take it easy.

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Haha, I was just kidding. Come find me when you have time tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #700156
anh_en: Thank you so much. We're now supporting performers in the Troupe and having a great time here.

speaker: NPC #700157
anh_en: Hehe, with the Troupe allowed back in the city, we've decided to come back too!

speaker: NPC #700156
anh_en: Yes... You can't imagine how big those waves were the entire trip.

speaker: NPC #700156
anh_en: But I'm not scared of them anymore, because they are no longer waves of exile, but of exploration and hope!

speaker: NPC #700155
anh_en: That's right... Exploration and hope... A perfect theme.

speaker: NPC #700154
anh_en: Fantastic! I'd rather listen to a song about courage than to those tense hymns from the Order!

speaker: NPC #700157
anh_en: Speaking of songs about courage, I heard Captain Brant and First Mate Roccia say that somewhere across the sea, there's a state completely different from Ragunna called Septimont! A city of courage!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And now, the real deal—who will win in the battle of Left vs. Right?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Or... maybe I should ramp up development of a betting system... Crap, I won't make it in time!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Writing reports is nothing compared to coding...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Forget it, forget it. Just focus on the task at hand. Please help Rightless beat Leftless.

speaker: NPC #700159
anh_en: Ugh... Ouch...

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: Such exciting Echo combat data!

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: It seems that frictions are unavoidable even among the best of companions... The same goes for Echoes.

speaker: NPC #700160
anh_en: You had that one coming! That's what you get for slacking off all day and dumping all the work on me.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And how long has this been like this?

speaker: NPC #700160
anh_en: Centuries. Every generation!

speaker: NPC #700159
anh_en: Well, Headless prefers right-handed... It's not like I wanted...

speaker: NPC #700160
anh_en: Shut up! All you know is picking on the honest folk. You won't want to know what happens if you push them too far!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You want to say something, but since it's someone else's family business, you choose to stay silent.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You submit the task, and nothing's more comforting than the ringtone of Lollo Stamps being deposited into your account.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Understood. I'll have two plans ready for you to review today.… Yes, everything on the list will be completed by the deadline.
You tell Zani about what happened...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, you met an oven Echo that wants to visit the Vault's Echo Depository, right? Got it.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Every Echo or piece of artwork needs to be appraised to see if it's valuable enough for the Vault. Is there anything particularly notable about this Echo?
It's especially large.
It smells really good.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Especially large… Well, I don't think the Vault has a shortage of large Echoes.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Smells really good, huh? An... interesting observation. Does it smell like the food it cooks?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Or maybe it's particularly talented? You see, talent is something the Vault looks for too.
Okay, I'll be sure to find out.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Sure. I'll be available tomorrow after I wrap up my current job. You can find me here if you need anything.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And... Hm, {PlayerName}? When did you get here?
I've been here for a while.
Right when you said you'd send the two plans…

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Sorry... I have a deadline tomorrow and things are tight. Do you need something?
I just wanted to ask you something.
Am I bothering you?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Go ahead. I'm waiting for things to move forward anyway. Ask me whatever you need.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No, it's fine. I'm waiting for things to move forward anyway. Ask me whatever you need.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}! How's it going? Any news on Bakethoven's chance to enter the Vault?
It needs to have something special, like a unique talent…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Your words seem to be dimming Bakethoven's spirit, causing it to lower its head. All it can do is bake, which probably doesn't count as a special talent.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I see… So, what should we do now?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's head to the Vault tomorrow. You said you'd prefer to live a short but meaningful life, right? From where I stand, making food for others seems like a pretty meaningful thing to me.

speaker: NPC #750107
anh_en: (Bakethoven lets out some grateful noises.)

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Alright then! Let's meet at the Vault tomorrow! Thanks as always, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I've got some great news! Bakethoven has decided to demonstrate its best skill—baking pizza!
That sounds great!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I know, right! It's a bit nervous, but with all its years of experience, I'm sure it'll be just fine.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Before we get started, could you get some <color=yellow>flour</color> and <color=yellow>milk</color>? Can't bake pizza without the right ingredients, after all.
Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I always trust you to get things done! Once you've got the <color=yellow>flour</color> and <color=yellow>milk</color>, let's meet up in front of the bank.
No problem!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you're here! We're all set.

speaker: NPC #750152
anh_en: Such a tempting pizza made by such a talented Echo! I'd love to try it…

speaker: NPC #750153
anh_en: Can I have a slice? I missed lunch because of a meeting!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Emm... is that okay?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I think so. The appraiser has probably finished their notes… Mmm, this smells so good.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Vault employees eagerly share the freshly baked pizza. Bakethoven, flattered by the praise, grows bashful. Its oven temperature even goes up a few degrees.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We should know the result by tomorrow. Thanks to you, we had a special and delicious meal today.
All thanks to Bakethoven.
Glad you like it.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Vault's standards for accepting Echoes are tough, but... I'm hopeful we'll hear some good news tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thank you all again. You're always welcome to visit the Vault next time. I'll give you a tour if I'm free.
Nice.
Zani's here too?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hope you don't mind if I watch too. I just finished up with work when you arrived, and I'm genuinely curious to see how this Echo performs.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I just finished up with work when you arrived. I'm genuinely curious to see how this Echo performs.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, of course, you're more than welcome to watch Bakethoven in action!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The appraiser is here as well. Shall we get started?
Bakethoven nervously starts baking the pizza. The scent of cheese and sausage gradually fills the air. By the time the pizza is ready, a small crowd of Vault employees has gathered.

speaker: NPC #750151
anh_en: Wow, this smells incredible! Is this today's special treat?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Greetings, my dear friend! How wonderful to see you again.
That's quite profound, Maji.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, thank you! Just a sudden insight. But there's another good piece of news!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Thanks to Bakethoven's case, Lollo Logistics' reputation for helping Echoes has spread far and wide. That's why our order today comes from another Echo, one who's looking for a little girl named Dora.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I've heard she's been spotted in the city. You might want to start there. I'm sure there's no one better to handle this final order than you, {PlayerName}!
Likewise, my friend.
You do sound like a real Ragunnesi now.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, you flatter me. Unfortunately, today is my last day in Ragunna. But as people say: "There's always more to the journey!" There will be a next time. Life is long, and there's always something to look forward to.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Well, about Bakethoven, while it is a pity that the Averardo Vault declined its application...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: ...It still wanted me to thank you and Zani! The Vault staff seemed to really enjoy its pizza, saying it was a hundred times better than the canteen food. Bakethoven felt that it had found its value.
That's great news.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Right? Who says an Echo's worth is determined only by "its place in the Vault?" It's the same with life, really.
Absolutely right.

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: So tired… but I haven't found it. No, can't give up, can't go home...

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: Thank you, thank you so much! Sorry I was unfriendly earlier, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Thank you for helping me find Dumdum… Dumdum, you should thank this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady}…

speaker: NPC #750112
anh_en: Woof!
You're welcome, just be sure to take good care of your pup from now on.
Thank you, Dumdum.

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: I'll take Dumdum home now. Mother has been so worried… I hope you have a wonderful day, {Male=sir;Female=miss}!
Be careful.
Hey there, are you Dora?

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: W-who are you!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't worry, I won't hurt you. I was asked by an Echo to find you.

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: An Echo? C-could it be…?
Dora's eyes widen. Before she can say anything else, a small Tubpup runs over with a loud bark!

speaker: NPC #750111
anh_en: …Dumdum! Where have you been? I've been looking for you everywhere… Where did you go…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Tubpup, Dumdum, clumsily licks the tears from the little girl's face, whimpering anxiously.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So it was trying to find its way back to its owner… and so secretly followed me the whole way?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Welcome back, my dear friend!
Mission completed.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I've already heard the news! You reunited the Tubpup with its owner! A feat worthy of praise. Feels like we've done something good again.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Well, it's almost time for me to head back. Before I leave Ragunna, I want to know what you think of our Lollo Errand campaign.
It's fun.
It's profitable.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ha, at one point it didn't even feel like an errand service anymore. But since everything worked out, all is well! This trip has really given me an appreciation for this Land of Echoes. Quite the fascinating place, wouldn't you say?
It is, indeed.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Your efforts never go unnoticed. It's always a pleasure working with you. I look forward to whatever adventure awaits us next!

speaker: NPC #750149
anh_en: {PlayerName}! {PlayerName}! Something's off here... PLEASE SAVE ME!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like Maji is in trouble... I'd better go lend a hand.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: HELP! Leave my package alone!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Welcome! Ah, it's you, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: I've heard the buzz! You're helping out Bakethoven with some big project, huh?
We're far from the halfway mark though...
Yes. We're keeping at it!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Good luck! I'm rooting for you!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Here are some fresh flour and milk that I prepared for you! Go on, take these!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A real-time exchange rate, plus a 0.02% variable fee, plus 10% GST, and a courier fee… What the actual... Oh! If it isn't my old friend, {PlayerName}! Unbelievable, we meet again!
Sounds rather profitable.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, exactly! The time I've spent on it has already paid off. I've already completed several orders!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Right now, I'm handling an order for some <color=yellow>flour</color> from Ragunna. An astute client discovered the price here is half of what they pay in Jinzhou, so they've been buying flour from Ragunna for quite a while!
Really?!
Your astute friend right here knew that a long time ago.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Amazing, right! They used to get the flour from a mysterious man wearing sunglasses, but he told them his ship was lent to someone else, so no errands for now…

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Aha! As expected for someone as sharp as you!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: This client said they used to get the flour from a mysterious man wearing sunglasses, but he told them his ship was lent to someone else, so no errands for now…

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: But later, they found out about Lollo Logistics's new service and reached out to me for help. That's how this all came together! Interested in joining me this time, {PlayerName}? Buy 10 bags of flour, and you'll earn a nice errand fee in return!
I never say no to bounties.
Well, if it isn't good old Maji!
If you pay upfront, I'll handle it.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Wonderful! The customer has already made their payment, and I'll transfer it to you right away.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, of course! The customer has already made their payment, and I'll transfer it to you right away.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: By the way, you might want to check out the <color=yellow>Gondola Market</color>. I hear they've got a special <color=yellow>fortified flour</color>. I'll be waiting for you here!
Why the sudden change in tone?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Haha, call it the magic of Ragunna! The allure of classical aesthetics and culture is simply too tempting to resist!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So, do you still remember the trial "Lollo Navigator"? I navigated my way to Ragunna with it, and it turned out to be incredibly useful. It even sparked a new idea! Care to hear about it?
I'm all ears.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Alright, picture this: You see something you want, but it's unavailable where you live. Or maybe you find it, but the price is inflated beyond reason. Or maybe the price is acceptable, but you don't have the luxury of time to get it yourself…

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Where there's a need, there's a market! That's why I came up with a new campaign called "Lollo Errand"!
Sounds very nice.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You're back already? That was fast!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So you really can get 10 bags of flour for just 5,000 Shell Credits! The client wasn't exaggerating after all!
Ragunna might just win best city of the year.
Everyone should start selling goods like they do at the Gondola Market.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Well… I wouldn't go that far, but it's definitely the perfect place for my errand business...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Anyway, thank you for your help today! Keep the rewards, and I'll see you tomorrow!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here you are, {PlayerName}!
Here I am.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Right on time. I just received a new order from… well, a mysterious madame.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: She needs an ingredient for her skincare and happens to know that <color=yellow>Heliobane Fungia</color> is quite moisturizing, so she asked us to help.
But… is it really safe to use?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hmm… she may have her own method for handling it. Maybe you can just see what she does when you deliver the order.
Alright then.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm counting on you, my friend!

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Well, well, I didn't expect the esteemed Laureate to deliver my order in person.
You, of all people, indulging in skincare?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Surprised, are we? I wear masks, so there must be... something they rest upon, yes? Though not everyone is fortunate enough to lay eyes on it...

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Ah, that expression again... how delightful. Hehe, perhaps there's more to me than you realize.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Have a pleasant day, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Oh dear, you won't believe this!
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The freight insurance of the item we're delivering today is worth a billion! I can't even imagine how much the actual item must cost... probably a number I could never earn in my lifetime!
What could it possibly be...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: No idea. Based on the tiny package, it could be a precious gem? We need to be extremely careful with this one...
Got it. I'll take care of it.
I wonder if my payment's going to be in the 10-digit range too.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Safe delivery!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Well, that's a bit beyond my reach... But maybe one day, when I strike it rich!

speaker: NPC #750105
anh_en: Oh, my package has finally arrived!

speaker: NPC #750105
anh_en: Ha, it's just an egg, but I found it so lovely when I first saw it. Too bad I couldn't get it myself since I was busy with my business. You've been a great help!

speaker: NPC #750105
anh_en: Just look at its gleaming shell and perfect size. It must taste divine... Couldn't have asked for better.

speaker: NPC #750105
anh_en: Thank you so much! This package really made my day!
Here you go, the invaluable, precious package.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Oh, except that one time in Taoyuan Vale for the <ano=Gulpuff Race>Riverside Games</ano>.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: The situation back then was volatile with the Threnodian's resurgence. Remaining at the border to safeguard the city was my responsibility.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Since you're already at the party, why not treat this as a vacation and relax a little? Even a general needs to recharge.

speaker: Taoqi

Have fun, Jiyan!

speaker: Taoqi

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: These Echoes. While Jinzhou does have Echo Terminals, the summoning process is heavily restricted.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I heard that Rinascita's Genesis Nexus draws on the Sentinel's power, allowing Echoes to maintain form far longer.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: If we could use this technology in Jinzhou, the Midnight Rangers would see their burden greatly lifted.

speaker: Taoqi

speaker: NPC #750088

anh_en: It's a long story. Remember Yangyang, the Outrider? She told me about what you went through after Rinascita.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The Carnevale, Septimont… No doubt the Fractsidus were pulling the strings behind all those incidents.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: To understand their plans, I followed the clues and did some digging of my own.
The Fractsidus are not to be taken lightly.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yeah, they're a hard nut to crack. Luckily, I had support from the Magistrate and others in Jinzhou. I never planned to take them head-on.
What are you doing here, Patroller Yinlin?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: With their help, I infiltrated one of their bases and discovered a new scheme they were whipping up.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We neutralized it before they could act. Those Artificers were no match for the Midnight Rangers.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It was my chance to step back into the light... And honestly, living in the shadows as a suspect wasn't exactly pleasant.

anh_en: …It was a tempting offer, but I turned it down.

anh_en: You turned it down? Why?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: (Terminal Communication) Yes, yes, user experience has always been the cornerstone of Lollo Logistics, and it's fundamental to our survival.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sure, I won't let you work for nothing.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: What are you talking about? In all of Solaris, you're the most dependable one. Only I, Maji, could find someone as reliable as you.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Since we last met, I submitted a new proposal, and they've finally agreed to let me handle part of the event activities!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I was thinking of using a completely new strategy for the event. Pretty bold, huh?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The entire event is brand new, completely different from the last one. It's a fresh Lollo promotional campaign with an all-new approach.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Let's identify new hooks—not by breaking through user pain points, but by creating new ones for them!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!
Alright, let's do this!
Let's get fired up!
Maji Era—!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I understand what you mean. You want us to maintain quality while shortening the update cycle for each event to enhance user experience, but the cost... Oh, right, Man-Made Arctic...?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's the all-new approach?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sure, it's just like last year, except we swap out some buzzwords on the slides to make them look impressive for the bosses.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Why are you looking at me like that? I have to report, you know. Besides, I've just been transferred to headquarters — I still need to put food on the table, right?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: However, I've initiated an optimization plan for the entire Lollo Stamps exchange feature, making it easier to acquire Lollo Stamps without having to detour through the finance department for approvals.
Maji, my good buddy!
This is great!
Maji Era—!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ahaha, but for now, I'm personally covering the expenses brought by the Lollo Stamps after the update... Anyway! I'll clearly list all the help you need on the panel, so you can directly claim the Lollo Stamps from the Feature when the time comes.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I've got the rest in your hands, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sure thing, absolutely! Your request is my mission! I'll make sure everything's set, and I look forward to you personally guiding us!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm sorry, I was just on a call with my boss. So, old friend, did you miss me?
I've missed you so much!
Let's discuss compensation first.
Did the boss send me new tasks through you again?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Of course, Lollo Stamps, my old buddy, I've missed you like crazy!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Why are you suddenly speaking with a foreign accent? And hey, are you thinking about me or what?!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Old friend! Finally, you're here! I'm facing the biggest crisis of my life!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Not long ago, I went to Septimont to watch an Agon. The Gladiators' fiery passion, their movements... It moved me to my core!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Even I was waving my arms, screaming myself hoarse.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And right then, I thought… sure, there were vending machines in the stands, but if someone came running over with a drink clinking with ice cubes... Ah! Wouldn't that be more refreshing than any perfectly-aligned workflow?
Maggie, throw away that How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite.
…Up until you said "workflow," it actually did sound refreshing.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You don't get it! Lose freedom, you lose a lot. Lose perfectly-aligned workflow, you lose everything!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (…Pretty sure that's not how the saying goes.)

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Anyway! I jumped right into putting the plan into action.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: But as I said, no matter what I try, I can't outrun melting ice!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Not even with coolers or ice packs?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Who would've thought that after years of running logistics, my delivery speed still can't outpace melting ice cubes!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: No! Friend, no cooler and ice pack can withstand the blazing passion of the crowd!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't suddenly get all worked up, Maggie!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sorry, sorry. Septimont's Agons just fire me up. But you see, my career is now melting away like those ice cubes.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A cold drink is heaven in a glass in this scorching heat.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: But once the ice melts, everything is watered down. No one likes watered-down content, be it a drink, or a game.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: If Lollo Logistics gets branded as a "watered-down company" because of this…

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: My colleagues will drag me back to the HQ as cargo and put me on trial!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So please, my old friend, save me!
Somehow, I get the feeling I'll be hearing this sort of wailing from you often…
Then I suggest asking Lumi to deliver you back to the HQ. Maybe she'll go soft on you.
Quit exaggerating, Maggie. You're still a rookie.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Come on, I know you'll help me. I don't expect you to shoulder the risks for me. But if you do, I promise you'd always have a stake in my payroll. We’ll go from rags to riches together.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So, same as always! New requests will pop up on the board every day. With your skills, it'll be a walk in the park, and Lollo Stamps will slip right into your pocket as usual.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Think about it! Who else will answer the desperate cries of those parched, hoarse, dizzy fans? No one but us!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: We'll be the rising heroes! Not only the Gladiators fighting valiantly in the arena are heroes! So are we, delivering chilled drinks with swift and shining valor!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So remember! Beat the ice before it melts!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Honestly… it's your fiery speeches that keep melting the ice, Maggie…)
Wait… are you saying even ice cubes are using Lollo Logistics now?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hey, I've been running errands for my mom since I was four! Don't tell me that's not logistics experience!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Please, don't spin surreal fantasies out of a nine-to-fiver's words.
Alright then, tell me your trouble, Maggie-kun.
So why exactly are you racing against ice cubes?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You know me, every crisis I have starts with a business opportunity.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hello, old friend. What took you so long? I'm having the crisis of a lifetime over here!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I bet you liked it, right? But that'll be the last of it.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I bet you liked it, right? But that'll be the last of it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What?!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Whoa. First time seeing you give off a face like that. Didn't realize it'd be that big of a blow.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Don't you worry. There's always a silver lining.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Our accounting says there are a few things I need to iron out first. Things like, lacking user incentives, not enough granularity in the work flow, and not being able to capitalize data in private domains.
You still have that How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite on you?
Now there's that old Maji I know of.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: That's what happens when you're a cog in a wheel. Stuck spinning for life.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Anyway. What you do think will happen if my very first project gets turned down right when it goes live once I'm over at HQ?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Wait. That crisis has got your name on it as well!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I suppose...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'll get pushed around by my colleagues. Start getting assigned work at stations out in the middle of nowhere. Unreasonable tasks, one after the other. And then finally, I'll be forced to hand in my resignation!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Which is why I went and found the head of accounting, had my knees give the floor a gentle touch, plus a little kiss with my forehead on the ground while I was at it. And voila. They had no choice but to give me a second chance!
Simply awe-inspiring, O great Maggie.
I have a feeling you'll make them pay it back twofold.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: For my salary, and for the happiness of my old friend. I, Maji, will do anything!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: All right. Same as usual, the panel will post daily updates of requests, which you'll easily breeze through, and the Lollo Stamps will come flying into your pocket.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And remember, friend. My own fate, and the fate of you not having to travel across the entire Solaris just to reach me for rewards, depends on you and your accomplishments in the upcoming days!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Good luck, {PlayerName}! With our powers we shall unite our customers, and force the evil-doers at accounting flatten and overthrow themselves!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Pretty sure that last part was his true goal...)
No need to be overly dramatic if you're asking for help.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ahem. Remember that Lollo Stamp exchange QoL improvement I proposed after being transferred to HQ?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And the end result is that from now on, you won't ever need to personally pick up orders from me anymore. The system will automatically send contracts and Lollo Stamps directly to you, like bringing a glass of hot milk to your bed right before bedtime.
That's a strange way of putting it.
It did come in handy, now that you've mentioned it.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The point is, how did you like its convenience?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Oh, right, a coworker at Port Gunchao reported that something was missing in the truck.
What was missing?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The copilot's missing. You got any idea?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The business today is "Lollo Grocery Shopping". Let me brief you on the background first.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The Tacet Field in the Port City of Guixu is expanding, and the nearby Xiehua Village has been included in the emergency evacuation area. The Ministry of Development and the Patrollers are already very busy.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Merchants willing to go to Xiehua Village are few already because of the short distance to the Port City of Guixu. Now with the trouble in the Tacet Field...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The purpose of piloting this business is to help the villagers of Xiehua Village with "Lollo Grocery Shopping."
I understand your idea.

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have ten new grocery orders. Please handle them on time.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Let me see... <color=highlight>3 bags of flour and 2 bottles of cooking oil</color>. You can buy them from Mahe's Grocery.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I will do the purchasing with you. You can find the shopping list on your Terminal now.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: When you've got everything done, meet me at Xiehua Village.
Who are you...?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You don't recognize me just because I changed the outfit?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Maggie! It's me, Maji!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I still feel nostalgic about this outfit. It fits me well.
Indeed, it suits you.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I have already handed over the ingredients to my Patroller friends. They will distribute them!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Oh, by the way, I will transfer the expense and pay to you through the terminal.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: See you tomorrow! Don't be late!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm sorry, {PlayerName}. We'll have to suspend the pilot business for today. I have something urgent to attend to.
What happened?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A courier at the Jinzhou Station, Guanxian, has gone missing. He was supposed to deliver the goods to the Port Gunchao Logistics Station an hour ago, but we haven't been able to reach him.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The navigation system shows that Guanxian is in Dim Forest. I was about to go and find him, that's why I changed into this outfit.
Why did he go to Dim Forest?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Most likely, trying to take a shortcut.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: {PlayerName}, the situation is urgent. I heard that you can use the Resonance Beacon to reach Dim Forest faster. I must ask you for help.
Let's go.
After dispersing the group of Hoochiefs, you and Maji bring the frightened freshman courier back to Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Thanks for your help, {PlayerName}. Guanxian is fine, with just a few scratches.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: When he was taking the shortcut, a group of Hoochiefs found him and got greedy for the package in his box.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Even though he was chased by the Hoochiefs all around, he managed to hide the package while the Hoochiefs were distracted.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: When we rescued him, he somehow managed to find the items from somewhere.
Luckily, everything turned out fine.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: As a Lollo Logistics courier, the first priority is to take responsibility for your own safety. Otherwise, how can you take responsibility for the packages you handle?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: What Lollo Logistics couriers least want to hear is the alarm for the activation of the "relay plan," which means...
Maji remains silent for a while before calming down.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm sorry, {PlayerName}, I was being frivolous. Thank you very much for your help.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here is today's reward. Thank you for lending a hand!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The business today is: "Lollo Petter."
I must have the emoji. Send it to me!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Let's see here... The emoji, and Wangcai's location... There, I've forwarded them to you! Remember to bring Wangcai's favorite fish fillet!
You want me to pet you?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: That would be nice... Just kidding. You'll be petting animals for other people. The demand has been growing lately.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: There are many animals roaming in the city. People living in other places would like you to pet and feed the animals in their place.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Actually, I once dealt with a similar order as a courier. The sender was a human, but the recipient was a hound named "Mimi"...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And the customer told me... "I bought some jerky in Rinascita. Please help me feed the jerky to Mimi the dog in Jinzhou city!"

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: At that time, I was totally lost because offering that service wasn't something we did, but it really got me thinking about a whole new business opportunity.

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new petting order.Please fulfill the order in time.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And this time we're looking for... a tabby cat named "Wangcai"? Oh my, I know this cat. I even have an emoji of it on my Terminal!

speaker: NPC #1365
anh_en: We have too many people trying to feed it at once. It looks scared. Step back, everyone!

speaker: NPC #1365
anh_en: Got it! Wangcai is hiding in the braces behind the light box, but his primordial pouch is too fat. He's stuck.

speaker: Vượng Tài
anh_en: Meow meow meow...

speaker: Huyền Âm
anh_en: Let me try the cat language translation module!

speaker: Huyền Âm
anh_en: Wangcai said: "Numb. Something's zapping me inside the light box. My tummy feels numb. Please get me out quickly."

speaker: Huyền Âm
anh_en: Quick. Turn off the circuit module, and I'll go save Wangcai.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I see, this is a growth curve that Lollo Logistics has not spent enough bandwidth on...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Next to Maji, an expensive-looking magazine titled How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite catches your attention...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The magazine seems full of abstruse terms and buzzwords such as LOD, roadmapping, closing the loop, product matrix, and more.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Yes... You mean, I can participate in the Incubator Project now?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Great! I'll submit my pitch in seven days. Thank you!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Maji hangs up the call.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hooray! They let me participate!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Oh, I almost forgot to introduce myself. I'm the new manager of the Lollo Logistics Station, Maji. By the way, I also go by Ma... M-Maggie! Sounds pretty cool and international, right?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: That was me doing the entrance interview for "Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Project". Phew, thought I was getting rejected again.
About the "Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Project...
How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Our market approach? That's... that's...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Make the best of everything and everyone is one of Lollo's corporate values.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: At Lollo Logistics, our team members are empowered to take initiative and bring forth innovative business ventures through the Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Project.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: It offers selected candidates access to company funds to launch pilot businesses within our facilities for a week.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: This season, the focus is on couriers' entrepreneurial ideas under the theme "Judging the Business Loop by User Experience."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I know what every word means, but it makes zero sense when they're put together. So I digged for their origin...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Have you heard of the industry-famous How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I asked a friend to get me this book and tried to find out what that theme really meant...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: ...But these jargons only feel too specious to make sense.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Don't laugh at me. I've only been the manager for a few days. All I can do is practice while I learn.
What's your business proposal?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Umm... Lemme think... I mean, let me streamline this for better comprehension!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Now, I did have quite a few ideas... Lollo Hitman, Lollo Fixit, Lollo Petter, etc.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: By the way, my favorite is Lollo Hitman.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: These specialized markets are born from the specific needs and challenges our customers face every day, namely, their pain points.
Specialized markets?
Pain points?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: ...I'm too deep into the jargon. You know what I mean.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The assistant role I'm hiring for is all about handling these business requests, helping me figure out if they're actually doable.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I know you'd be the perfect candidate for this job, {PlayerName}. What do you say?
Let's cut to the chase. How's the pay?
You are not expecting me to work for free, are you?
(Whisper) I heard you were looking for an assistant?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A competitive pay is only the first thing I offer.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: In case you don't know, Lollo Logistics provides "Lollo Stamps" for friends who have helped the company.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: They can be redeemed for cash and other rewards. Now, what do you say?
Sure, I'm looking forward to work with you.
Pleasure to be of service, Maggie!
Give me some time to think.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: (Whisper) Yes, we are. Thank you for dropping by. Please wait a moment. I'm sorry.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The manager takes a deep breath.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Our cutting-edge market approach entails a laser-focused allocation of resources. By propelling our users to the brink of the event horizon through unparalleled differentiation, we are poised to revolutionize the industry landscape...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: M-Moving ahead, this initiative will enhance user knowledge and align them with Lollo's business, optimizing value delivery synergies!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Yes, I am Maji, staff number 2404150. I have worked at the Jinzhou Lollo Logistics Station for three years.

You and Xuanyin join forces to save Wangcai, prompting cheers from the crowd. After thanking you, Xuanyin takes Wangcai to the Academy's medical department. It seems you'll have to wait until next time to feed Wangcai.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You tell Maji about the event, leaving him speechless for a moment.
What's the matter?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Being a cat is way better than being a human.
I don't get it...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I can't write today's report in this case, but if I were a cat, I would never have to write any report. Sob sob...
You can try another of your business ideas tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You're right. Let me cope with this now. Everything will be fine tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You might not believe what the business plan is when I tell you.
A chance to draw?
How many cups before we get the guaranteed?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Let me see... One cup for one pull....

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Wait! The fine print here... is this the lottery probability rules?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: ...Starting from the 50th cup, the probability of winning increases, and the guaranteed drop appears by the 60th cup.
Are there any other rules?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Before placing an order, you have to shout the slogan: Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!
Remove the applet, now!

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding!...

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have...
How unorthodox could it be?

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new...

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new order...

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new order... Ding! Ding! Ding!
If I gain extra weight from this, it'll be on you.
Can I apply for a work injury compensation?
It's not too late to give up.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Don't underestimate me! Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Your encounters yesterday inspired me. I've developed a new business overnight.
What business? We go begging for food?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Nah! We're helping people eat stuff! And we make money from that! It's called "Lollo Eater"!
Sounds the same to me.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Jewel Boba has launched a collab event with the popular game, "Second Coming of Solaris."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Players can buy collab drink at Jewel Boba for a chance to get limited edition redemption codes. The hype is crazy!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: They get the codes, we get to drink boba and make money. It's a win-win!

speaker: NPC #900062
anh_en: Welcome to "the Second Coming of Solaris: Jewel Station". How many cups would you like?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris! I'll have 100 cups of boba!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And make half of them large, no ice, and less sugar please!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: What about you?
Large, extra ice, extra sugar!
Large, half ice, half sugar!
Large, no ice, less sugar!

speaker: NPC #900062
anh_en: Now, please shout out our slogan loudly.
Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!

Order #1: 5 cups, 0 code.
Order #2: 30 cups, 1 code.
Order #3: 22 cups, 1 code.
Order #4: 1 cup, 1 code.
Order #5: 10 cups, 2 codes...

With 68 cups of boba in your stomach, you and Maji call it quits earlier than you expected.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sorry. I underestimated the enthusiasm of those players... Hic! I won't ever try something like this again.
Hic! It's okay, I understand. I forgive you.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Thanks. That's very sweet of you to say.
As sweet as the boba, yeah.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I can't do this. Hic... I can present no more treasure. Won't be able to work as a courier again if I go out of shape from this...
You are no longer a courier, though.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hic... I forgot. Haven't gotten used to my new occupation yet.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A stunning idea.
Are you saying...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The traditional food delivery takes the food to the customer's home. In that case, it might be difficult to balance time-efficiency and the condition of the dish.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: And that's why our "Lollo Take-in" will go the other way: we deliver our customers to the food!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I already came up with a slogan: Eat wherever you want with Lollo Take-in!
That... does sound very unconventional.
Something feels off, but I can't name it.

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new take-in order. Please pick up the customer on time.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: An order! That looks like a faraway location, though... I don't think I've ever seen any people living there?
I'll go check it out.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Okay. Call me if everything turns out fine.
Really? I don't believe that.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Then I'll drive there to pick up the customer.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I will name it "Lollo Take-in". I was inspired by a post on Lollo's internal forum.
Take-in? Are you trying to say takeout food?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here, I'll show you. Read this article!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A non-native customer placed a Lollo cold-chain order, wanting a Pulled Chicken from Panhua's Restaurant...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: But I only found that I forgot to take the food when I arrived at the customer's location. Careless of me...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: To make up for my slip, I rode the customer to Panhua's Restaurant, so he could order the chicken himself and have a fresh taste!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Now, I contacted this courier and got his authorization...

speaker: NPC #900063
anh_en: Bad news, boss! Ain't that the Lollo Hitman?!

speaker: NPC #900064
anh_en: Dang, no way! Who the heck called Lollo Hitman?

speaker: NPC #900065
anh_en: But, but we already apologized! Hmph, we won't be beaten for the same matter twice. Let's kick {Male=his;Female=her} arse!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Sorry I came late.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Interestingly enough, I picked up a Patroller who lost the way while I drove here.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'll make it 100% sure: was it true that you were going to have the last meal before turning in?

speaker: NPC #900065
anh_en: I swear I'm not lying. It's all worth it for a feast at Panhua's Restaurant.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Now move. Get on the truck.

speaker: NPC #900063
anh_en: Why are we getting beaten for nothing for the second time?
You acted first.

speaker: NPC #900064
anh_en: We called it quits right after we made the apology... Sob sob...

speaker: NPC #900065
anh_en: We were going in town for the last meal together before turning ourselves in to the Patrollers.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So, you were the ones who...
Turns out they're the ones who called "Lollo Take-in."

speaker: NPC #900063
anh_en: Yeah. Boss promised to treat us to a big meal.

speaker: NPC #900064
anh_en: Now that you brought about that case of "Lollo Hitman", we apologized and made reparations. Why do we have to be beaten again today?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I worked all last night to launch our first applet, "Lollo Hitman"! This app helps protecting people from the Exiles.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I was robbed by a group of Exiles in Wuming Bay, and they threatened to destroy all my stuff if I dared to call the Patrollers. Please, help me!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Darn! {PlayerName}, do you want to be an ally of justice?
I will make them pay.
Is this legal?
I'll call Patrollers.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Let me explain. I know not all the Exiles are bad guys.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Lollo Hitman helps protect people from the Exiles while traveling alone.
That sounds nice.
Hopefully it's legal.

speaker: NPC #900060
