anh_en: Ding! You have a new hitman order. Please go beat up the bad guy in time.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: An order has been placed. Let me see the details...

Traveling towards Jinzhou in a Lollo courier truck, a mix of strangers—a logistics manager, Exiles, a lost Patroller, and yourself—converge at Panhua's Restaurant. Around the table, unfamiliar faces bond over a feast of exquisite dishes, their spirits lifted by the shared joy of good food.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm exhausted...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Better yet, if you can bring me some new potential clients...
That won't be very easy.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Oh, and I have put together the "Entrepreneur Pilot Business Report."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I've listed you as a co-author. Did I spell your name right, {PlayerName}?
Yeah, you did.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Recipient... "Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Supervisory Board", and... send. Done.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Thank you for the help, {PlayerName}!
...But at least everything worked out in the end.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Those Exiles finally woke up and decided to return home.
Prodigal sons.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Hey, what about my business? I say, my product matrix formed a closed loop and successfully educated the Exiles to become our customers. This turned out a promising growth curve!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Alright, enough with the fancy words... Ahem. I hereby declared that "Maji's Lollo Entrepreneur Pilot Business Projects" will end today.
Congratulations.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Be sure to redeem your rewards with Lollo Stamps in time. Don't say I didn't remind you!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Tomorrow's not a payday, but feel free to swing by for a casual chat anytime.
A few days have passed. Today, the Incubator project's final decisions will be revealed. You meet Maji at the Lollo Logistics Station.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: They didn't accept any of my project proposals.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Who knows? You may become a customer of one of the new services I come up with one day.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: So long, {PlayerName}.
See you!
Why the uniform?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm not made for the manager position, so I applied for transfer. I'll go back to working as a courier.
I'm glad you look happy.
I respect your choice.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: No way, you bought that? I'm just going on a trip.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: While they didn't accept any of my proposals, the board said I had some great ideas, and that they would like me involved in some other pipelines.
They had a point.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I'm leaving for Lollo's headquarters. Looks like it is farewells for now.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: You're here just in time. The cargo truck made it to Port Gunchao in one piece, but it broke down completely shortly afterwards.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here's your pay for today. You keep that momentum rolling for tomorrow, all right?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A five-star review! Look, the buyer just posted a review.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Rover looked so cool! 'Lollo Hitman' will be my go-to app when I run into the Exiles again!

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A good start! Let's see the next order...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Strange... Why are the orders all canceled? Anything wrong with the system?
Maji inspects the codebase and contacts the buyers who canceled the orders.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: It's not a problem with our code. The buyers canceled their order.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: However, little can be done to fight back when one suffers their raid. That's why I had this idea about "Lollo Hitman."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: If everyone could just stay in their own place, there would be no Exiles who deserve lessons.
You had quite an experience...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ha, that's years ago.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: With you here, I think the Exiles will stay put for a while. We can remove "Lollo Hitman" from the app store for the time being.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: This is your pay for today, and remember, there is a new business to test out tomorrow.
Why?

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: The reason they canceled the orders are the Exiles who picked the quarrel with them came and apologized...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: All their apologies read like: "We return all your possessions and accept liability for your mental damage, lost wages and nutrition costs, but please, could you cancel that order?"

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Some even said, "Scold me or hit me if you like, but please don't call 'Lollo Hitman'... Not that Rover, please!"

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Didn't know you were so famous in Jinzhou.
Sorry, it seems I scared off your potential clients.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Don't be. I've seen a lot of cases when I was a courier in remote regions, in which Exiles just took advantage of outnumbered travelers and picked on them.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A new business that suits just your capability: "Lollo Fixit."

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: A new order! An automatic courier truck went missing in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire. I'll send you the coordinates.
Repairperson Rover at your service.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: I heard you fixed a lot of puzzles in the wild alone, including even those left by CSC. You should find no problem doing this job.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: One of the worst nightmares during travels is the sudden breakdown of devices. For example, courier truck failures, short circuits of electric locks on courier boxes...

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: What would you do as an experienced repairperson to address these issues?
Knock it hard.
Reboot.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Ha, in that case, I can make an expert myself.

speaker: NPC #900060
anh_en: Ding! You have a new repair order. Please fulfill the order in time.
Punch it.
Reboot the control panel.

speaker: NPC #900061
anh_en: Impact detected, impact detected. Ejecting copilot in 3141.5926 seconds...

speaker: NPC #900061
anh_en: Traveling to... Rinascita.
Start repairing.
Repaired, the courier truck shakily makes its way to Port Gunchao.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: Here you are. The truck has successfully arrived at Port Gunchao, though not long after it broke down completely.

speaker: NPC #900059
anh_en: This is your pay today. I will welcome you tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Would you like to start the test now, {PlayerName}?
Sure.
Sorry, I've got other things to do.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Very well. Just be sure to stay safe. I'll stay in touch during the test.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That's okay. You're welcome to come back when you're free.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. I hope you received my email.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I've remotely upgraded your Flight Module. It should now be available in the Jinzhou region.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: But before we put it into public use, we'd like your help with testing its performance.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: If you're available, please stop by the Huaxu Academy.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: You're here, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Simple. Just follow the flight paths we've marked for you and reach the designated locations on the map using the module.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I've sensors set up across Jinzhou City. They'll automatically record data as you fly past.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Data such as lift force, maximum speed, time of flight, flying position, etc.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: We'll compare these to the ones collected in Rinascita shared by the Montelli family to determine how the environment here affects flight performance.
No problem. Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Very well. Just be sure to stay safe. I'll stay in touch during the testing.
Sorry, I've got other things to do.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That's okay. You're welcome to come back when you're free.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Have you tried out the upgraded Flight Module yet?

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Did you run into any issues? For example, a sudden loss of altitude? Wings retracting themselves?
All good so far.
I haven't tried it yet.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Good to hear. Seems like it's passed the performance and safety checks.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Next, we need to acquire some more precise data in the upcoming tests. Just to be safe.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That's alright. Since you've used it plenty of times in Rinascita, I'm sure you'll have no trouble flying it here.
What do I need to do then?

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Excellent. We've gathered all the baseline data.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Next, we'll test the module's acceleration capabilities and maneuverability.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Please proceed to the next location.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Data is in. The Flight Module's performance matches the Academy's wind tunnel tests.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Now, let's test its climbing characteristics.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I've marked the next location. Please proceed when ready.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Alright, data uploaded. Thrust performance and wing durability are within the expected range.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Just one final test remaining. We're almost there now.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Good luck, {PlayerName}. I'll be waiting for you.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Thank you very much, {PlayerName}. So, what do you think of the Flight Module?

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Though I doubt someone as capable as you will run into much trouble.
I'll keep that in mind.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Now, then. I'll be heading back to the Academy to sort out this data. If you ever run into any issues with the module, don't hesitate to contact me.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: See you around, {PlayerName}.
It's nice seeing Jinzhou from above.
Just average.
It's marvelous.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Interesting… You know, the Flight Module might be useful in the tourism sector. That's worth exploring as a business idea.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Hmm… seems like there's still room for improvement... I'll make a note of it.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Thank you for your compliment. The module has come a long way, but it's nowhere near perfect. There's always room to improve.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Anyway, that wraps up our test. Thank you for supporting the Huaxu Academy.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: You can hold on to the Flight Module. Just be careful when using it.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. I'm Lanyan, a researcher from the Huaxu Academy. I was wondering if you could spare a moment.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I'd like to introduce you to the Academy's latest research achievement—the Flight Module. Designed purely for short-distance travel and exploration.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: But before we put it into public use, we'd like your help with testing its performance.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: If you're available, please stop by the Huaxu Academy.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: You're here, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Simple. Just follow the flight paths we've marked for you and reach the designated locations on the map using the module.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I've sensors set up across Jinzhou City. They'll automatically record data as you fly past.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Data such as lift force, maximum speed, time of flight, flying position, etc.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: We'll compare these to the ones collected in Rinascita to evaluate its performance.
No problem. Leave it to me.
I have other matters to attend to.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I've remotely upgraded your Flight Module, and the user manual has been uploaded to your Terminal. You can check it anytime.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: Very well. Just be sure to stay safe. I'll stay in touch during the test.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That's okay. You're welcome to come back when you're free.
What is this Flight Module you mentioned?

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: I'm sure you're very familiar with the Glider?

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: To put it simply, the Flight Module shares a similar mechanic—it also revolves around the wings of an Echo.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: But unlike the Glider, it offers a faster flight and more rapid maneuvers.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: This technology originated from Rinascita and cannot be deployed outside of that region, including Jinzhou, due to certain limitations.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That is, until recently, we've made it functional here with some adjustments. Now, we just need to test its stability and safety.

speaker: NPC #750168
anh_en: That's why we'd like your help in collecting some flight data, so that we can make further improvements to it.
What do I need to do then?

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: Ha ha ha... Found ya at last, {PlayerName}! You haven't forgotten me, right?

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: It's Abbowser! I'm no purple Abby... Never mind. Here's that once-in-a-year good message:

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: The 2nd anniversary of the Second Coming of Solaris is just around the corner, and your favorite game is back by popular demand!
Is that so...

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Kinda figured it out.

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: You guessed it right! It's the game highly acclaimed—Cubie Derby!

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: But here's the kicker: this time, I will join the race myself! Ha ha ha... make your way to the arena and prepare to be dazzled by my magnificent gallantry!

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: By the way. Be sure to join my supporters. You know how it goes—I'll bring that grand prize home without breaking a sweat.
You are...?
Unsubscribe.
Why have I heard of this line before?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Who is this?

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: I am the—ahem—it doesn't matter who I am. What matters is I've got a once-in-a-year scoop for you.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Unsubscribe.

speaker: NPC #850618
anh_en: I will—aheam—I really recommend you listen to my message. Did you catch the "once-in-a-year" part?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Oh... Are you that purple Abby?

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: …Impressive, Stardust. Victory is yours.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Your last blow shook me to my very core. But next time, I will win!

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: Next time, we'll go all out again!

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Of course. Wait… I feel myself fading.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: So this was it... My final wish... was to fight you properly.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: ...You've remembered now, haven't you? Everyone else has found their path. Now, it's our turn.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: In this duel called life, let's walk together and shine forth to the future!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So… nobody cared about the half-priced bento?

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: ...You win, King.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Hahahaha! Your strike shook my soul, Stardust. But in the end, the King stands above all.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: Next time, we'll go all out again!

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Of course. Wait… I feel myself fading.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: So this was it... My final wish... was to fight you properly.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: ...You've remembered now, haven't you? Everyone else has found their path. Now, it's our turn.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: In this duel called life, let's walk together and shine forth to the future!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So… nobody cared about the half-priced bento?

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: ...Incredible, Stardust. You've found a third possibility beyond victory and defeat.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Take it, and know you hold the symbol of glory—this half-priced bento!

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: But it's not enough! A tie cannot shake the King's soul.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Tonight, this street has no winner. No one has earned this half-priced bento.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: In that case... let's give it to the one who witnessed our duel.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: You there, spectator. This half-priced bento belongs to you now.
What?
But I didn't even do anything.

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: No, I saw it, the duelist's spirit burning within you.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Yes. You must've fought countless soul-shaking battles, haven't you?
(Deliver the castaway.)

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Ah, Passenger, you found it! The legendary half-priced bento!
What is this half-priced bento anyway?

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: A half-priced bento is a bento that gets marked down late at night, a symbol of rules and hope!

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: It's the little spark of joy on the shelf when your stomach growls, an oasis you find in the desert of thirst...

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Ahem. Anyway, I'll restore the information inside this frequency right away.

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: With a cafeteria this fancy, bringing a bento to class feels pointless...

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Oof, now I'm hungry just watching.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: I've got bad news... A package meant for the cafe has gone missing.
What happened?
New outfits again?

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: One of us found a castaway outside, and we figured it'd be easier for you if we mailed it straight here.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Along the way, a helpful citizen offered to deliver it, but he never showed up.
That sounds fishy.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: I don't know... but I can track every lost package's location.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Right now, it's sitting deep inside the Hanakage Underground Street. Please come with me!
... Are you sure he was just being "helpful"?

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: I failed, I failed, I failed, I failed, I failed, I failed, I failed...

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: What kind of fool am I, thinking I could be a hero of justice? I'm long past the age for that.
You're selling yourself short.
Your life is not a failure.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: At least, you still had the courage to hold this sword, didn't you? You've come this far with justice in your heart.

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: …Thank you. Please, take this "hero's sword." Do what I couldn't... Finish off those monsters!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Request accepted. I'll take care of it for you.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Aww, you guys got me emotional… but wait, that's our package in the first place!

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Careful, Passenger! I can sense something dangerous ahead.

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: But… I couldn't. I couldn't take another step forward... because I didn't have the courage to face it.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: What's wrong? You look more helpless than helpful now.
Why did you take the package?
Could you stop repeating that?

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: Ah, I'm sorry I took this sword… Someone like me doesn't deserve to hold it.

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: I used to run with a gang, living a life of failure. And when I finally managed to find a decent job through an agency, I got fired for being clumsy.

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: To stop my family from worrying, I pretended to go to work every day. But all I did was wander around like a vagrant...

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: This sword reminded me of when I was a kid, when I was still naively brave. So I wanted… to prove myself.

speaker: NPC #50264
anh_en: I thought I could help people get rid of the monsters in the underground street. It took everything in me just to lure it this far.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Well done. The underground street will finally see some peace for now.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Alright, let's see what Lahai-Roi information is tucked away in here.
Shouldn't we return to the cafe first?

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Not anymore. <ano=Namipons>We</ano> have made a little upgrade to the Lahai-Roi Frequency Analyzer...

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: From now on, you'll be able to connect to it remotely through your Terminal.
Why are you here alone?
Where's that young man?

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: After you defeated the TD, he vanished with a smile on his face, perhaps knowing his efforts hadn't been in vain.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: Oh, and in his final moments, he left a message for you...

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: What you said made me realize, even with all the bumps in my life, I'm no different from others. We're all just trying to live each day the best we can.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: I still have friends I trust, and a family who cares for me. I think… it's time for me to go home.
He came to terms with it in the end.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: …Yes. Anyone who lives each day the best they can is already a hero in their own story.

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: KuKu, good to see you again, Bloom Bearer.
I think I know who that is.
So, the coffee-making capybara.

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: Ku! My mission here is complete. Good luck on your journey.

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: Do you remember me? I'm the Tethys Terminal assigned to look after Ms. Chisa.
What's the matter?
Did something happen to Chisa?

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: Your friend in Honami City asked me to pass along a few words—

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: This time, it's not about Ms. Chisa. In fact, her emotional readings have been high lately. She's now preparing to resume her studies at the Academy.

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: Your friend in Honami City asked me to pass along a few words—

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: Passenger, radio repairs are almost done. As for <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, that region you and Chisa talked about, I've made a discovery.

speaker: NPC #50201
anh_en: If you have time, come see me at the cafe.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: The restored image… looks like a very special elevator.

speaker: NPC #50263
anh_en: But why would Honami City interpret it as a sword?

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: Passenger, this is your ever-reliable transport Namipon, here for you rain or shine.
The castaway this time is...

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: This castaway is a very common means of transport in Honami City.

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: I have pinpointed its location. Please, follow me!

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: You know, Honami used to have an urban legend called the "Goddess in the Fountain."

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: That fountain looks suspicious. I'm sensing a strange frequency.

speaker: NPC #850398
anh_en: Tell me, did you drop this Gale Bike, or this Road Bike?
What's the difference?

speaker: NPC #850398
anh_en: The Gale Bike is very fast. It can climb steep slopes, but it's tough to handle. So it's only for experts.

speaker: NPC #850398
anh_en: The Road Bike is a bit slower, but much more stable, and you can take it on special lanes. Perfect for normal riders.
I'm a pro cyclist.
The regular one will do for me.

speaker: NPC #850398
anh_en: Oops, there's only one bike left. But it's still a solid ride, far better than any cheap knock-off.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Obviously, this voice is not coming from the fountain...)

speaker: NPC #50265
anh_en: Sigh… I knew I couldn't hide from you.

speaker: NPC #50265
anh_en: Thank you, Namipon. Wait, you can talk?! So the mascot of Honami is real?

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: Ahaha, it's a long story... Passenger, I'll take her to somewhere safe first.

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: That's another castaway hunt wrapped up nicely.

speaker: NPC #50265
anh_en: …Sorry, I wasn't trying to prank anyone. I just wanted to help advertise my family's bike shop.
Advertise?

speaker: NPC #50265
anh_en: Yes. My dad runs the shop all by himself, but lately, business has been slow.

speaker: NPC #50265
anh_en: ...Everyone's switching to cars or the subway. Maybe no one wants bikes anymore?

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: Not at all. Times may shift, and fashions may change, but the worth of a vehicle goes far beyond the vehicle itself.

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: Even if someday bikes disappear from the streets, the culture they embody will live on!
Namipon...
Never seen you so worked up before.

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: So the most common vehicles in Lahai-Roi are... motorcycles?

speaker: NPC #50206
anh_en: Sitting on a motorcycle, feeling the wind race past your ear, that sounds relaxing.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Super Detective Team, back in action! I cannot wait to hunt the truth with you.
Long time no see, detective.
I figured you'd show up.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: This time, the castaway awaits in the Honami Central Park. It's the kind of item that brings nostalgia.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Enough chatter. Come on, let's go!

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Hmm... No luck spotting it myself. I'll leave this challenge to you!

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Every speck, every mark, scrutinize them all. The smallest clue could be the missing piece of the puzzle.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is… a tent? Looks ordinary.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: But here comes the curious part. The ground was muddy from the rain the night before, but there was not a single footprint around the tent.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Which means... no one in, no one out. That tent was a classic "locked room"!
Did you just make that up?
The story's a bit worn out…

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Ahem. Want to try your hand at deduction? To be clear, this case involves no Resonator tricks.
(This was clearly suicide.)
(This was clearly a statue trick.)
I'm not in the mood for riddles.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It was ice. "A" froze the dagger's hilt in a block of ice, blade pointing upward.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Then he leaned back onto it, stabbing himself. The ice melted in the summer heat, erasing the evidence and making it seem like a murder.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Haha! Real detectives aren't like those in novels and comics. Big cases don't fall into our laps at every street corner.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Brilliant! You noticed the temperature and drew a solid answer!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It was the statue. The killer disguised themselves as a plaster statue, then stabbed "A" when his guard was down.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And when others arrived, the killer kept pretending to be a plaster statue, right at the scene.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Excellent! You focused on the key object and drew a solid answer!

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Hmm, I was hoping you'd dazzle me with your own theory.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Alright then, just tell me the truth.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Very well! The truth is that the killer sent a Chop Chop Echo inside the tent to do the dirty work!
...Totally believable.
Chisa would hate this kind of deduction.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Ahem. Now then, time to unveil the Lahai-Roi secrets in this castaway!

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Most days, it's just humble work, like tracking runaway cats, shadowing cheating—Ahem...

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Anyway, the tent, yes. That reminds me of a bizarre case I solved years ago. Care for a tale?
Yes, please.
Even if I say no, you'll just keep going, won't you?

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: It was a summer's day. A middle-aged sculptor—let's call him "A"—was found dead in his camping tent.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Time of death, dawn. Cause, a dagger through the back. And at the scene stood a plaster statue.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: It seemed "A" was working on a new sculpture when the killer struck from behind.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Welcome, Passenger! These days, Honami has been flooded with "castaways" from Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Since Lahai-Roi is your next stop, the information inside those frequencies will definitely be of some use.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The problem is… once they reach Honami, their appearance changes.
Any idea why?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hmm... maybe they lose part of their frequency while passing through the rift. Or maybe Honami can't interpret their original form.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: From what I heard from Chisa, Startorch Academy's technology is two steps ahead of what we have here.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: So, Honami just reshapes them into something familiar to the Left Behind.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: But I've figured out a way to restore their true form—

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Pon-pon! Presenting, the Lahai-Roi Frequency Analyzer!
...Isn't that the radio?
...And a monitor from the Black Shores?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: By the way, have you ever heard of castaways?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hehe, yes... I traded several cups of coffee to borrow this mystical monitor from the Black Shores passengers.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The process is simple. Step one, analyze the frequencies with the radio. Step two, reconstruct their images on the display!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Relax. I'll handle the technical parts. All you need to do is bring me the castaways.
And where exactly am I supposed to find them?
Sounds like a hassle.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: No need to worry. I will provide you with their general locations.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: No hassle. I will provide you with their general locations.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: In fact, the nearest one is just by the Crossing.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Passenger, if you're interested, go take a look.
Chisa mentioned it before.
Not that I can recall.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: That makes it easier. They're things from outside Honami, like the cassette you and Chisa found in the fountain.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: They're frequencies from elsewhere that end up in Honami for all sorts of reasons.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The cassette you and Chisa found in the fountain was a typical castaway.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's bringing more castaways from Lahai-Roi?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: My guess is that when the rift at the Crossing opened, it "spat" them into Honami City.

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: The design of these living facilities is really unique...

speaker: NPC #50205
anh_en: Am I seeing straight? Why are their tents shaped like sheep?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Namipon in charge of this search... is not here?

speaker: NPC #50266
anh_en:
To lighten her master's troubles is the basic duty of a maid.
If you are reading this note, it means—
I have already set out to retrieve the castaway for you!

This time, the castaway should be near the Meishin Passageway.
There shouldn't be any danger… I hope.

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: As long as I carry my master's mission, I will not give in!

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: Oh no… I can't... I'm terrible at combat...

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: Goshujin-sama! Thank you for saving me in time. I found this castaway further inside the passageway.

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: For some reason, the castaway seems to have drawn the TDs here.
You need to stay safe.
Don't go off to risky places by yourself again.

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: Understood. Next time, I will not disgrace myself like this.

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: Please, allow me to show you the castaway's original form!

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: It turns out to be a mechanical bird that wakes people in the morning.

speaker: NPC #50203
anh_en: Hehe, Goshujin-sama, I'm sure you'd prefer a maid's voice waking you up instead, right?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Passenger, welcome back. Finally, our castaway search is almost finished.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hehe, and it's really close by. It's up on the coffeehouse terrace.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Go check it out, Passenger.
Almost finished?
You're finally back to your usual self.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Yes. These past days must have been tiring for you.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Because it's the one you know best.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Thanks to the castaways we've collected, I can soon pin down the coordinates from Honami to Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Once the rift stabilizes, you and Chisa will be able to return to your Academy.
You've been a huge help, Namipon.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: But… there's still one last castaway to be found.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Morning, {PlayerName}. Hope I didn't surprise you much.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: In times like this, even a schoolgirl can pilot a robot!
Is that some new catchphrase?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: It's nice, isn't it? Even as the loop ends, some of the Left Behind remain here in Honami, living their quiet, everyday lives.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: You must have pieced together something about Lahai-Roi from the castaways, right?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I can't help much… I didn't stay at Startorch Academy long enough to gather much info.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That means we're on the same starting line. We'll learn about Lahai-Roi together once we get there.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Hm. I'd love to.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I have a feeling… Once you're back at the Academy, you'll be pulled into many things.
What sort of things?
Good to see you again, Chisa.
Is there something you know?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I honestly don't know. But it should have a lot to do with your time there.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Sooner or later, we'll run into our own share of troubles. But whatever happens, I believe everything will turn out all right.
We'll help each other out, classmate.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Yes, we will help each other. As classmates.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Ahem, back to the business. Let's take a look at what's inside this castaway.
…I should've guessed.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Namipon said the last castaway was up here on the terrace.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Well, I'm sort of a "castaway" from <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te> myself.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Haha, sorry. I was making weird jokes again. Anyway, here it is. I found it near Neon Tower.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: The search went smoothly. The only challenge was not knowing the exact location, but a sweet schoolgirl showed me the way.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A sweet... schoolgirl?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Right. She was into robot culture, and before she left, she told me—

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This does look like something you'd find in Honami.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Looks like a note is attached to it.)

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: …On my way to academic enrollment, I saw this towering figure standing at the horizon of the frostlands.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Later, I found its name in the Academy orientation materials—

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: From what I read, it's directly tied to why Startorch Academy was founded in Lahai-Roi.
Some time later, you arrive near the Meishin Passageway mentioned in the note…

speaker: NPC #50260
anh_en: When... did the rain stop?\n...Even if no rain falls, I will stay here with you.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Back so soon, Passenger! Seems everything went well.
(Deliver the castaway.)

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Ah, a sunny doll that carries people's wishes.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: When the rainy season comes, Honami folk hang these dolls by their windows, hoping for fair weather.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Alright, time to find out what Lahai-Roi intel it holds...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: So, this is the sun Lahai-Roi's people have been living under.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: If that's the case… does it still rain there at all?

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Passenger, you're here! I'll be guiding you to the castaway today.
It's you, the mall guide.
Why is it you this time?

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: This time, the castaway is not at the Crossing. It's over by the shops on Ginga Street.

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: And I know Ginga Street inside out. So they sent me to guide you.
Time to set off.
That's a bit of a trek.

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Hold on, Passenger. I can teleport you there directly.

speaker: NPC #50204
anh_en: Destination: Ginga Street! In three, two, one... off we go!

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: This bento... I saw it first.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: You there, stranger, tell us. Who deserves this half-priced bento?
Stardust, obviously.
The King, no doubt.
Actually, I'm an Apex Duelist of Peak of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Hah! Then you clearly know nothing of the gulf between me and him!

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Hahahaha! Good! For I am the King of Ginga Street.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: I see… so you're a duelist as well. But what is this Peak of Prestige?
Like that, you witness a mysterious evening duel on Ginga Street.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Hah! "First come, first served"? Don't insult me with playground rules. Remember, Stardust—

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: When night falls, this street becomes a battlefield. And the half-priced bento is the crown of a true King!

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: If you lack the resolve to burn your soul for glory, then pay full price like the loser you are!

speaker: NPC #50261
anh_en: I get it now. But with my companions' bonds on my shoulders, I will not lose.

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Then let me show you what a true King's duel is.
It's just a bento...

speaker: NPC #50262
anh_en: Hold it. Seems our duel has attracted a spectator.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Are you ready to Overdash?
I came for the rewards.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: That's right.
It's no surprise you're drawn to such an exciting event.
Hmm, looks like we need to ramp up our promotions...
But hey, now that you're here, why not give it a shot? It's free, after all!
I wish you'd put it a bit more tactfully...
Alright, let me run you through the event rules!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Overdash is all about racing through the air using Grapples to show off your skills.
Is it safe?
Is it legal?
Ready for what?
Can't be more familiar. Shall we start now?
Don't worry! It's completely legit!
Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Don't worry! It's completely legit!
Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Fantastic! By the way, let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development. We've got the green light!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: They're gone...
The documents... are gone!!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: A-Anyway, trust me! We've got all the permits!
You are...

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: As long as we stick to the designated area, we are good to go.
This time, we're racing on an "Easy" track on the outskirts of Jinzhou, perfect for beginners like you!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Normally, I'd guide newbies through their first Overdash, but I need to track down those documents, you know...

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: So, here's a trick instead. Pay attention, and stay safe, okay?

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Step 1: Assess your surroundings. Step 2: Get your hook ready. Step 3: Warm up. Step 4: Let's go! Always keep an eye out for the next Grapple Point.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: If you can't spot it, use your Glider for a better view. And remember, don't retract it mid-air or you'll fall straight down!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Even though it's a race, safety is priority number one. Got it?
Got it.
Just enjoy my performance.
It's normal to feel dizzy at first. I've got some antiemetics just in case. Hopefully, you won't need them...
For the Overdash Challenge!
Fantastic! Love your enthusiasm!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Alright, get ready for your first Overdash! Meet me outside the city. Don't stand me up!
I'm Shui, an honorary member of the Overdash Club.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Actions speak louder than words. Let's get you Overdashing right away to feel the thrill!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Just to confirm, you're here because of our ad, right?
Yes.
No.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Alright, here we are at the starting line. Feeling those butterflies fluttering?

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Alright, enough talk. If I keep going, I might just jump into the challenge myself!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Go on! Overdash your way to that finish line! You've got this!
Yes.
Raring to go.
Have you found your permit?
Haha, every time I'm about to kick off an Overdash challenge, those nerves hit me like a wave!
Excellent! Can't wait to see what you've got!
Ahem, it's not the point!

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: Once you hit that track and leap forward into the air, all this jitter will vanish, replaced by pure exhilaration.

speaker: A Thủy
anh_en: The wind whipping against your skin, the scenery blurring past you... It's like the entire world fades away, and it's just you out there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...It's time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You need to decide, Timoteo…

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: ...It's time to decide, Timoteo.
…to take revenge for their miserable fate.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: What? No, of course not. They are perfectly harmless, I assure you.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: For asset protection reasons, they're only authorized to respond with limited, non-lethal force when under serious threat.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Even if we left them alone, their reserve power wouldn't last more than two months. I seriously doubt they could stage any kind of "rebellion" in that time.
Then why go after them?

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: For money. What else could it be?

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: I helped bring them into existence myself. There's no personal grudge here.
Money...?
Is that some new technical term I missed?

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: That's right. Money. Shiny, glittering Shell Credits.
Decide? About what?

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: No, no, just money. Shiny, glittering Shell Credits.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Those unruly little things grabbed our research funds when they escaped. No idea what they'd even want money for… An accident, probably.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: We could just wait at the Sonoro's entrance and retrieve them once they're powered down.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: The only catch is, the Sonoro is not very stable. If we don't get them out soon, our funds will be lost along with them.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: That leaves us with only one option: force them into shutdown by giving them a good o' hammering, and bring them back. Hence, the "hunt."

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: As you can probably tell, I'm not exactly a combat specialist. I'm fine holding the fort here, though...
Maybe I can help.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Ah, indeed! You certainly look like a capable hunter.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Then I'll leave those biomechs to you. No need to hold back. Tear them down to components if you must, we can always put them back together.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Bring back the funds safe and sound, and I'll carve out a share as your reward. Good luck, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: To... hunt the things I created, of course.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: I was involved in a project that adapted Exoswarm biology to create a batch of biomechs.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: These biomechs can't survive long without the lab's external power supply.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Our original plan was to keep them in the lab, observe their behavior, and use the data to simulate Lahai-Roi's ecological evolution.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: But they evolved faster than we ever expected. Smarter than the originals. More cunning, too.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: They slipped out of the lab and into this Sonoro Sphere…
…to rebel against their creators.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: You're back, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: That's obviously nonsense. No one else ever heard this so-called "message." I think he just watches too many movies.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: He's never been quite normal anyway, always muttering things like "The Lament destroys civilizations, the Lament creates monsters. Man resists the Lament. Man creates biomechs."

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: The project director thinks stress from the escape incident finally broke him, and the man is having hallucinations. They've approved him for medical leave.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: In any case, these biomechs are certainly incapable of feelings or desires. They're only imitating their originals.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Maybe it was a form of migration or something... Anyway, we'll thoroughly examine the recovered units and make sure this never happens again.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Yes. Thank you for your help. Without the funds, it's going to make our future research very difficult...

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: I should head back. Still got an entire mess to clean up. Sigh... Until next time.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: The funds have come through. I'll head to Sonoro with a team soon and retrieve those power-downed biomechs.
So why did they escape?
I guess that's the end of it, then.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: Who knows… One of my colleagues says it was some kind of biological desire for freedom, that they didn't want to be confined in a lab.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: And he swore he heard a message from the biomechs the day they escaped.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: We've seen the shift of evolution... Auroras refracted through ice, blotting out the stars... Where starlight cannot reach, the future becomes yesterday, and eternity returns to the void.

speaker: NPC #750464
anh_en: All those moments will be lost in time, like tears frozen in ice.
You really think the biomechs said that?

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}! Long time no see!
Blank?

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Exactly. As the head of Wutherium Film Studio, I'm tied to my duties every day. I can't leave Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: And in this city, there's no real stage for battle, making it impossible to admire the graceful battle postures of Resonators.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: So all I can do is let my imagination run wild, until it turns into empty reels, tangled with my hair...

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: So please! I need you to breathe life into them!
I doubt I can do it alone…
Sounds a bit creepy, mate.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: No, no, no, you misunderstand! I'm not asking you to fill every reel yourself.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Behold! The Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition!

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Capture the breathtaking moments of Resonators in battle!

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Savior from a foreign land, the dark thunderbolt streaking across the world… Every time I see you, I feel an urge to capture this extraordinary moment!

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Whether it's the undying hunter who walks the underworld…

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Or the mysterious swordsman wrapped in shadows…

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Seek them out with your steps, seize them with your gaze, and preserve them with your lens!

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Help my reels regain their rightful brilliance.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: C-MOSS and I will be forever grateful for your help.
That's too much. Cut it out.
Let's get to the point.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Hahaha, forgive me. I just get carried away whenever I see your majestic figure…

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Right, right. I actually have a favor to ask.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Ever since I saw your valor in battle, my fascination with combat-type Resonators has only grown.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Every time I think of your fierce roundhouse kick, that unyielding stance… and then, the reels in my hair start growing wildly—

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: But alas… they're blank.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You've done it... You defeated him.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But this is not the end. You may choose to go to the deeper layers of this dream, where challenges still await.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: In the future, you may encounter more and more people or things you're familiar with in the Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But I believe, you'll get to the bottom of what created these bizarre realms.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Until then. See you around.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Oh, it's you again! It's been a while, hasn't it? Hmm, no, should I say, "Nice to meet you?"

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: I don't know its name, but it's a super big black cat! Like bigger than a tiger!

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Huh... why? It's not a bad cat.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: There are scary monsters beyond the gate. I've seen them before, but this time, they feel... different.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Something tells me they're from somewhere... "deeper."
You mean, the depths of dreams?

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: I'm not sure. They're probably from somewhere I haven't been... or even know about.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: They're tough. My friends and I couldn't handle them. But, thankfully, that black cat showed up out of nowhere.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: It carried me on its back and brought me through the gate, but then… it turned around and went back.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: {PlayerName}, could you help us? Please defeat those monsters and save my friends and that big black cat!

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Even though most of my friends are still stuck on the other side, all of us who got out will help you like always!
I don't think we've met before.
As always...?
Has this happened before?

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Maybe... at some point in the future? After all, time is a closed loop.
(Remain silent)
...I've heard that before.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Anyway, I'll be rooting for you! Please drive those bad guys away!
You're the child from before.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Really? That's not too surprising though... Anything can happen here! Maybe I mixed up the time, mistaking what hasn't happened with what already has...

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: That's right! I feel like we've met somewhere else before. But... when?

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Hmm, I can't remember.

speaker: NPC #750102
anh_en: Oh, by the way, have you seen that large black cat?
You mean... the Gatekeeper?
We fought once.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It's been a while, {PlayerName}. You did it. The Somnoire has returned to peace.
Why did he open the gate?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I have my suspicions, but it's too soon to reveal them. I'll have a "talk" with him first.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Our paths will cross again soon, {PlayerName}... And that's when you'll once again determine the Somnoire's fate.
Where's Dorothy?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I've sent her back to the Somnoire. She doesn't belong here. It's not good for her to stay in the outside world for long.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Once again, thank you for helping us through the crisis.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: All that talk about balance... and look at the mess that ivory fool made. We had to clean up after him.
So he created those nightmares?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You could say that. Though it was more of an accident than anything.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: He opened a gate that should never have been opened, allowing those monsters from the depths to slip into the shallower realm.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The good thing is, we managed to draw their attention and buy him some time. If he's smart, he should've sealed the gate by now.

anh_en: *Click Clack*

anh_en: Beep—Your Echo Interpreter Abby is now online—

anh_en: With the help of Echo interpreter Abby, the click-clacks of C-MOSS become clear sentences.

anh_en: Let's see... Light, checked. Equipment, checked. We are ready to go! *Clack*

speaker: NPC #800328
anh_en: Verdant leaves, swaying bamboos... Eccellente! Please help me capture the chilling sense of danger lurking in this bamboo forest. *Click*

anh_en: Great angle! When capturing specific moves, Slow Motion will be activated.

anh_en: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Utility button to use Freeze Frame Camera.

anh_en: Use the skill at the fourth slot of your lineup to turn on or off the Slow Motion as you like. *Clack*

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: Hello, hello. It's been quite a while. Remember me, {PlayerName}? It's Yhoran from the Black Shores.
Just a tiny bit?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Just a tiny bit?

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: Ahem... Never mind the details, I was only joking. Now, on to our business.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: I've collected some feedback from agents and researchers, and made some improvements to the simulator based on it. I might need your help testing it out again.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: I'll fill you in on the specific updates once we meet. I'll see you at Startorch Academy, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: Thanks to your help, our research on the combat simulator has been going smoothly, both in the Black Shores and Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: The last version, Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier, was a hit with all the agents. They reported that the Lament simulated by Tethys felt genuinely immersive, like a real apocalypse.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: That feeling of pushing back against fate, clutching at the thinnest thread of hope while drowning in despair, only to finally get swallowed by the TD Outbreak in the end... it left everyone in awe...
Okay...

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Sounds like something Cristoforo would be into.

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: Oh, you mean the Overseer of the Fractsidus? Is that a compliment or are you being sarcastic...?

speaker: NPC #300092
anh_en: Well, I was just repeating everyone's feedback as it was, although... umm, I do admit I added just a tiny bit of artistic expression into it.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Oh, you're here, {PlayerName}. Even from the intel I saw, I still couldn't tell from the pictures just how massive Startorch Academy actually is...

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Just like that famous action-movie star from Huanglong did in those old movies KU-Cass collected.
I think I've heard of it.
You mean "Champion in the Machine City"?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Anyway, this time around, we removed the default offensive Resonance Abilities from the simulator.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Instead, you'll have to rely on your own strategy and whatever you can get your hands on—weapons, handmade tools, even scrap salvaged from ruins—to take on the TDs.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: We've also given this project a brand-new codename, Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Now, then... That's all I have for now.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Oh, you're gonna need your friends to come along for the testing this time as well. Don't worry, the pay will be good, same as before.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Thank you in advance, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: All the students here look incredibly energetic as well, like they could pull ten all-nighters in a row on their research and still be fine.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: And look at me, a couple of sleepless nights, and I'm already checking the drain for hair loss. Ah, to be young again.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Oh, sorry, I got sidetracked.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Just as I mentioned over WavesLine, we've made adjustments to the previous Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Long story short, this new simulator works much the same as the last one. Both use panoramic holographic technology to recreate scenarios where various locations are hit by "critical crises."

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Basically, it's about dealing with TD Outbreaks, and I'm sure it's nothing new to you at this point.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier leaned heavily on strong Resonators and their Resonance Abilities as the deciding factor in combat.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: But that doesn't apply to all agents. Some agents are better at working with their environment, using whatever items and tools they can find to deal with Tacet Discords, rather than relying on their Resonance Abilities.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Help—Hello?—Well, they say even a good horse stumbles...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Wait, in my case, that should be "even KU-Cage fumbles," ku ku ku.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: KU-Cage?
Let me guess: Virtual Crisis, right?

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Ku ku ku. Sounds like my reputation as the developer of Virtual Crisis has really left a mark on you!

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: You're right! And this time, we are simulating none other than the magnificent and mysterious Lahai-Roi!

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Though you already know that place like the back of your hands.
Then you must be collecting quite a lot of data.

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Yeah, tell me about it! Exosworm, mechs, and even the Threnodian...

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: I've been frying my circuits processing all those complicated environment models—sorting, categorizing, writing the algorithm...

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: And when I finally finished building the environment for this round of Virtual Crisis, I was so hyped I wanted to kick up my "foot" in celebration! Then I rolled straight into that bush.
Thanks for all the hard work. Looking forward to seeing your work.

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Oh, it was nothing. You can even try it now! And if you'd like to take it step by step, you can always customize the difficulty.

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Wow, that soothing voice… My favorite elite Bloom Bearer! We meet again!

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Ku ku ku. Now dive in, face all those formidable foes across the endless Crisis Trials, and collect some sweet combat data for the Black Shores!
Let me get you out of there.
You fumble around the grass and find KU-Cage, then take it out.

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Thanks. Any longer in there and my grass-cleaning buddy would've tossed me out like the rest of the trash. Ha, just kidding.
You know, I always see you stuck in the grass.

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Ku ku ku. I'm a bot, and a bot makes mistakes. Total accident. Nothing more.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If you put it that way... But we are in the Black Shores, how did you manage to fall into the grass like that on your turf?

speaker: NPC #750104
anh_en: Good question! My computation core's been maxed out lately. Watching where I'm going? Not exactly enough processing power for something trivial like that.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Ahem... "Just name the target."

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Let's work together again.

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: Swirl.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Fine, fine... I'll help.

speaker: NPC #350099
anh_en: Ripples dance bright.

speaker: NPC #750872
anh_en: Sounds flow!

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Leave it in my hands.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Name your color!

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Time to trim things down.

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: Mm, I am here.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Over here.

speaker: NPC #350099
anh_en: Spring's breath sings.

speaker: NPC #750872
anh_en: Swift as wings!

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.
